Description

About Us

Zelis is modernizing the healthcare financial experience in the United States (U.S.) across payers, providers, and healthcare consumers. We serve more than 750 payers, including the top five national health plans, regional health plans, TPAs and millions of healthcare providers and consumers across our platform of solutions. Zelis sees across the system to identify, optimize, and solve problems holistically with technology built by healthcare experts – driving real, measurable results for clients.

At Zelis, AI is woven into the fabric of how we work. Every associate is expected - and empowered - to partner with AI to challenge the status quo, accelerate innovation, and amplify their impact. This is a place for builders with a growth mindset who act with agility, embrace change, and use modern technology to shape smarter solutions, exceptional experiences, and the future of our industry for our clients, customers, and our culture.

Why We Do What We Do

In the U.S., consumers, payers, and providers face significant challenges throughout the healthcare financial journey. Zelis helps streamline the process by offering solutions that improve transparency, efficiency, and communication among all parties involved. By addressing the obstacles that patients face in accessing care, navigating the intricacies of insurance claims, and the logistical challenges healthcare providers encounter with processing payments, Zelis aims to create a more seamless and effective healthcare financial system.

Zelis India plays a crucial role in this mission by supporting various initiatives that enhance the healthcare financial experience. The local team contributes to the development and implementation of innovative solutions, ensuring that technology and processes are optimized for efficiency and effectiveness. Beyond operational expertise, Zelis India cultivates a collaborative work culture, leadership development, and global exposure, creating a dynamic environment for professional growth. With hybrid work flexibility, comprehensive healthcare benefits, financial wellness programs, and cultural celebrations, we foster a holistic workplace experience. Additionally, the team plays a vital role in maintaining high standards of service delivery and contributes to Zelis’ award-winning culture.

Position Overview

The Client Business Analyst (CBA) will be responsible for monitoring, analyzing, summarizing and presenting data for all assigned editing clients. The Client Business Analyst will work as part of the Client Policy Integration team to provide monthly performance summaries which includes but is not limited to trends, edit utilization, outliers and impact of requested edit customizations. This role will provide a major contribution enhancing the overall capacity of the Client Policy Integration team to meet the key performance goals for client edit adoption and revenue optimization. The Client Business Analyst will ensure day-to-day activities align with the overall mission and adherence to best practice policies.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

  • 5–10 years of relevant experience, or an equivalent combination of education and work experience, with healthcare payers.

  • Current certified coder (AAPC or AHIMA), RHIA/RHIT certification, or RN/LPN with coding knowledge preferred, but not required

  • Demonstrate an expert level understanding of all Zelis editing products with an ability to clearly articulate correct coding/claim adjudication guidelines, and interpretation of client policies.

  • Perform revenue optimization analysis for Zelis editing products and assigned accounts as defined by the business unit (external and internal customers).

  • Demonstrate expertise in auditing claims processes and edit performance validation with ability to document root-cause analysis for escalation and resolution.

  • Partner with Client Integration Specialist team to support the implementation of the Zelis editing product which includes but is not limited to data review, interpreting client policies, guidance for requested client customizations and support testing and client “go-live”.

  • Support the research/validation of new edit concepts, pre-production data analysis, determine client selection based on edit volume/potential savings opportunity and support new edit communication/rollout strategies.

  • Critically evaluate information gathered from multiple sources, reconcile conflicts and provide a synopsis of findings

  • Weekly, monthly and quarterly client financial KPI analysis; monitor client trends, work with assigned teams to report/escalate issues that would affect daily business operations.

  • Proactively escalate identified claim adjudication issues utilizing all tools and resources to document and resolve

  • Perform monthly performance analysis with detailed summary for edit trends, utilization, adoption, opportunity pipeline, revenue variances and forecasting.

  • Conduct ad hoc analysis as requested per assigned clients.

  • Assist in project management of financial forecasting, budgeting and trend analysis details.

  • Work with assigned aforementioned teams to design and build reports/templates to present monthly performance trends to assigned clients/internal teams.

  • Completes all responsibilities as outlined on annual Performance Plan

  • Completed all special projects and other duties as assigned

  • Ensure compliance with HIPAA regulations and requirements.

The Chevron Engineering and Innovation Excellence Center (ENGINE) in Bengaluru India brings together the resources and expertise of the Chevron global network with talent in India to enhance agility and technological innovation to optimize solutions for the world’s current and future energy challenges. As one of the leading energy providers worldwide, Chevron is involved in the production of crude oil and natural gas, manufacturing of transportation fuels, lubricants, petrochemicals, and additives, and the development of enabling technologies.

Chevron's vision is to be the global energy company most admired for its people, partnerships, and performance. With a clear purpose to develop affordable, reliable, ever-cleaner energy that enables human progress, we believe human ingenuity has the power to solve any challenge and overcome any obstacle. Meeting the world’s growing energy needs requires the pursuit of innovations and advancements that deliver a better future for all.

About the position:

A Data Analyst is responsible for gathering, analyzing and problem solving as it relates to data, types of data, and relationships among data elements within a business system or IT system and with business domain expertise. A Senior Data Analyst provides expertise on how Business workflows map to data, and how data can be integrated to build reusable data products. A Senior Data Analyst will serve as a subject matter expert for delivery teams.
The Senior Data Analyst will play a key role in transforming complex data into actionable insights to support business decision-making processes. This role requires advanced knowledge of data analysis, visualization, and cloud data services, particularly within Microsoft Azure and the Power Platform. The ideal candidate will work closely with business stakeholders, data engineers, and data scientists to develop meaningful reports and dashboards, leveraging tools such as Power BI, Spotfire, and Tableau. A Senior Data Analyst will serve as a subject matter expert for delivery teams.

Key responsibilities:

  • Data Analysis: Extract, analyze, and interpret complex datasets using Microsoft Azure Services to derive insights that drive strategic business decisions.
  • Data Modeling: Develop and maintain data models using Azure Synapse Analytics and Azure SQL Database to facilitate data analysis and reporting.
  • Data Visualization: Create interactive dashboards and reports using tools like Power BI, Spotfire, and Tableau to effectively communicate data insights to stakeholders.
  • Azure Services: Leverage Azure Data Lake for efficient data storage and retrieval, ensuring data consistency and quality.
  • Power Platform Integration: Utilize Microsoft Power Platform to automate processes, build data-driven workflows, and enhance the efficiency of data analysis tasks.
  • Collaboration with Teams: Work closely with business stakeholders to understand their data requirements and provide analytical support that meets their needs.
  • Data Quality and Governance: Implement and maintain data quality checks and data governance practices to ensure data accuracy, reliability, and compliance with industry standards.
  • Mentoring: Mentor junior data analysts and provide guidance on best practices for data analysis and visualization.

Required Qualifications:

  • Experience: 5-10 years of experience in data analysis, data visualization, or related fields.

  • Technical Skills:

  • Microsoft Azure Services: Advanced proficiency in Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Data Lake, and Azure SQL Database.

  • Data Visualization Tools: Expertise in Power BI, Spotfire, and Tableau for building insightful dashboards and reports.

  • SQL Skills: Strong skills in SQL for querying, transforming, and analyzing data.

  • Power Platform: Experience using Microsoft Power Platform, including Power Automate and Power Apps, to create automated workflows and enhance data processes.

  • Data Modeling: Experience in creating and maintaining data models that facilitate analytics and reporting.

  • Problem-Solving Skills: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify patterns and trends within large datasets.

  • Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to present data insights to non-technical stakeholders in a clear and concise manner.

  • Team Collaboration: Ability to work effectively in a team, collaborating with data engineers, data scientists, and business stakeholders.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Educational Background: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Information Technology, Statistics, or a related field.

  • Certifications: Microsoft certifications such as Azure Data Engineer Associate or Azure Data Scientist Associate are highly preferred.

  • Experience with Big Data Technologies: Exposure to big data technologies such as Hadoop, Spark, or Databricks.

  • Programming Skills: Knowledge of programming languages like Python or R for advanced data analysis.

  • Experience with Data Governance: Familiarity with data governance practices and data privacy regulations, ensuring compliance in data handling.Selection Criteria:

  • Technical Skills:

  • Microsoft Azure Proficiency:

  • Demonstrated expertise in working with Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Data Lake, and Azure SQL Database to manage and analyze large datasets.

  • Ability to leverage Azure services for efficient data storage, processing, and analysis.

  • Data Visualization Expertise:

  • Strong experience in creating interactive and insightful dashboards using Power BI, Spotfire, and Tableau.

  • Ability to translate complex data insights into visually appealing and understandable formats for stakeholders.

  • Power Platform Integration:

  • Proficiency in using Power Platform tools, such as Power Automate and Power Apps, to build workflows that streamline data analysis and business processes.

  • SQL and Data Modeling:

Have the opportunity to take part in world-leading energy projects, advance your professional development and expand your career within an inclusive and collaborative workplace.

About the position:

A Data Analyst is responsible for gathering, analyzing and problem solving as it relates to data, types of data, and relationships among data elements within a business system or IT system and with business domain expertise. A Senior Data Analyst provides expertise on how Business workflows map to data, and how data can be integrated to build reusable data products. A Senior Data Analyst will serve as a subject matter expert for delivery teams.
The Senior Data Analyst will play a key role in transforming complex data into actionable insights to support business decision-making processes. This role requires advanced knowledge of data analysis, visualization, and cloud data services, particularly within Microsoft Azure and the Power Platform. The ideal candidate will work closely with business stakeholders, data engineers, and data scientists to develop meaningful reports and dashboards, leveraging tools such as Power BI, Spotfire, and Tableau. A Senior Data Analyst will serve as a subject matter expert for delivery teams.

Overview:

About the Role & Team
I

Currently we are looking for a Junior Data Analyst to join our Software research team. If you are passionate about technology, eager to explore market trends, and ready to develop your analytical and technical skills, we offer the perfect platform for your professional growth. Our team is committed to nurturing talent, providing extensive training, and supporting long-term career development. You'll work closely with research analysts and the broader forecasting team, owning the analysis and reporting that underpins IDC's published research. This is a strong opportunity for someone who enjoys working with data end-to-end — from cleaning and validating it, to modelling trends, to presenting findings in a way that drives decisions.


What You’ll Do


  • Collect, clean, and validate data from multiple sources, ensuring accuracy and consistency across datasets.
  • Perform quantitative analysis on market size, growth rates, and vendor performance using appropriate analytical tools and techniques. Create models that reconcile data from disparate sources, including SEC filings, vendor surveys, press releases, primary research, and analyst estimates.
  • Identify trends, patterns, anomalies, and key business drivers within large and varied data sets. Design fact and dimension tables for vendor revenue, market sizing, and forecast data
  • Model relationships between vendors, products, M&A activity, and parent/subsidiary corporate structures
  • Translate raw data into actionable insight, presenting analysis in a way that's easy for stakeholders to act on.
  • Partner with research and forecasting teams to ensure data consistency across publications and deliverables.
  • Support ad-hoc data requests and analysis, adapting quickly to shifting priorities.
What You Bring
  • Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field such as Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, or Engineering (preferred) with a strong understanding of economic principles and their application to market analysis.
  • 1.5 years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, or market research, ideally within the technology industry.
  • Proven experience in financial analysis and market modelling.
  • Strong analytical, critical thinking and pattern recognition skills with an understanding of the broader business implications of data findings.
  • Skilled in analysing complex datasets and developing predictive models, with familiarity in statistical tools and methodologies.
  • Strong English written and verbal communication skills to effectively present research findings.
  • Efficient in managing multiple research projects and meeting deadlines. Excellent in problem-solving around data integrity, redundancy, and scalability.
  • Advanced Excel skills, including pivot tables, formulas – ex. VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, data validation, COUNT and macros knowledge is a plus. Experience using Advanced Excel is a must.
  • Leverage Large Language Models (LLMs) such as Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, and similar AI tools to accelerate research, data extraction, content summarization, information synthesis, and productivity. workflows using strong prompt engineering, rigorous data validation to ensure accuracy and reliability.
  • Excellent attention to detail and a commitment to data accuracy.
  • Stakeholder communication and presentation skills. Adaptability to shifting priorities and ad-hoc requests.
  • Ability to work effectively in a hybrid work environment.

Why This Role Stands Out
At IDC, your work helps shape how the world understands technology and where it goes next. You collaborate with curious, high-caliber colleagues who value rigor, integrity, and shared success. As the premier global provider of trusted technology intelligence, IDC equips business and technology leaders with the evidence they need to make confident decisions. Our insights inform strategy, investment, and innovation across industries and regions.

Recognized by IIAR as Analyst Firm of the Year for five consecutive years, IDC sets the standard for credibility and impact. With more than 1,000 analysts worldwide and a truly global perspective, we combine deep expertise with practical relevance. Here, your ideas matter, your voice is heard, and your contributions provide the insights leaders rely on every day. It is meaningful work, backed by a culture that supports growth, collaboration, and long-term career development with a globally respected brand.

What We Offer

  • A competitive benefit package with additional companywide (1 day in the summer and global shutdown from 24th Dec to 1st Jan).
  • Comprehensive Training: Willingness to learn! We provide extensive training in market research and data analysis.
  • Career Growth: Clear pathways for professional development and advancement within the company.
  • Work Flexibility: Hybrid work model with a mix of in-office and work-from-home days, along with flexible working hours.
  • Supportive Culture: Join a team that values innovation and promotes a supportive and collaborative environment.
  • A position in a highly professional and globally respected market research and advisory firm, where initiative leading to results is rewarded.
Equal Opportunity Employer
IDC is committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all qualified persons. Employment eligibility verification required. We participate in E-Verify.

Location: Nagpur

Job Summary

ARC Technologies and Institutions is looking for an experienced Data Analyst Trainer who can deliver strong conceptual knowledge along with hands-on industry-oriented training. The trainer should be capable of mentoring candidates using real-world datasets, industrial projects, and practical use cases, preparing them for analytics roles in the industry.

Skills Required

* Advanced Microsoft Excel (Formulas, Pivot Tables, Dashboards)

* SQL (Joins, Subqueries, Performance Optimization)

* Power BI (DAX, Data Modeling, Interactive Dashboards)

* Python for Data Analysis (NumPy, Pandas, Matplotlib, Seaborn)

* AI – Generative AI & Prompt Engineering

* Understanding of real-world Data Analytics workflows

Key Responsibilities

* Deliver classroom/online training sessions for Data Analyst courses

* Provide practical, hands-on learning using live datasets

* Train candidates on industry-level projects and case studies

* Guide students in capstone and real-time analytics projects

* Conduct assessments, assignments, and mock interviews

* Prepare students for industry requirements and placements

* Share industry insights, best practices, and real-world scenarios

* Support students with doubt-clearing and project reviews

* Strong communication and presentation skills

* Ability to explain complex concepts in a simple, structured manner

* Experience in training, mentoring, or working as a Data Analyst

* Passion for teaching and upskilling freshers and working professionals

* Hands-on experience with real-time or industrial projects

Experience

* 2+ years of experience in Data Analytics / Training / Industry Projects

* Training experience will be an added advantage

* Opportunity to work with aspiring data professionals

* Professional training environment

* Exposure to latest tools and AI-driven analytics

* Long-term growth opportunities

Your role

Are you curious about financial instruments and how the data is utilized in the Asset Management lifecycle? Are you passionate about solving business problems and making an impact? Do you want to learn more about the Asset Management business?

If yes, we are looking for someone to lead Data Services Operations Lead in Pune, ensuring stable BAU delivery, handle escalations, manage projects and drive consistent data quality across datasets.

In this role, you will oversee multiple teams, drive accountability and act as link between DS leads and stakeholders.

Your team

UBS Asset Management Data Services team is responsible for providing timely, accurate and complete Security Reference & Price Data, Analytics, Index and Benchmark data to the UBS Asset Management Division – in line with defined requirements.

Sitting at the intersection of the Business and Technology teams, AM Security Reference & Price Data team is part of the Asset Management COO function and has a mandate to govern and commercialize data through innovative technology and services.

Team provides 24*6 coverage to ensure uninterrupted support and assistance to the Asset Management Division. Team members are in Chicago, Krakow, Zurich, Singapore, and Pune.

Your expertise

Key Responsibilities:
  • BAU oversight and delivery across teams, ensuring operational stability.
  • Drive process improvements.
  • Act as point of escalations for data and process issues with stakeholders.
  • Track and report risks, including NFRI and KPIs.
  • Lead and manage multiple projects and initiatives.
  • Coordinate with IT, data providers and global stakeholders for data solutions.
In addition, you will be expected to:
  • Identify opportunities to streamline data management processes, to improve efficiency.
  • Actively seek automation initiatives to simplify processes and reduce manual effort.
  • Participate & Contribute Subject Matter Expertise (SME) in team, function, division and even Group wide data & business initiatives.
  • Proactively identify and resolve potential problems and risks before they arise.
  • Follow escalation guidelines and escalate issues in a timely manner, when appropriate.

About us

UBS is a leading and truly global wealth manager and the leading universal bank in Switzerland. We also provide diversified asset management solutions and focused investment banking capabilities. Headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland, UBS is present in more than 50 markets around the globe.
We know that great work is never done alone. That’s why we place collaboration at the heart of everything we do. Because together, we’re more than ourselves. Want to find out more? Visit ubs.com/careers.

Join us

At UBS, we know that it's our people, with their diverse skills, experiences and backgrounds, who drive our ongoing success. We’re dedicated to our craft and passionate about putting our people first, with new challenges, a supportive team, opportunities to grow and flexible working options when possible. Our inclusive culture brings out the best in our employees, wherever they are on their career journey. And we use artificial intelligence (AI) to work smarter and more efficiently. We also recognize that great work is never done alone. That’s why collaboration is at the heart of everything we do. Because together, we’re more than ourselves.
We’re committed to disability inclusion and if you need reasonable accommodation/adjustments throughout our recruitment process, you can always contact us.

Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start Caring. Connecting. Growing together.


Primary Responsibilities:

  • Designs, develops, tests, documents and maintains database queries and data analysis
  • Develops and implements scripts to maintain and monitor and completes performance tuning
  • Need to Develop and Maintain the SSIS and SSRS ongoing projects with the advanced tools
  • Applies data transformation based on understanding of data structures in place using common methods
  • Understands all the connected technology services and their impacts
  • Assesses design and proposes options to ensure solution meets business needs in terms of security, scalability, reliability and feasibility
  • Effectively communicates with business stakeholders and technical team
  • Understand work with AI tools which can effectively help with productivity improvement

  • Sorts through large amounts of data to assess for relevancy
  • Pro-actively identifies patterns in issues and research root-cause to improve overall quality
  • Comply with the terms and conditions of the employment contract, company policies and procedures, and any and all directives (such as, but not limited to, transfer and/or re-assignment to different work locations, change in teams and/or work shifts, policies in regard to flexibility of work benefits and/or work environment, alternative work arrangements, and other decisions that may arise due to the changing business environment). The Company may adopt, vary or rescind these policies and directives in its absolute discretion and without any limitation (implied or otherwise) on its ability to do so

Required Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience creating stored procedures with SQL Server T-SQL, creating data pipelines in SSIS and develop reports SSRS
  • 5+ years of experience managing complex data ETL projects and programs
  • 5+ years Extensive experience in analytical roles using SQL and Programming Languages Python or similar
  • 3+ years experience creating visualizations using Power BI or similar BI Tools, to tell a compelling story with data and effectively deliver actionable insights
  • Experience with cloud-based AI services (e.g., Azure AI ,AWS or others)

Data & Analytics Specialist: Power BI, SQL & Automation

We are seeking a highly motivated and skilled Data & Analytics Specialist to join our growing team. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in developing insightful business intelligence solutions, automating data workflows, and managing robust database systems. This role is perfect for a data enthusiast who is passionate about transforming raw data into actionable insights that drive business decisions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Business Intelligence & Visualization: Design, develop, and maintain interactive and visually appealing dashboards and reports using Power BI. You will translate complex data sets into clear and concise visualizations that provide actionable insights for stakeholders across the organization.
  • ETL & Data Pipeline Development: Take ownership of the entire ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) process. This includes designing, building, and maintaining scalable data pipelines to integrate data from various sources into our data warehouse.
  • Database Management & SQL Mastery: Demonstrate expertise in SQL and PostgreSQL to write complex, efficient, and low-latency queries for data extraction, manipulation, and analysis. You will be responsible for database performance tuning and optimization.
  • Process Automation: Utilize Power Automate to design and implement automated workflows, streamlining data-related processes and improving operational efficiency.
  • Data Modeling & Analysis: Develop and implement data models to support business intelligence initiatives. Conduct in-depth data analysis to identify trends, patterns, and opportunities.
  • Collaboration & Communication: Work closely with business users, data engineers, and other stakeholders to understand data requirements and deliver effective solutions. You will be expected to clearly communicate technical concepts to non-technical audiences.

Required Qualifications

  • Proven Experience: A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, along with proven experience in a similar data-focused role.
  • Power BI Proficiency: Demonstrated expertise in Power BI, including a strong understanding of DAX (Data Analysis Expressions) and data modeling best practices.
  • ETL Expertise: Hands-on experience with ETL tools and a deep understanding of data warehousing concepts.
  • Advanced SQL Skills: In-depth knowledge of SQL, with a focus on writing high-performance, low-latency queries. Experience with PostgreSQL is essential. While SQL" certification is required, a demonstrable ability to write efficient code is paramount.
  • Power Automate Knowledge: Experience in creating and managing automated workflows using Microsoft Power Automate.
  • Analytical Mindset: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to work with large and complex datasets.
  • Excellent Communication: Strong 1 verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate with team members and stakeholders. 2

About the Company

· Convert requirements into a Business Requirements Document (BRD), definitions, metric logic, and work steps that enable the data engineer and Power BI developers to deliver

· Own delivery plans and timelines; track progress, manage dependencies, and communicate status/risks to stakeholders

· Guide a small team through the analytical and delivery cycle

· Interact with the end-users to clarify requirements, validate outputs, and manage feedback and change requests

· Ensure documentation of datasets, report logic, measures, and releases; maintain handover notes and user guides as required

Role:

The role requires a minimum of six years of experience in data analytics with a functional background in business processes, and intermediate knowledge of Power BI (or a comparable BI tool). The analyst must demonstrate the ability to work independently and efficiently, manage stakeholders, and drive delivery with timelines.

Please share your CV updated with relevant experience including atleast two professional references.

Candidates who have worked for large organisations as part of an in-house reporting or analytics teams would be preferred. Candidates who have worked for consulting firms who serve large organisations, are also encouraged to apply.

Candidates would be assessed based on the following capabilities:

Technical Capabilities:

Proven work experience of six years as a Power BI Analyst (or BI/Data Analyst with strong Power BI delivery experience) is essential.

· Strong understanding of business processes, controls, and the ability to interpret business logic into analytical requirements

· Intermediate Power BI skills including data modelling, DAX measures, report design, and performance-aware visualisation practices

· Proficient in translating business requirements into activities that enable the data engineer and Power BI development team to deliver

· Ability to define and document process flows, KPIs, and metric calculations (including assumptions, exceptions, and reconciliations)

· Demonstrable ability to investigate data to achieve the purpose of analysis and validate outputs against source systems

· Excellent conceptualisation of using visualisation to present insights for operational and financial decision-making

· Working knowledge of data concepts (joins, grains, dimensional modelling) to collaborate effectively with data engineering

· Capability to seek solutions through ambiguity and conceptualise meaningful solutions

· Experience in Visio (added advantage)

· Excellent mathematical and computational skills

Working Capabilities:

Proficient in and keen to work in a team-oriented environment

  • Excellent communication (written and oral) and interpersonal skills for managing technical and non-technical teams
  • Passionate about learning new skills and is a quick learner
  • Ability to use technology to solve business problems and work in fast-paced environments
  • Analytical thinking for independently verifying requirements versus output
  • Demonstrate ability as a self-starter and to complete tasks independently
  • Documentation of work

Education:

Candidates preferably from computer science or data science or mathematics or statistics or business backgrounds

Certifications:

Data analysis certification would be an added advantage

Languages:

Excellent communication skills in spoken and written in English is a must.

Working Location:

The role is onsite at Chennai and hence, only Chennai residents or candidates with immediate willingness to relocate to Chennai may apply.

Working Hours:

Indian Standard Time – 8 hours a day

Job Types: Full-time, Permanent

Pay: ₹800,000.00 - ₹1,000,000.00 per year

Ability to commute/relocate:

  • Chennai, Tamil Nadu: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Required)

Experience:

  • Healthcare: 3 years (Preferred)
  • Revenue and Credit Management: 1 year (Preferred)
  • Data analytics: 6 years (Required)
  • Data mock-up: 1 year (Required)
  • Corporate finance: 2 years (Preferred)

Language:

  • English (Required)

DESCRIPTION

At Amazon, the Leadership Principle “Strive to be Earth’s Best Employer” challenges us to create “a safer, more productive, higher performing, more diverse, and more just work environment,” and reinforces that nothing is more important than the safety and well-being of our teams. At Workplace Health and Safety (WHS) we strive to do just this. We work tirelessly to ensure we have the appropriate strategy, technology, and attitude to be successful. We also understand that people are at the center of safety and look to invest in talent that shares in our passion for making our employees and partners lives better.

The WHS Data team is hiring a Business Analyst (BA). The Data team is responsible for providing all reporting solutions required by the WHS Organization to drive workplace safety and regulatory compliance worldwide. This BA role will primarily support the data and reporting needs for the Safety Performance Insights (SPI) BI team in the WHS Organization. The role requires BA to identify the metrics and the dimensions that provide deep insights into program performance and also partner closely with the business to define the scope and the roadmap for the analysis, with an eye on both short term asks and long terms needs from a BI standpoint. This role requires to partner closely with Data Engineering teams to design the required data assets and where needed to partner with other business teams to study the cross-effects of safety programs on other business areas and processes.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience with SQL or ETL
  • Experience defining requirements and using data and metrics to draw business insights
  • 1+ years of Excel or Tableau (data manipulation, macros, charts and pivot tables) experience
  • 1+ years of data analysis work and leveraging analytics to make decisions experience
  • Bachelor's degree in relevant field

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience using very large datasets

Working with Us
Challenging. Meaningful. Life-changing. Those aren’t words that are usually associated with a job. But working at Bristol Myers Squibb is anything but usual. Here, uniquely interesting work happens every day, in every department. From optimizing a production line to the latest breakthroughs in cell therapy, this is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it. You’ll get the chance to grow and thrive through opportunities uncommon in scale and scope, alongside high-achieving teams. Take your career farther than you thought possible.

Bristol Myers Squibb recognizes the importance of balance and flexibility in our work environment. We offer a wide variety of competitive benefits, services and programs that provide our employees with the resources to pursue their goals, both at work and in their personal lives. Read more: careers.bms.com/working-with-us.

Core responsibilities of this role are:

  • Develop, enhance, and maintain end‑to‑end forecast models, including patient‑based, epidemiological, and scenario‑driven models, with a strong emphasis on Python‑based implementation
  • Lead the digitalization of forecasting deliverables, transitioning manual or spreadsheet‑based models into robust, automated, and reproducible Python workflows
  • Conduct analysis and interpretation of complex data sets to derive meaningful insights and recommendations to the key forecasting assumptions/decisions
  • Perform statistical analyses, data mining and predictive modelling to uncover trends and correlations
  • Partnering closely with Commercial Data Analyst teams to drive value for stakeholders by optimizing/managing business processes, synthesizing data at regular intervals, maintaining high quality standards, applying automation using cutting edge technology, performing analyses, updating business rules, presenting results to stakeholders, answering queries on deliverables and generating focused insights.
  • Collaborate with Business stakeholders to identify goals and KPIs to develop analytical frameworks
  • Collaborate with Finance team to ensure efficient forecasting processes, data/information sharing, and insight generation related to forecast performance
  • Collect real-world data from multiple sources to support business strategies and decision-making.
  • Prepare reports and presentations to communicate findings, insights, and recommendations to your team members
  • Stay up-to-date with industry trends, best practices and emerging technologies

Requirements:

  • 1-3 years experience in a similar business analyst role, preferably within the biopharma or pharmaceutical industry
  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in pharmacy, technology or engineering. In addition, a strong record of analytic and quantitative work.
  • Deep experience with short-term and Strategic forecast in Pharma industry
  • Proficiency in statistical analysis techniques, predictive modeling, and forecasting methodologies.
  • Experience operating successfully in a complex organizational environment.
  • Experience interacting with senior management, understanding, anticipating, and fulfilling their insight/ analytical information requirements
  • Strong verbal/written skills, with the ability to effectively communicate with and strategically impact senior leadership.
  • Strong Python expertise with hands‑on experience in libraries such as pandas, NumPy, scikit‑learn, and related data science/ML packages.
  • Experience integrating Python models with visualization or reporting tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, or internal platforms).
  • Advanced MS Excel and PowerPoint skills; proficiency with VBA and Macros preferred

If you come across a role that intrigues you but doesn’t perfectly line up with your resume, we encourage you to apply anyway. You could be one step away from work that will transform your life and career.

Uniquely Interesting Work, Life-changing Careers
With a single vision as inspiring as “Transforming patients’ lives through science™ ”, every BMS employee plays an integral role in work that goes far beyond ordinary. Each of us is empowered to apply our individual talents and unique perspectives in a supportive culture, promoting global participation in clinical trials, while our shared values of passion, innovation, urgency, accountability, inclusion and integrity bring out the highest potential of each of our colleagues.

On-site Protocol

BMS has an occupancy structure that determines where an employee is required to conduct their work. This structure includes site-essential, site-by-design, field-based and remote-by-design jobs. The occupancy type that you are assigned is determined by the nature and responsibilities of your role:

Site-essential roles require 100% of shifts onsite at your assigned facility. Site-by-design roles may be eligible for a hybrid work model with at least 50% onsite at your assigned facility. For these roles, onsite presence is considered an essential job function and is critical to collaboration, innovation, productivity, and a positive Company culture. For field-based and remote-by-design roles the ability to physically travel to visit customers, patients or business partners and to attend meetings on behalf of BMS as directed is an essential job function.

Supporting People with Disabilities

BMS is dedicated to ensuring that people with disabilities can excel through a transparent recruitment process, reasonable workplace accommodations/adjustments and ongoing support in their roles. Applicants can request a reasonable workplace accommodation/adjustment prior to accepting a job offer. If you require reasonable accommodations/adjustments in completing this application, or in any part of the recruitment process, direct your inquiries to adastaffingsupport@bms.com. Visit careers.bms.com/eeo-accessibility to access our complete Equal Employment Opportunity statement.

Candidate Rights

BMS will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, pursuant to applicable laws in your area.

If you live in or expect to work from Los Angeles County if hired for this position, please visit this page for important additional information: https://careers.bms.com/california-residents/

Data Protection

We will never request payments, financial information, or social security numbers during our application or recruitment process. Learn more about protecting yourself at https://careers.bms.com/fraud-protection.

Any data processed in connection with role applications will be treated in accordance with applicable data privacy policies and regulations.

If you believe that the job posting is missing information required by local law or incorrect in any way, please contact BMS at TAEnablement@bms.com. Please provide the Job Title and Requisition number so we can review. Communications related to your application should not be sent to this email and you will not receive a response. Inquiries related to the status of your application should be directed to Chat with Ripley.

Job Description:

Description:

Digital Workplace (DW) was established to be an enabler of Digital Transformation across Airbus. Its primary focus is to: provide employees with simple, intuitive and easy to use workplace tools and services; enable employees to create and collaborate from anywhere at any time; enable continuous optimisation of work experience and productivity underpinned by fit-for-purpose security.
Digital Workplace consists of the following core elements: Operational Performance, Devices and Services, Employee Collaboration, Industrial and Specialist Devices, Workplace Support, User Adoption.

We are currently looking for a new colleague mastering data analysis and tooling to join the Operational Performance PSL (DWW). His/Her expertise will support us to bring data to life. Thus we will make the right decisions in the product design and at project steering and also we will have all the information required to transform and to improve user experience.

Position Summary:

The Data Analyst will play a key role in designing, developing, and deploying scalable data solutions within the Skywise / Palantir Foundry platform or other equivalent platforms to support Airbus divisions and functions across Europe. This position combines strong analytical, technical, and communication skills to drive business value through data insights and automation.

The specialist will work closely with business and technical teams to identify opportunities for improvement through data value analysis, develop end-to-end analytics solutions, and promote data-driven decision-making across the organization.

Qualification & Experience:

We seek out curious minds. We value attention to detail, and we care deeply about outcomes. We are looking above all for passionate people, eager to learn, willing to share, establishing innovative ways of working and influencing culture change.

Are you ready to share this exciting challenge with us?

  • Bachelor/ Master Degree in Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science, Information Management, Statistics or relevant field with 1-3 years of data analysis, data management and software development experience
  • Hands-on experience with Skywise / Palantir Foundry for building and deploying end-to-end data solutions.
  • Proven track record in developing and maintaining large-scale data applications on Foundry.
  • Proficiency in Ontology Manager, Code Authoring, Contour, Workshop, and Data Ingestion modules.
  • Advanced proficiency in Python, SQL, React, JavaScript, and CSS. and strong understanding of REST APIs and Big Data architectures.
  • Experience in ETL scripting for data transformation.
  • Advanced analytical expertise in data modeling, database management, and SQL (expert level).
  • Experience with BI tools, Google Data Studio, and BigQuery.
  • Skilled in designing and maintaining KPI metrics, dashboards, and Performance Analytics (PA) reports.
  • Proficient in data acquisition, automation, and maintaining data systems from multiple sources.
  • Ability to identify valuable data sources and optimize data collection processes and Strong analytical mindset with exceptional attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Adept at querying, report writing, and presenting findings effectively.
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, and facilitation skills.
  • Experience with ITSM and ServiceNow.
  • Ability to help transform organizational reporting processes through automation and optimization.
  • Skilled in administration of reporting environments, including user management and job scheduling.

Key Requirements and Responsibilities:

  • Design, build, and maintain robust data analytics and application solutions within the Skywise (Palantir Foundry) framework.
  • Develop, test, document, and deploy data pipelines, analytical models, and visualization tools to support strategic and operational initiatives.
  • Work with Product Owners and core Airbus business functions to capture requirements, understand business processes, and deliver impactful data-driven solutions.
  • Manage the full application delivery lifecycle — from design and implementation to testing, deployment, and support.
  • Build and maintain pipelines to enable automated deployments across Development, QA, and Production environments.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve application issues, manage incidents and requests, and provide ongoing support for developed tools.
  • Encourage and enable self-service analytics by empowering business teams and promoting data literacy.
  • Coach and develop data analytics awareness among internal customers and stakeholders.
  • Define, implement, and maintain KPI metric reports, dashboards, and performance analytics (PA) reporting.
  • Help automate reporting processes and transform the organization’s approach to data management.
  • Acquire data from various sources, manage and maintain data systems, and automate data collection processes.
  • Ensure compliance with best practices in data quality, security, and governance.
  • Conduct Artificial Intelligence / Machine Language (AI/ML) feasibility studies linked to tool and platform availability within the Airbus Digital environment, including laying the foundation and start to build use cases and solutions

GOOD TO HAVE

  • Develops and manages information to support corporate decision making.
  • Coach internal business users with a goal of being largely self-sufficient for their analytics needs
  • Research and document new and improved features on existing tools
  • Become familiar with new analytics technologies in Airbus and in the marketplace
  • Stay current on latest analytics trends and emerging technologies
  • Recommend new ways of using tools to further business needs
  • User experience oriented
  • Fluency in English is mandatory, French or German knowledge will be an added advantage
  • Working experience in Agile Scrum, SAFe and/or Kanban projects

Success Metrics

Success will be measured in a variety of areas, including but not limited to

  • Consistently ensure the on-time delivery and quality (first-time-right) of the projects
  • Bring innovative cost effective solutions
  • Achieve 100% customer satisfaction
  • Ability to handle a subject from demand management, to development and support
  • Ability to understand the business potential of applications and provide insight to clients

The role will also have the following key outputs:

  • Strong link with all the Airbus Digital Workplace services
  • Proactive in providing guidance & inputs for the Airbus Digital Workplace strategic roadmap

This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth.

Airbus India Private Limited

Permanent

-

Experience Level:

Entry Level

Digital <JF-IM-DI>

Airbus is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief.

Airbus is, and always has been, committed to equal opportunities for all. As such, we will never ask for any type of monetary exchange in the frame of a recruitment process. Any impersonation of Airbus to do so should be reported to emsom@airbus.com .

Who are we?


Myntra is India’s leading fashion and lifestyle platform, where technology meets creativity. As pioneers in fashion e-commerce, we’ve always believed in disrupting the ordinary.

We thrive on a shared passion for fashion, a drive to innovate to lead, and an environment that empowers each one of us to pave our own way. We’re bold in our thinking, agile in our execution, and collaborative in spirit.
Here, we create MAGIC by inspiring vibrant and joyous self-expression and expanding fashion possibilities for India, while staying true to what we believe in.

We believe in taking bold bets and changing the fashion landscape of India. We are a company that is constantly evolving into newer and better forms and we look for people who are ready to evolve with us.
From our humble beginnings as a customization company in 2007 to being technology and fashion pioneers today, Myntra is going places and we want you to take part in this journey with us.

Working at Myntra is challenging but fun - we are a young and dynamic team, firm believers in meritocracy, believe in equal opportunity, encourage intellectual curiosity and empower our teams with the right tools, space, and opportunities.


Role : Title - Udaan Data Analyst

Type : Program for People with Disabilities

Location : Bengaluru

Mode : Onsite

Duration: 6 months


About Udaan Udaan is Myntra’s initiative specifically designed to offer a career launchpad to People With Disabilities. It is a six-month paid program that ensures a conducive environment facilitating a smooth inclusive transition to work. With structured onboarding, customized learning and development programs, mentorship opportunities, on-the-job learning, and best-in-class benefits, we aim to provide an environment that is supportive, so that you can thrive and build your career with us.As a part of our commitment towards diversity and inclusion, through this program, we strive to create a culture where all can belong and bring their experiences and authentic selves to work every day.


During this 6-month program with us, you will get the opportunity to work with the best talent in the e-commerce industry and work on projects that match your interests, abilities, and could lead to full-time employment with Myntra.Udaan 3.0 is a testament to the program’s success in the previous years. It is the strong foundation of inclusive commitment and empowerment that Myntra holds which has enabled this program to return and grow stronger each time. With every batch, Udaan continues to reinforce Myntra’s vision of building a workplace where everyone can thrive, contribute meaningfully, and shape their careers with confidence.


About Role

We are looking for an enthusiastic and detail-oriented Entry-Level Data Analyst to join our activations team. This is an exciting opportunity for someone looking to develop their career in data analytics, working with SQL, Excel, and business insights to drive decision-making and support business operations. You will be responsible for analyzing data, generating reports, and providing actionable insights to stakeholders.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Data Collection & Analysis: Use SQL to query, clean, and analyze large datasets to identify trends, patterns, and key insights.

  • Reporting & Dashboarding: Create and maintain Excel-based reports and dashboards that summarize key business metrics and performance indicators.

  • Business Insights: Collaborate with business teams to understand their data needs and provide actionable insights that drive business decisions.

  • Data Quality Assurance: Ensure the accuracy and completeness of data by performing data validation and quality checks.

  • Support Business Teams: Provide ad-hoc data analysis support to various business units as needed.

Requirements:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Computer Science, Statistics, or a related field.

  • Technical Skills:

    • Proficiency in SQL for querying databases and retrieving data.

    • Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Excel, including pivot tables, VLOOKUP, data analysis tools, and formula creation.

  • Analytical Skills: Strong problem-solving skills with an ability to analyze and interpret data and provide meaningful insights.

  • Business Acumen: Understanding of business operations and ability to translate data findings into actionable business recommendations.

About the role

transIT Connect is an Australian transport management SaaS platform. We are looking for a Product Support Analyst who can become a strong internal product expert and support customer onboarding, user training, support tickets, data preparation and knowledge base updates.

This role will support the Australian customer-facing team and work closely with product, QA and development. You will learn the transIT Connect platform deeply and help customers and internal teams use it properly.

This is a good role for someone with SaaS support, product support, customer onboarding, technical support or B2B application support experience.

Responsibilities

  • Learn the transIT Connect product in detail across web and mobile workflows
  • Handle support tickets, user queries and product questions
  • Assist with customer onboarding tasks and go-live preparation
  • Prepare and clean customer data for import
  • Support demo environment setup and sample data preparation
  • Help run virtual user training sessions where required
  • Create and update knowledge base articles, user guides and FAQs
  • Reproduce customer issues and document them clearly for QA/dev teams
  • Track onboarding tasks and customer support follow-ups
  • Support release notes, product updates and internal training material
  • Work with the Australian customer lead to prepare for demos, training and onboarding calls

  • 3–5 years in SaaS product support, application support, customer support or customer onboarding
  • Experience supporting business software users
  • Experience working with Australian, UK or US customers
  • Strong written and spoken English
  • Comfortable joining customer calls when required
  • Good spreadsheet skills for data cleanup and import preparation
  • Ability to understand workflows and explain steps clearly
  • Experience using ticketing tools, Trello/Jira, CRM or helpdesk systems

Good to have

  • Experience with logistics, transport, fleet management or ERP software
  • Experience creating knowledge base articles or user guides
  • Basic understanding of software QA or bug reporting

Work Location: In person

  • Identify opportunities for process optimization and automation of KPI reporting.
  • Support management reviews by preparing comprehensive Business reports and performance scorecards.
  • Living Hitachi Energy’s core values of safety and integrity, taking responsibility for actions while caring for colleagues and the business.

Your Background:

  • BE / B.Tech in Engineering, Data Analytics, or related discipline with 4-8 years of relevant experience in business KPI management or performance analytics.
  • 4-8 years of experience in KPI reporting, business performance tracking, or data analytics with exposure to engineering or manufacturing environments.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Power BI for KPI visualization and performance dashboards
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms, especially Microsoft Azure , for data integration, storage, and analytics use cases.
  • Experience with test automation frameworks and tools for validating data pipelines, dashboards, or KPI reporting systems.
  • Advanced proficiency in SQL for data extraction and transformation; experience with DAX and data modeling.
  • Good understanding of business performance metrics (engineering productivity, project efficiency, cost optimization, etc.).
  • Knowledge of Python/R, forecasting methods, or statistical techniques for trend and variance analysis.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms such as Azure for accessing and managing data sources.
  • Ability to collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to define and refine KPI frameworks aligned with business goals.
  • Excellent presentation and communication skills to convey KPI insights to engineering leaders and management.
  • Proven capability to manage end-to-end KPI lifecycles from data preparation and standardization to reporting and continuous improvement.

  • Expert in KPI Design and Measurement: Skilled in defining, developing, and tracking key performance indicators to assess operational efficiency and business impact.

  • Analytical Agility & Business Acumen: Combines strong analytical skills with strategic thinking to drive informed decisions and enhance business outcomes.
  • Experience as a Data Analyst in a manufacturing environment is plus.
  • B.Tech in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering is plus.

Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.

We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!

Job Description

DataAnalyst (Data model experience)

Job Description

The Data Analyst will partner with business stakeholders to understand and align business strategies and requirements with organizational priorities. The role requires strong collaboration with both business and technology teams to translate high-level business requirements into clear functional, non-functional, and data requirements.

A key focus of this role is to design and build data models from scratch , ensuring that business requirements are accurately converted into scalable and efficient data structures. The candidate will be responsible for defining data models (fact/dimension, star/snowflake schemas), establishing relationships, and enabling high-quality data solutions for downstream consumption.

The individual will work closely with design and development teams to ensure these data models are effectively implemented into technical solutions that meet business needs. Strong expertise in data modeling and SQL is mandatory , while visualization skills are considered secondary.

Your Responsibilities

  • Gather and validate business, technology, and data requirements to define scope, success criteria, and key metrics
  • Translate business requirements into data modeling requirements, including entities, relationships, and data structures
  • Design and build logical and physical data models from scratch (fact/dimension, star/snowflake schemas)
  • Define data granularity, hierarchies, and semantic layers to support analytics and reporting needs
  • Work closely with business stakeholders and architects to ensure data models align with enterprise data architecture
  • Ensure data quality, consistency, and governance, including metadata definition and approval
  • Review and optimize data models for performance, scalability, and maintainability
  • Support production issues by analyzing data/model design gaps and providing improvements
  • Lead discussions with stakeholders to align data model design with 3–6 month business priorities
  • Collaborate across teams to identify dependencies and ensure smooth delivery of data solutions
  • Use modeling and prototyping tools (Power BI or others) only to validate data models and business logic (not as primary responsibility)

The Essentials – You Will Have

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Management Information Systems, or a related field
  • Proven experience in designing and developing logical and physical data models (fact/dimension, star/snowflake schemas)
  • Strong experience building data models from scratch (requirement analysis to implementation)
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills

Must Have Skills

  • Strong hands-on experience in data modeling (design + build from scratch)
  • Expertise in SQL
  • Deep understanding of:
    • Fact & Dimension modeling
    • Star vs Snowflake schema
    • Data warehousing concepts

The Preferred – You Might Also Have

  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Experience translating business requirements into data models and technical solutions
  • Ability to work across cross-functional teams and challenge design decisions
  • Understanding of system design, architecture standards, and data security principles
  • Experience with Analytics & Data platforms such as:
    • Azure SQL DW, AAS, Power BI
    • Python, ADF, ADLS Gen2
  • Domain knowledge in Finance processes (GL, Cost Center, Profitability)
  • Exposure to SAP systems (ECC, CRM, Hybris)
  • Knowledge of planning applications (Hyperion, Enterprise Planning Management)

    Important Note :
  • Candidates with only visualization / Power BI experience without core data modeling design should not be considered
  • SQL + Data Modeling is mandatory (others are optional)

What We Offer:

Our benefits package includes …

  • Comprehensive mindfulness programs with a premium membership to Calm
  • Volunteer Paid Time off available after 6 months of employment for eligible employees.
  • Company volunteer and donation matching programs – Your volunteer hours or personal cash donations to an eligible charity can be matched with a charitable donation.
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Personalised wellbeing programmes through our OnTrack programme
  • On-demand digital course library for professional development... and other local benefits!

At Rockwell Automation we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this or other roles. Rockwell Automation's hybrid policy aligns that employees are expected to work at a Rockwell location at least Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays unless they have a business obligation out of the office.

Working with Us
Challenging. Meaningful. Life-changing. Those aren’t words that are usually associated with a job. But working at Bristol Myers Squibb is anything but usual. Here, uniquely interesting work happens every day, in every department. From optimizing a production line to the latest breakthroughs in cell therapy, this is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it. You’ll get the chance to grow and thrive through opportunities uncommon in scale and scope, alongside high-achieving teams. Take your career farther than you thought possible.

Bristol Myers Squibb recognizes the importance of balance and flexibility in our work environment. We offer a wide variety of competitive benefits, services and programs that provide our employees with the resources to pursue their goals, both at work and in their personal lives. Read more: careers.bms.com/working-with-us.

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Own and maintain business rules for commercial and digital datasets, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and alignment with organizational data standards
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including data engineering, forecasting, and therapeutic area stakeholders to understand business requirements and support the design of data and analytics solutions
  • Support the design and development of new data products from scratch, enabling scalable and reusable solutions across the Commercialization
  • Support identification, evaluation, and onboarding of US commercial and healthcare datasets (e.g., claims, sales, payer datasets).
  • Apply SQL, Python, and analytical techniques to explore pharma datasets, support use case development, generate insights, and develop and maintain dashboards and reporting solutions (e.g., Power BI, Tableau) for brand performance tracking and analytics delivery.
  • Collaborate with data ingestion and engineering teams to ensure proper integration of datasets (e.g., IQVIA, Symphony), including basic data validation and quality checks.
  • Support automation and innovation efforts by leveraging scalable frameworks and GenAI tools to improve efficiency in analytics delivery.
  • Support data governance responsibilities across commercialization and digital datasets, including documentation, stewardship, and compliance
  • Contribute to enterprise data migration efforts to the Databricks platform, supporting UAT activities and validating business rules post-migration

Skills and Competencies

  • Strong understanding of healthcare and US commercial data sources (e.g., claims, sales, payer datasets) and their application in analytics use cases
  • Proficiency in data pre-processing, cleaning and transformation techniques to ensure data quality and compatibility for analysis
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with ability to derive meaningful insights from complex datasets
  • Solid communication and presentation skills to effectively convey complex concepts and findings
  • Ability to work collaboratively in cross-functional teams and manage multiple projects simultaneously
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy in data analysis and interpretation

Experience

  • A Bachelor's or Master's degree (preferred) in a relevant field, such as Data Science, AI, Engineering or a related discipline
  • 1–2 years of experience in a Data Analyst or similar role, preferably in healthcare, pharma, or related industry.
  • Exposure to US commercial real‑world data such as prescriptions, claims, or sales datasets. Good analytical and problem-solving skills with ability to analyze data and support actionable insights.
  • Proficiency in SQL required & working knowledge basic Python for data extraction and analysis.
  • Exposure to BI tools such as Power BI or Tableau for creating reports and dashboards.
  • Hands on experience with data platforms such as Databricks, Redshift, or Snowflake is a plus.

If you come across a role that intrigues you but doesn’t perfectly line up with your resume, we encourage you to apply anyway. You could be one step away from work that will transform your life and career.

Uniquely Interesting Work, Life-changing Careers
With a single vision as inspiring as “Transforming patients’ lives through science™ ”, every BMS employee plays an integral role in work that goes far beyond ordinary. Each of us is empowered to apply our individual talents and unique perspectives in a supportive culture, promoting global participation in clinical trials, while our shared values of passion, innovation, urgency, accountability, inclusion and integrity bring out the highest potential of each of our colleagues.

On-site Protocol

BMS has an occupancy structure that determines where an employee is required to conduct their work. This structure includes site-essential, site-by-design, field-based and remote-by-design jobs. The occupancy type that you are assigned is determined by the nature and responsibilities of your role:

Site-essential roles require 100% of shifts onsite at your assigned facility. Site-by-design roles may be eligible for a hybrid work model with at least 50% onsite at your assigned facility. For these roles, onsite presence is considered an essential job function and is critical to collaboration, innovation, productivity, and a positive Company culture. For field-based and remote-by-design roles the ability to physically travel to visit customers, patients or business partners and to attend meetings on behalf of BMS as directed is an essential job function.

Supporting People with Disabilities

BMS is dedicated to ensuring that people with disabilities can excel through a transparent recruitment process, reasonable workplace accommodations/adjustments and ongoing support in their roles. Applicants can request a reasonable workplace accommodation/adjustment prior to accepting a job offer. If you require reasonable accommodations/adjustments in completing this application, or in any part of the recruitment process, direct your inquiries to adastaffingsupport@bms.com. Visit careers.bms.com/eeo-accessibility to access our complete Equal Employment Opportunity statement.

Candidate Rights

BMS will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, pursuant to applicable laws in your area.

If you live in or expect to work from Los Angeles County if hired for this position, please visit this page for important additional information: https://careers.bms.com/california-residents/

Data Protection

We will never request payments, financial information, or social security numbers during our application or recruitment process. Learn more about protecting yourself at https://careers.bms.com/fraud-protection.

Any data processed in connection with role applications will be treated in accordance with applicable data privacy policies and regulations.

If you believe that the job posting is missing information required by local law or incorrect in any way, please contact BMS at TAEnablement@bms.com. Please provide the Job Title and Requisition number so we can review. Communications related to your application should not be sent to this email and you will not receive a response. Open Secret is an Indian healthy-snacking and packaged-food brand founded in 2019 by Ahana Gautam and Udit Kejriwal. Headquartered in Mumbai, the company aims to “un-junk” popular snacks by offering products made without maida, palm oil, artificial colors, or artificial flavors. Its product range includes cookies, chocolates, chips, nuts, cereals, spreads, and protein products.

Job Description

1. Factory Performance Analysis

  • Analyze daily, weekly, and monthly production data.
  • Track and report key manufacturing KPIs such as:
  • Productivity %
  • OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness)
  • Line Efficiency
  • Capacity Utilization
  • Throughput
  • Downtime Analysis
  • Labor Productivity
  • Identify production bottlenecks and recommend improvement opportunities.
  • Prepare factory performance dashboards and management reports.

2. Contract Manufacturer (CM) Performance Monitoring

  • Track production performance across all contract manufacturing partners.
  • Monitor:
  • Output vs Plan
  • Yield %
  • Material Consumption
  • Wastage & Losses
  • Rework & Rejections
  • Customer Complaints
  • Service Levels
  • Compare CM performance and benchmark best-performing facilities.
  • Highlight operational risks and improvement opportunities.

3. Productivity & Manpower Analytics

  • Analyze operator-wise and supervisor-wise productivity.
  • Monitor attendance, absenteeism, and manpower utilization.
  • Develop manpower planning and productivity improvement reports.
  • Identify root causes of low productivity and recommend corrective actions.

4. Inventory & Material Analysis

  • Track RM, PM, WIP, and FG inventory movement.
  • Analyze inventory accuracy and stock variances.
  • Monitor material consumption against BOM standards.
  • Identify excess consumption and wastage trends.

5. Quality & Loss Analysis

  • Analyze quality complaints, defects, and rejection trends.
  • Conduct RCA (Root Cause Analysis) using data.
  • Track COPQ (Cost of Poor Quality).
  • Support quality improvement initiatives through data-driven insights.

6. Dashboard & Reporting

  • Develop and maintain:
  • Power BI Dashboards
  • Excel KPI Dashboards
  • Automated Reports
  • Management MIS
  • Present findings to factory management and leadership teams.
  • Create real-time reporting systems for production and CM performance.

7. Continuous Improvement

  • Support Lean Manufacturing and Operational Excellence initiatives.
  • Identify cost-saving opportunities through data analysis.
  • Build predictive models for production planning and capacity utilization.
  • Drive process standardization across manufacturing locations.

Key KPIs

  • Factory Productivity %
  • Line Efficiency
  • OEE
  • Production Attainment %
  • Capacity Utilization %
  • Yield %
  • Rejection %
  • Rework %
  • Material Loss %
  • Labor Productivity
  • Inventory Accuracy
  • Contract Manufacturer Performance Scorecard
  • Cost Savings Generated Through Analytics

Pay: ₹60,000.00 - ₹70,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

Job Summary
We are seeking a highly skilled Data Analyst to join our team. The successful candidate will be responsible for analysing complex data sets, developing insightful visualisations, and supporting strategic decision-making processes. This role offers an excellent opportunity to utilise advanced data analysis skills and contribute to the optimisation of business operations through innovative solutions. The ideal applicant will have experience with a variety of data tools and methodologies, including Tableau, Power BI, SQL, and programming languages such as R and Python. This is a paid position suitable for both experienced professionals and interns seeking to develop their expertise in data analytics.

Responsibilities

  • Analyse large datasets to identify trends, patterns, and insights that support business objectives.
  • Develop and maintain interactive dashboards and visualisations using Tableau and Power BI.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather requirements and translate them into effective data solutions.
  • Design and optimise database schemas using Oracle, Microsoft SQL Server, and other relational database systems.
  • Write complex SQL queries to extract, manipulate, and analyse data efficiently.
  • Utilise programming languages such as R, Python, VBA, and Bash (Unix shell) for data processing and automation tasks.
  • Support project management activities by contributing to the SDLC (Software Development Life Cycle) processes.
  • Conduct business analysis to determine data needs and recommend improvements for existing systems.
  • Create detailed documentation using Visio for system architecture, workflows, and processes.
  • Assist in database design projects ensuring data integrity, security, and performance optimisation.

Requirements

  • Proven experience with data analysis tools including Tableau, Power BI, R, Python, VBA, and Bash (Unix shell).
  • Strong understanding of SQL databases such as Oracle, Microsoft SQL Server, with the ability to write advanced queries.
  • Knowledge of database design principles and optimisation techniques.
  • Familiarity with SDLC methodologies and project management practices.
  • Excellent analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex data sets accurately.

Job description

This role is based in India and as such all normal working days must be carried out in India.

Join us as a Data & Analytics Analyst

  • Take on a new challenge in Data & Analytics and help us shape the future of our business
  • You'll be helping to manage the analysis of complex data to identify business issues and opportunities, and supporting the delivery of high quality business solutions
  • We're committed to mapping a career path that works for you, with a focus on helping you build new skills and engage with the latest ideas and technologies in data analytics
  • We're offering this role at associate level

What you'll do

As a Data & Analytics Analyst, you'll be planning and providing high quality analytical input to support the development and implementation of innovative processes and problem resolution. You'll be capturing, validating and documenting business and data requirements, making sure they are in line with key strategic principles.

We'll look to you to interrogate, interpret and visualise large volumes of data to identify, support and challenge business opportunities and identify solutions.

You'll also be:

  • Performing data extraction, storage, manipulation, processing and analysis
  • Conducting and supporting options analysis, identifying the most appropriate solution
  • Helping to maintain full traceability and linkage of business requirements of analytics outputs
  • Seeking opportunities to challenge and improve current business processes, ensuring the best result for the customer
  • Creating and executing quality assurance at various stages of the project in order to validate the analysis and to ensure data quality, identify data inconsistencies, and resolve as needed

The skills you'll need

You'll need a background in business analysis tools and techniques, along with the ability to influence through communications tailored to a specific audience. Additionally, you'll need the ability to use core technical skills.

You'll also demonstrate:

  • Strong analytic and problem solving abilities
  • A keen eye for detail in your work
  • Strong hands-on experience with Snowflake, including:
    • Designing and querying data models
    • Writing efficient SQL for data extraction, transformation and analysis
    • Working with Snowflake features such as warehouses, stages, and data sharing
  • Solid proficiency in Python for data analysis and automation, including:
    • Use of libraries such as Pandas, NumPy and Requests
    • Writing clean, reusable scripts for data processing and transformation
  • Experience working in an Agile environment
  • Knowledge of APIs and data integration techniques
