We are seeking a Business Intelligence & Analytics Engineer to join our Business Intelligence team. This role partners closely with Finance and cross-functional teams to build and maintain the data infrastructure, pipelines, and reporting layer that power financial planning, forecasting, and performance management. The ideal candidate is comfortable working across the full data stack—from ingestion and transformation to visualization—and brings strong analytical judgment alongside technical depth.

Job Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines using Fivetran to ingest data from Salesforce, ERP, and other business systems into Snowflake.

  • Own the data transformation layer between raw ingested sources and analytics-ready datasets, ensuring models are clean, tested, documented, and aligned to Finance and GTM reporting needs.

  • Build and maintain Tableau dashboards and reporting assets to track key financial and go-to-market metrics, including pipeline coverage, ARR/NRR, revenue retention, quota attainment, and other GTM activities.

  • Partner with Finance and cross-functional stakeholders to translate business questions into data models, metrics definitions, and dashboard solutions.

  • Validate data accuracy and reconcile financial and operational metrics across source systems (CRM, ERP, and other systems of record) and the Snowflake data warehouse.

  • Manage data warehouse objects in Snowflake, including schema design, virtual warehouse configuration, role-based access controls, and query optimization.

  • Define and enforce KPI definitions, data source documentation, and metric governance to drive consistent reporting across Finance and GTM teams.

  • Analyze customer, revenue, and product usage data to surface trends related to growth, churn, expansion, pricing, and performance.

  • Continuously improve analytics workflows, documentation standards, and self-service reporting capabilities to scale insight delivery across the organization.

Job Qualification

  • 4–7 years of experience in analytics engineering, business intelligence, or a related data role.

  • Hands-on experience with Snowflake and Fivetran in a production environment.

  • Strong SQL skills for querying, joining, and transforming structured data across complex schemas.

  • Experience building and maintaining Tableau dashboards and data sources.

  • Familiarity with CRM data structures, particularly Salesforce objects and reporting.

  • Experience working cross-functionally with Finance, Ops, or GTM teams to support data and reporting needs.

  • Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative, technical, or business fields (e.g., Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science, Data Science, Business Analytics). Master’s degree preferred.

Technical Skills

  • Snowflake: schema design, virtual warehouse management, RBAC, query optimization, and cost monitoring.

  • Fivetran: connector configuration, sync scheduling, schema change handling, and MAR management.

  • Tableau: advanced dashboard design, calculated fields, LOD expressions, data source management, and Tableau Server/Cloud publishing.

  • SQL: advanced querying across Snowflake; window functions, CTEs, and performance tuning.

  • Salesforce: familiarity with standard and custom objects, SFDC data exports, and CRM reporting structures.

  • Git: version control for analytics codebases.

  • Python (preferred) for data analysis, automation, and supplemental data processing tasks.

Analytical & Business Acumen

  • Solid understanding of SaaS business metrics (ARR, NRR, churn, pipeline coverage, quota attainment) and how they flow through financial and GTM reporting.

  • Ability to integrate, clean, and analyze data from disparate source systems into a coherent, governed data model.

  • Skilled in translating complex data into clear narratives, actionable insights, and strategic recommendations for Finance and executive audiences.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Digital Finance Business Analyst

Location: Hyderabad

About the Role

The Digital Finance Business Analyst supports the development and delivery of data and analytics products within the Digital Finance team, part of FP&A. The role exists to enable standardized, data‑driven finance processes across Lonza’s global CDMO sites by driving the digitalization of Finance. Acting as a bridge between finance teams and technical systems, this role designs and delivers Power BI solutions using SAP ERP Finance and Controlling (FICO) data to support site‑level financial operations, performance management, and decision‑making.

What We Offer

  • An agile and dynamic working environment within a global life sciences leader
  • The opportunity to contribute to global Finance digitalization initiatives across multiple CDMO sites
  • Hands‑on exposure to SAP ERP Finance (FI/CO) and Microsoft Power Platform solutions
  • A collaborative, inclusive, and ethical workplace culture
  • Competitive compensation and benefits aligned with experience
  • Opportunities for professional growth through global and cross‑functional collaboration

Key Responsibilities

  • Collaborate closely with site finance teams, controllers, and global process owners to gather reporting requirements and translate them into intuitive Power BI solutions
  • Design and develop interactive Power BI dashboards and reports focused on site finance operations, cost management, and performance tracking
  • Build and maintain robust data models and analytical solutions using data sourced from SAP ERP FI and CO modules
  • Translate complex financial data into clear, actionable insights for non‑financial stakeholders
  • Automate repetitive finance processes using Power Automate, improving efficiency and reducing manual effort
  • Support finance users by providing training, documentation, and ongoing assistance to maximize report adoption and data literacy
  • Ensure data accuracy and integrity by validating underlying SAP data and report logic
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of digital finance solutions, standards, and best practices

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related discipline
  • Proven experience in finance analytics, reporting, or business analysis roles
  • Strong exposure to enterprise finance systems and data‑driven decision support

Skills & Technical Expertise

  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Power BI, including DAX, data modeling, and report publishing
  • Deep understanding of SAP ERP Finance and Controlling (FI/CO) processes and underlying SAP table structures
  • Solid knowledge of financial principles, including budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis
  • Excellent analytical and problem‑solving skills with strong attention to detail
  • Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to business and finance users
  • Experience with SQL, advanced Excel, and other analytical tools is an advantage
  • Familiarity with Agile or Scrum methodologies is desirable

About Lonza

At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With more than 30 sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to enable the manufacture of life‑saving medicines. Our core values—Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion, and Integrity—reflect how we work and succeed together.

Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives. Lonza is committed to fostering an inclusive environment where diverse perspectives drive innovation and where every employee can make a meaningful impact.

Role Summary

We are seeking a motivated, experienced Senior Data Analyst who will lead analytics efforts around Oncology patient journey, line of therapy (LoT) and structured claims/patient data.

The successful candidate will transform large claims datasets into insights that shape strategic decisions for our clients.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and execute analytics projects focused on patient-journey and line-of-therapy mapping, Brand analytics.
  • Analyze structured claims and patient datasets such as DRG, IQVIA, McKesson, Symphony claims.
  • Conduct exploratory data analysis (EDA) to assess treatment patterns, pathways and utilization.
  • Support HEOR/HCRU analyses including prevalence, burden, incidence and cost-of-illness studies.
  • Develop and present client-facing insights using dashboards, PowerPoint and visual analytics.
  • Build and optimise SQL queries, pipelines; use Excel and Python for automation and analysis.
  • Collaborate with HEOR, market-access, strategy and engineering teams. Ability to gather requirements, articulate approach, timeline and execution with key stakeholders are of equal importance.
  • Ensure data integrity, governance, documentation and reproducibility.
  • Independently manage workload, communicate progress and drive project delivery.

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum 5 years' experience, with 3+ years in relevant analytics roles.
  • Bachelor's/Master's in Computer Science, Electronics, Pharmacy, Life Sciences, Data Science, Statistics or related field.
  • Prior Experience with structured datasets: DRG, Symphony, IQVIA, McKesson.
  • Strong proficiency in SQL, Python, Excel, PowerPoint.
  • Experience in Pharma/life-science consulting or analytics agencies.
  • Exposure to RWE sources including EHR/EMR, CMS datasets.
  • Understanding of LoT frameworks, treatment guidelines and market-access structures.

Preferred / Nice to Haves

  • Working knowledge of Python and visualisation tools (Power BI, Tableau).
  • understanding of data modeling and statistical techniques.
  • Client-facing experience with ability to translate analytics into business insights.
  • Therapy-area familiarity (oncology, immunology, rare diseases).
  • Experience conducting stakeholder workshops or building interactive dashboards.

Experience working with global teams and multi-geography datasets.

The Data Analyst is responsible for transforming data into actionable insights that support business decisions.

  • Identify data quality issues, reconcile discrepancies, and support data governance practices
  • Document data definitions, calculation logic, dashboard assumptions, and report usage guidance

  • Support ad hoc analysis and recurring reporting needs
  • Help standardize metrics and reporting conventions across the organization

  • Tableau dashboard development and visualization

About the Role

We are seeking a Data Analyst to join our Analytics & Digital Solutions (ADS) organization. In this role, you will lead initiatives that deliver scalable, action-oriented analytics solutions supporting Global Logistics function.

You will partner closely with Logistics and data engineering teams to co-create high-quality analytics products, support design reviews, and enable structured deployments. As a functional analyst, you will also drive adoption, change management, and sustained utilization of logistics analytics solutions. This role supports global and regional logistics operations by delivering data-driven insights and analytics products that improve process efficiency, service performance, cost optimization, and continuous improvement, with solutions designed to scale across regions where applicable.

What’s in it For You • The opportunity to take on some of the world’s most meaningful challenges, helping customers achieve clean water, safe food, abundant energy, and healthy environments • The ability to make an impact and shape your career with a company that is passionate about growth • The support of an organization that believes it is vital to include and engage diverse people, perspectives, and ideas to achieve our best • This is a fantastic opportunity to join a highly recognized global growth company offering competitive compensation and benefits in addition to career growth

Key Responsibilities:

  • Partner with Logistics leadership and regional teams to translate operational needs into analytics solutions
  • Collaborate with global and regional leaders to standardize and scale logistics analytics solutions
  • Act as a business process expert and contribute to knowledge management, documentation, and continuous improvement
  • Stay current on industry and analytics trends to identify opportunities for new technologies and practices
  • Act as the functional SME for logistics reporting and analytics tools, enabling faster insights and improved effectiveness
  • Support process efficiency, automation, and controls initiatives across logistics operations to improve operations.
  • Co-develop AI-ready analytical data models with data engineering and operations teams to enable action-oriented logistics insights
  • Design and deliver reporting for logistics KPIs, including transportation, service, cost, and execution performance
  • Ensure data availability, reliability, quality, validation, and reconciliation across all logistics analytics products
  • Lead design reviews, functional QA, and governance for dashboards, reports, and analytics solutions
  • Identify logistics and transportation process, service and cost improvement opportunities, including AI-enabled use cases
  • Ideate, prototype, and iterate solutions using analytical tools such as Power BI, python etc. balancing analytical rigor with usability
  • Plan and support analytics deployments, including documentation and delivery readiness

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, information systems, supply chain, or a related field
  • 3-5 years of experience in analytics, logistics, transportation, supply chain, or business process roles
  • Good SAP experience in Logistics function.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with strong attention to detail
  • Proficiency in Power BI and working knowledge of SQL, Python, Azure and Snowflake.
  • Strong communication, organization, and collaboration skills
  • Proven ability to drive change management and value realization through analytics solutions
  • Ability to manage multiple initiatives in a fast-paced environment
  • Experience working in Warehouse Management System (WMS) and Transportation Management System (TMS)
  • Working knowledge of ETL processes and data warehousing

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience working with SAP logistics, transportation and warehousing.
  • Experience working with Transportation management systems such as Blue Yonder, Mercury Gate etc will be added advantage.
  • Experience working with Warehouse management systems such as Körber etc will be added advantage.
  • Advanced degree or certification in supply chain, logistics, analytics, or computer science such as ASCM CLTD etc.

Syneos Health® is a leading fully-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.

Every day we perform better because of how we work together, as one team, each the best at what we do. We bring together talented experts across a broad spectrum of business critical corporate functions. Every role plays an essential part in enabling our customers to achieve their goals. Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:

Why Syneos Health
  • We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
  • We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.
  • We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.

Note: Shift timings- 2PM to 11PM IST

Responbilities:
 Assist in documenting functional requirements and supporting translation into system solutions
 Work with cross-functional stakeholders to understand and clarify business needs
 Support configuration and maintenance of enterprise systems and modules
 Assist with system integrations across clinical, finance, procurement, and other applications
 Support data migration activities, including validation and quality checks
 Generate basic reports and dashboards to support operational insights
 Assist in development of test scripts and support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and deployments
 Troubleshoot routine system issues and escalate complex problems as needed
 Maintain documentation including user guides and SOP-aligned materials
 Support identification of process improvement opportunities

 Bachelor’s degree in IT or related field
 0–2 years of experience in business analysis, product operations, or a related field.

 Domain Knowledge Lifesciences, Pharmaceuticals, Healthcare would be Plus.

 Exposure to AI Tools (preferred)
 Foundational understanding of the drug development lifecycle or regulated
environments (preferred)

 Basic knowledge of SQL or data querying concepts (PL/SQL exposure a plus)
 Familiarity with enterprise systems or cloud environments (e.g., Azure, Windows Servers, IIS) preferred
 U nderstanding of object-oriented programming concepts (preferred)
 Exposure to reporting or analytics tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau).


Core Skills
 Analytical thinking and problem-solving

 Strong written and verbal communication skills.
 Communication and collaboration
 Attention to detail and quality
 Process awareness and continuous improvement mindset
 Documentation and compliance discipline

Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.

description_html:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.

JLL Technologies is a tech-focused division of Jones Lang LaSalle, a world leader in real estate services and a Fortune 500 company.
As a Senior Data Analyst at JLL, you will play a direct role in shaping how one of Silicon Valley's largest technology companies makes strategic decisions about its global real estate portfolio.
At JLL, a Fortune 500 real estate services leader, we build dedicated analytics teams that work alongside our clients as trusted partners. As part of our Portfolio Insights team, you will be the primary data expert for client planners — owning the quality of production datasets, translating complex data findings into executive-ready insights, and building the reliable data foundations that drive strategic real estate decisions.
This is a client-facing role with significant impact you will work directly with planners, resolve real data challenges, and be the person the client turns to when quality and clarity matter most.
If this opportunity resonates with you, we encourage you to apply. At JLL, we know that great talent comes from many paths and we are always interested in people who are eager to grow and make an impact.

Responsibilities:
Serve as primary technical expert for client planners, building strong relationships to anticipate needs and provide strategic guidance for data solutions
Take full ownership of client presentations and reports, creating impactful visualizations with professional polish and meticulous attention to detail
Own data validation and quality assurance processes for key production datasets, proactively identifying root causes and implementing long-term solutions
Collaborate directly with data source owners, system, and process owners to identify and resolve limitations or friction points that impact planning support effectiveness
Support regional planners with any data, insights and ad hoc requests. Leverage best practice to ensure rapid delivery and maintain high data quality
Proactively identify and eliminate repetitive manual processes through automation or smarter tooling — building for long-term scalability
Implement best practices for knowledge transfer and documentation to achieve internal consistency and long-term scalability
Mentor and support junior analysts by providing guidance and promoting a culture of continuous learning and development

Minimum Requirements:
Strong analytical skills and an abundance of intellectual curiosity
Bachelor’s Degree in Math, Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, Engineering, or other quantitative field
5+ years data-focused experience: Professional experience in data-focused role with strong proficiency in SQL and Excel/Google Sheets
Proficient in SQL (any dialect)
Expertise with spreadsheet-based tools like Google Sheets or Excel
High-agency, self-starter mindset proactively identifying problems and driving solutions with strong ownership and bias toward action, even under deadline pressure
Exceptional communication skills: able to translate complex data findings into polished, visually compelling, executive-ready narratives for both technical and non-technical audiences.
Demonstrated experience with data validation and quality assurance methodologies.
Excellent attention to detail, exhibiting the highest standards of professional integrity and work ethic
Cultural sensitivity and flexibility in working hours to collaborate with a global team
Experience and comfort working remotely, with the ability to thrive under minimal supervision

Preferred Qualifications:
Corporate Real Estate knowledge
Familiarity with or eagerness to learn Google Cloud Platform (e.g., BigQuery, Cloud Storage, App Engine): enthusiasm for continuous technical upskilling valued.
Proficiency in or strong interest in developing Python skills for analytics and automation
If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!

Personalized benefits that support personal well-being and growth:

JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.

About JLL –

We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.

Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.

Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.

Own Every Moment at NetApp

At NetApp, your ideas power innovation. We lead in intelligent data infrastructure—delivering unified storage, integrated data services, and solutions that help organizations unlock the full potential of their data, from AI to multicloud.

Ready to innovate and contribute to our path to $10B? Here, you'll collaborate with passionate teams, tackle real-world challenges, and see your impact in how customers transform and grow. If you're ready to bring curiosity, creativity, and drive to every moment, NetApp is where your journey begins.


Job Summary

Supply Chain team at NetApp needs a business-savvy & innovative Analyst with advanced skills in developing Power BI Dashboards. We are also looking for advanced data management, visualization and analysis skills in Oracle PL/SQL and Microsoft Excel. The individual identified for this position will take ownership of developing Power BI dashboards along with data cleansing, transformation, and management, taking guidance from senior members of staff to assist Functional Stakeholder run the business activities. The individual chosen will work with a cross-functional team in close collaboration with the Supply Chain and IT organizations to manage Supply chain Planning, Inventory and Order Fulfillment Data
To be successful in this role, the ability to collaborate with various internal and external stakeholders will be critical. This position requires an individual who is creative, team-oriented, has ability to multi-task, a quick learner and driven to produce results. Additionally, this role will require attention to detail and the ability to handle large datasets.

Job Requirements

  • Hands on experience with Power Bi as a Developer. PL 300 certification preferred
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills; including the ability to author detailed process flow documentation.
  • Detail oriented with strong analytical, problem-solving, reporting, task, project management, and organizational skills.
  • Candidate should be keen on learning the latest trends in Gen AI and should have capability of building AI Agents.
  • Hands on experience on Power Query and Power Automate as well as use of gen AI for automating workflows.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment of other analysts and cross functional peers to achieve project deadlines, while handling multiple tasks concurrently
  • Ability to work with business stakeholders, IT, and the system integrator to ensure successful data transfer.
  • Ability to perform regular data quality audits and follow up with owners to improve and maintain data quality.
  • Advanced skills with Oracle PL/SQL queries and scripting is required
  • Advanced skills with MS Excel is required including formulas.
  • Ability to author macros using VBA or Office Script will be an added advantage
  • Familiarity with Oracle cloud ERP will be an added advantage
  • A good understanding of Manufacturing and Supply Chain related domains of knowledge is desirable
  • Knowledge of Agile development process and systems analysis, design, and requirements management
  • Basic to Intermediate software programming and/or scripting skill, including coding constructs and techniques.
  • Ability to multitask with shifts in priorities.
  • The ability to document and communicate status updates to team members and management.

Education & Experience

  • A master’s degree, or bachelor’s degree with equivalent experience is required.
  • A minimum of 6 years of work experience is required. 7 to 9 years of experience is preferred.

At NetApp, we embrace a hybrid working environment designed to strengthen connection, collaboration, and culture for all employees. This means that most roles will have some level of in-office and/or in-person expectations, which will be shared during the recruitment process.

Equal Opportunity Employer:

NetApp is firmly committed to Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) and to compliance with all federal, state and local laws that prohibit employment discrimination based on age, race, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, religion, disability or genetic information, pregnancy, protected veteran status, and any other protected classification.

Why You'll Thrive at NetApp

At NetApp, you won't wait for the perfect moment—you'll make it. The early planning, the extra thought, the bold idea that turns good into great: That's how our people operate and how we continue to push the boundaries of data infrastructure.

NetApp is the trusted partner for organizations transforming data into opportunity. As the only enterprise-grade storage service natively embedded in Google Cloud, AWS, and Microsoft Azure, we empower customers to run everything from traditional workloads to enterprise AI with unmatched performance, resilience, and security.

Our culture

We celebrate mold breakers, bold thinkers, and problem solvers. We reward initiative, impact, and ownership. We provide flexibility so you can balance professional ambition with your personal life. Here, differences are not just welcomed—they drive everything we do.

If you're ready to innovate, rise to the challenge, and own every moment - make your next move your best one. now.

description_html:
Keyloop bridges the gap between dealers, manufacturers, technology suppliers and car buyers.
We empower car dealers and manufacturers to fully embrace digital transformation. How? By creating innovative technology that makes selling cars better for our customers, and buying and owning cars better for theirs.
We use cutting-edge technology to link our clients’ systems, departments and sites. We provide an open technology platform that’s shaping the industry for the future. We use data to help clients become more efficient, increase profitability and give more customers an amazing experience. Want to be part of it?

This hands-on role focuses on building, managing, and evolving Power BI dashboards that inform operational and commercial decisions. You will lead the migration of existing Tableau dashboards to Power BI, ensuring like-for-like capability where appropriate and redesigning visualisations where Power BI offers a better approach. Working closely with the data warehouse team and business stakeholders, you will model data, write DAX, and implement best-practice governance so that reports are performant, trusted, and easy to use.

Skills & Experience

  • Essential:
  • 4–6 years of experience in BI development or data visualisation, including hands-on Power BI.
  • Proven ability to build and manage production-grade dashboards (requirements through to publishing and support).
  • Strong DAX and Power Query (M) skills; comfortable modelling data for analytics.
  • Solid SQL skills for querying data warehouse tables and views; familiarity with dimensional modelling.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management; able to explain technical trade-offs to non-technical audiences.
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret and present data in a clear, meaningful way.
  • Organised, detail‑oriented, and able to manage multiple tasks.
  • Desirable:
  • Experience migrating dashboards from Tableau to Power BI, including redesign where features differ.
  • Row-Level Security patterns and object-level security; familiarity with data governance.
  • Scripting with Python or R for data preparation and analysis

Key Attributes

  • Customer-focused mindset with a passion for improving user experience.
  • Collaborative and adaptable, able to work across diverse teams and time zones.
  • Ownership mentality with attention to detail and commitment to quality.
Why join us?
We’re on a journey to become market leaders in our space – and with that comes some incredible opportunities. Collaborate and learn from industry experts from all over the globe. Work with game-changing products and services. Get the training and support you need to try new things, adapt to quick changes and explore different paths. Join Keyloop and progress your career, your way.
An inclusive environment to thrive
We’re committed to fostering an inclusive work environment. One that respects all dimensions of diversity. We promote an inclusive culture within our business, and we celebrate different employees and lifestyles – not just on key days, but every day.
Be rewarded for your efforts
We believe people should be paid based on their performance so our pay and benefits reflect this and are designed to attract the very best talent. We encourage everyone in our organisation to explore opportunities which enable them to grow their career through investment in their development but equally by working in a culture which fosters support and unbridled collaboration.
Keyloop doesn’t require academic qualifications for this position. We select based on experience and potential, not credentials.
We are also an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce. We value diversity and encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply.
"At Keyloop, AI is a daily ally: We encourage and train every employee to use our AI tools to boost their creativity and productivity."
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

SENIOR DATA ANALYST

Apply Now

COUNTRY
Europe
FORMAT
Remote

Svitla Systems Inc. is looking for a Senior Data Analyst for a full-time position (40 hours per week) in Europe. Our client runs an television network everages various data and tech to enable targeting messaging.

This role sits at the intersection of data, advertising measurement, sales, product, and client strategy. The work transforms large-scale mobile location signals, advertising campaign delivery data, and audience data, purchasing data, and third-party measurement sources into clear, actionable business intelligence for major brands, agencies, and strategic partners. The position will play a critical role in building and supporting a proactive advertising campaign analytics program, including in-flight campaign performance analysis, post-campaign reporting, audience insights, optimization recommendations, upsell opportunities, and long-term customer growth strategies. The ideal candidate is strong in SQL, comfortable working with large and complex datasets, and able to translate campaign performance data into a clear business narrative for internal teams and client-facing use. The role will also require modern analytics practices, including the effective use of GenAI tools, custom prompts, automated workflows, and AI-assisted analysis to improve speed, quality, consistency, and scalability across recurring reporting and campaign insight generation.


REQUIREMENTS:

  • 5+ years of experience as a Senior Data Analyst, Data Analyst, Advertising Analyst, Campaign Analyst, Marketing Analyst, Measurement Analyst, Quantitative Analyst, or comparable role.
  • Degree in an analytical field such as Mathematics, Economics, Statistics, Engineering, Physics, Computer Science, Data Science, Linguistics, or a related discipline.
  • Advanced knowledge of SQL, including complex joins, aggregations, window functions, data validation, and performance-aware querying against large datasets.
  • Strong experience with advertising campaign analysis, media analytics, audience analytics, campaign performance reporting, or marketing measurement.
  • Understanding of large datasets and cloud-based data environments, ideally AWS, Redshift, Snowflake, BigQuery, or similar platforms.
  • Working knowledge of Python or R for data analysis, automation, statistical analysis, or reporting workflows.
  • Experience with BI and data visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, Looker, Qlik, Adobe Analytics, or similar platforms.
  • Familiarity with advertising measurement, media planning, campaign performance reporting, attribution, reach/frequency analysis, audience segmentation, and marketing effectiveness concepts.
  • Experience with Nielsen, NMI, MRI-Simmons, iSpot, or comparable media/audience Measurement platforms is strongly preferred.
  • Experience with geospatial analysis, spatial data, location-based datasets, or mobility data is highly desirable.
  • Solid foundational knowledge of descriptive statistics, predictive statistics, data modeling, and analytical quality control.
  • Proficiency with Unix commands, regular expressions, and repeatable data workflows.
  • Practical experience using GenAI tools for analytics, prompt development, QA, documentation, workflow automation, and business reporting is highly desirable.
  • Strong ability to analyze advertising campaign data and turn it into a clear, communicable business value proposition.
  • Proven track record of investigative analysis, including getting to the root cause of hard data and campaign performance questions.
  • Strong attention to accuracy, methodology, and data integrity, with the pragmatism to deliver high-quality work on business timelines.
  • Ability to connect campaign analytics to revenue outcomes, client retention, campaign optimization, upsell opportunities, and sales enablement.
  • Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain complex analysis to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Self-motivated, proactive, flexible, and comfortable working in a fast-moving environment.
  • Critical thinker who can challenge assumptions, identify better approaches, and recommend practical next steps.
  • Strong interest in using modern AI-enabled tools to improve analytical productivity, reporting consistency, and campaign insight generation.
  • Be comfortable working with imperfect data, asking the right questions, validating outputs, and helping sales and leadership understand what campaign performance means and what action should follow.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Build clear, accurate, and business-relevant reports, dashboards, and data visualizations for advertising campaign performance, audience delivery, inventory, and measurement analysis.
  • Move from raw campaign logs to business insight, from
  • audience and delivery data to client-ready narratives, and from one-off campaign reports to scalable always-on analytics programs.
  • Support an always-on advertising campaign analytics program, including in-flight pacing insights, optimization opportunities, post-campaign wrap reports, and recommendations for renewals.

As the recognized global standard for project-based businesses, Deltek delivers software and information solutions to help organizations achieve their purpose. Our market leadership stems from the work of our diverse employees who are united by a passion for learning, growing and making a difference. At Deltek, we take immense pride in creating a balanced, values-driven environment, where every employee feels included and empowered to do their best work. Our employees put our core values into action daily, creating a one-of-a-kind culture that has been recognized globally. Thanks to our incredible team, Deltek has been named one of America's Best Midsize Employers by Forbes, a Best Place to Work by Glassdoor, a Top Workplace by The Washington Post and a Best Place to Work in Asia by World HRD Congress. www.deltek.com

Position Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain logical and physical data models, database designs, and master data standards that ensure data is structured for efficient use across operational and analytical consumers.
  • Build and maintain a unified, authoritative source of truth for master data entities by designing governed hub structures, defining survivorship rules, and resolving cross-system discrepancies to eliminate data silos.
  • Operationalize critical data elements (CDEs) and product taxonomy by defining attribute-level rules, classification hierarchies, and standardized value sets that ensure consistent field usage across models, pipelines, and reporting layers.
  • Design and maintain master data processes—including canonical schemas, API contracts, and ETL/ELT pipeline specifications—that support both real-time operational workflows and batch analytics consumption.
  • Maintain a single trusted view of master data—including golden record definitions, match-merge rules, and certified entity attributes—to support reliable decision-making and business growth.
  • Diagnose data-related issues—including referential integrity failures, schema drift, duplicate entity proliferation, and null/inconsistency patterns—and recommend targeted solutions to improve data integrity, security, and usability.
  • Maintain lineage documentation connecting raw source fields to governed definitions and downstream model consumption; version-control data dictionaries and field-level mapping documents.
  • Support data migration and system transition initiatives by assessing legacy data structures, identifying quality gaps, and mapping source fields to target canonical models.
  • Work closely with data engineering, data architecture, analytics, and product teams to align master data standards, embed requirements early in the development cycle, and deliver consistent data outputs across all team boundaries.
  • Run focused working sessions with EDI leads and subject-matter experts to gather data requirements, validate field definitions, and resolve conflicting interpretations across systems.
  • Share clear, concise updates on data model progress, field classification status, and domain coverage with both technical teammates and non-technical stakeholders to maintain shared understanding and trust in data assets.

Success Metrics

  • Unified source of truth established for master data domains—validated through reduction in duplicate entity records, survivorship rule coverage, and cross-system discrepancy rate.
  • CDE and product taxonomy operationalization: critical data elements and product taxonomy classifications defined, documented, and embedded in at least one active data model or pipeline within the first two quarters.
    • Model enablement velocity: data model requirements documentation delivered on time to unblock
  • 1 downstream model update per quarter, with no rework cycles caused by incomplete or inaccurate field definitions.
  • Cross-team effectiveness: positive feedback from data engineering, analytics, and product teammates on the clarity of data requirements, responsiveness in working sessions, and usefulness of delivered documentation.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Data Modeling: Expert command of logical and physical data modeling, including dimensional modeling (star/snowflake schemas), Data Vault, and canonical model design—with hands-on experience building and maintaining models in enterprise data environments.
  • SQL Proficiency: Expert-level SQL for interrogating complex multi-schema environments, profiling data quality, and validating model outputs.
  • Integration & Pipeline Design: Working knowledge of ETL/ELT pipeline design, API contracts, and canonical schema patterns that bridge operational workflows and analytics consumption.
  • Data Diagnostics: Ability to identify and resolve data integrity issues—including referential integrity failures, schema drift, duplicate proliferation, and null patterns—and recommend targeted solutions.
  • Graph-Based Lineage: Exposure to graph-based lineage tools for tracing field-level data flow from source systems through to model outputs.
  • Cloud Platforms: Working knowledge of Snowflake or Google BigQuery and their native capabilities for metadata management, data sharing, and schema governance.
  • Documentation: Ability to author clear data requirement specifications, field-level mapping documents, data dictionaries, and lineage documentation for both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Experience: 5+ years in data engineering, data modeling, or master data management roles within enterprise data environments.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Data Engineering, or a related technical field.

Discover your future at Citi

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of more than 230,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

Job Overview

The MIS Analyst is a developing professional role responsible for supporting business reporting, management information systems (MIS), data analytics, and performance reporting activities. The role requires a strong understanding of reporting processes, data management, and visualization tools to support business decision-making. The candidate should possess analytical capabilities and be proficient in creating, maintaining, and automating reports and dashboards using tools such as Power BI, Tableau, and MS Office Suite.

The individual will work closely with stakeholders across operations, business, and support functions to gather reporting requirements, analyze data, and deliver meaningful insights. They will be expected to make evaluative judgments based on data analysis, identify trends, and contribute to process improvement initiatives. The role has a direct impact on business performance through the quality, accuracy, and timeliness of reporting services provided.

Responsibilities

  • Prepare, maintain, and automate Management Information System (MIS) reports to support business decision-making and operational efficiency.
  • Develop, enhance, and maintain dashboards and visualizations using Power BI, Tableau, and other reporting tools.
  • Perform data extraction, validation, reconciliation, and analysis to ensure data accuracy and integrity across reports.
  • Create periodic and ad-hoc reports, scorecards, performance metrics, and executive dashboards for stakeholders.
  • Work closely with business users to understand reporting requirements and translate them into meaningful analytical solutions.
  • Analyze reporting trends, identify insights, and provide recommendations to support business objectives.
  • Support report migration, dashboard enhancements, reporting automation, and process improvement initiatives.
  • Ensure compliance with reporting controls, governance standards, and data quality requirements.
  • Utilize advanced features of MS Excel including Pivot Tables, Power Query, Power Pivot, Lookups, and data modeling for reporting and analysis.
  • Prepare presentations and management updates using PowerPoint and maintain reporting documentation using the broader Microsoft Office Suite.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Operations, Technology, Risk, and Business stakeholders to deliver reporting solutions.
  • Perform user acceptance testing (UAT) for reporting changes, enhancements, and dashboard implementations.
  • Resolve reporting issues through root cause analysis and recommend appropriate solutions.
  • Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, ensuring adherence to policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements.

Qualifications

  • 5–8 years of experience in MIS Reporting, Business Reporting, Data Analytics, or Management Information Systems.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Power BI, Tableau, and reporting/dashboard development.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and strong working knowledge of the MS Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook).
  • Experience in data analysis, report automation, data validation, and reporting governance.
  • Understanding of data visualization best practices and KPI/dashboard design.
  • Experience with reporting tools, databases, and data management processes is preferred.
  • Knowledge of AI-enabled productivity and analytics tools is an added advantage.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to present data insights to diverse audiences.

Education

  • Bachelor's/University degree in Business Administration, Finance, Statistics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience will also be considered.

Preferred Skills

  • Power BI Dashboard Development
  • Tableau Reporting & Visualization
  • Advanced MS Excel
  • MIS Reporting & Reporting Automation
  • Data Analytics & Data Validation
  • KPI & Performance Reporting
  • Power Query / Power Pivot
  • Presentation & Stakeholder Management
  • Process Improvement & Reporting Controls
  • Microsoft Office Suite Expertise

  • Implement reusable ingestion patterns and transformation templates aligned with enterprise architecture standards
  • Ensure compliance with enterprise metadata management, monitoring, and operational standards

  • Implement schema evolution, partitioning strategies, and version control for large datasets
  • Optimize data lake storage structures in Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS)
  • Develop scalable pipelines using Databricks notebooks, jobs, and clusters
  • Manage dataset governance and access controls using Unity Catalog
  • Optimize Spark performance through partitioning, caching, and cluster tuning
  • Develop and schedule ETL pipelines using Apache Airflow
  • Implement dependency management, monitoring, alerting, and failure recovery mechanisms

  • Optimize transformations and data loading using Snowflake SQL and staging techniques

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

Job Summary

To maintain customer data files in the ordering system

What You Will Do:

  • Developing detailed solutions to solve business problems
  • Input data into the customer data files, making changes to existing data and monitoring the accuracy of all data in files.
  • Participate the evaluation and deployment of new technologies to add or enhance existing digital technical capabilities.
  • Participating in addressing business requirements for applications and collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver solutions that meets business results

Degree Requirement

B.E. / B. Tech in IT, CS, or related engineering discipline (2025 or 2026 graduates)

What You Have:

Customer Focus: Knowledge of the values and practices that align customer needs and satisfaction as primary considerations in all business decisions and ability to leverage that information in creating customized customer solutions.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Communicates the importance of customer needs/expectations and commits to resolving them.
  • Researches and verifies customer needs and expectations.
  • Solicits customer satisfaction feedback and acts on improvement opportunities.
  • Helps link organizational objectives to customer needs and expectations.
  • Meets regularly with customers to understand their wants, needs and expectations.

Data Gathering & Analysis: Knowledge of data gathering and analysis tools, techniques, and processes; ability to collect and synthesize data from a variety of stakeholders and sources in an objective manner to reach a conclusion, goal, or judgment.

Level Basic Understanding:

  • Describes alternative data-gathering techniques and tools.
  • Documents basic data-gathering methodologies.
  • Identifies the purposes of data gathering and analysis.
  • Identifies key objectives in gathering and analyzing data.

Data-driven Decision Making: Knowledge of the data-driven decision-making process and associated tools and techniques; ability to gather and analyze data to make organizational decisions that align with strategic business objectives and goals.

Level Basic Understanding:

  • Describes major considerations and issues in the use of data-driven decision making.
  • Differentiates Data-driven decision making from traditional decision making.
  • Explains characteristics and steps in an effective Data-driven Decision-Making process.
  • Identifies key objectives in gathering and analyzing data.

Analytical Thinking: Knowledge of techniques and tools that promote effective analysis; ability to determine the root cause of organizational problems and create alternative solutions that resolve these problems.

Level Basic Understanding:

  • Names specific tools or techniques that can be used to support the analytical thinking process.
  • Describes specific software applications or products used for business analytics.
  • Gives examples of how analytical thinking has been used to resolve problems.
  • Helps others research and learn more about business analytics tools and applications.

Effective Communications: Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Delivers helpful feedback that focuses on behaviors without offending the recipient.
  • Listens to feedback without defensiveness and uses it for own communication effectiveness.
  • Makes oral presentations and writes reports needed for own work.
  • Avoids technical jargon when inappropriate.
  • Looks for and considers non-verbal cues from individuals and groups.

Data Architecture: Knowledge of processes, techniques and factors that affect data architecture; ability to design blueprints on how to integrate data resources for business processes and functional support.

Level Basic Understanding:

  • Identifies the processes, standards and principles of data architecture.
  • Discusses the techniques and tools used in building and designing data architecture.
  • Describes any constraints or influencing factors that effect data architecture design.
  • Lists the elements of data architecture (e.g. administrative structure, data store methodologies).

Requirements Analysis: Knowledge of tools, methods, and techniques of requirement analysis; ability to elicit, analyze and record required business functionality and non-functionality requirements to ensure the success of a system or software development project.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Follows policies, practices and standards for determining functional and informational requirements.
  • Confirms deliverables associated with requirements analysis.
  • Communicates with customers and users to elicit and gather client requirements.
  • Participates in the preparation of detailed documentation and requirements.
  • Utilizes specific organizational methods, tools and techniques for requirements analysis.

What You Will Get:

Our goal at Caterpillar is for you to have a rewarding career. Our teams are critical to the success of our customers who build a better world. Here you earn more than just wage, because we value your performance, we offer a total rewards package that provides day one benefits along with the potential of a variable bonus. Additional benefits include paid annual leave, flexi leave, medical and insurance (prorated based upon hire date).

Please frequently check the email associated with your application, including the junk/spam folder, as this is the primary correspondence method. If you wish to know the status of your application – please use the candidate log-in on our career website as it will reflect any updates to your status.

If you are interested in joining our team, please apply using an English version of your CV. We look forward to meeting you!

description_html:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all .

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.

The Data Analyst supports Global Procurement by enabling trusted, standardized, and AI ‑ ready procurement data that drives productivity, business value, and transformation outcomes. This role plays a hands ‑ on, execution ‑ focused part in operationalizing data governance, improving master data quality, and enabling consistent KPI and program reporting across GP.

The analyst connects day ‑ to ‑ day data governance and stewardship activities to measurable procurement outcomes , reducing manual effort, improving decision quality, and accelerating adoption of analytics, automation, and AI capabilities.

This is not an IT or Business Intelligence role. The analyst partners closely with GP business teams, Master Data, Analytics, AI, and IT functions to align with enterprise data standards, controls, and approved platforms.

GP KPIs, Metrics & Program Reporting

  • Support GP KPI frameworks by ensuring metric definitions, data sources, and calculations are clearly defined, standardized, and auditable.

  • Enable consistent, trusted program and transformation reporting by improving data reliability and transparency.

  • Partner with GP program owners to align reporting needs with governed data sources and approved definitions.

Data Governance & Quality Operations

  • Execute day-to-day procurement data governance activities, including stewardship support, data quality monitoring, issue intake, and remediation tracking.

  • Support the procurement data stewardship operating model, including routines, escalation paths, and documentation.

  • Define and maintain governance artifacts such as business glossaries, critical data elements, and business rules for key procurement datasets.

  • Track and report data quality KPIs (e.g., completeness, accuracy, duplication, timeliness) and support root cause analysis with data and process owners.

Procurement Master Data Management

  • Perform hands-on procurement master data clean up and standardization activities (supplier, category, material, contract, and reference data).

  • Coordinate with Master Data and process owners to resolve data quality issues at the source and prevent recurrence.

  • Support continuous improvement of master data processes and controls.

AI R eady Procurement Data Enablement

  • Contribute to procurement master data strategy required to enable AI, automation, and advanced analytics use cases.

  • Partner with analytics and AI teams to translate use case requirements into actionable data governance and data quality improvements.

  • E nsure procurement data is structured, labeled, and governed to be AI ready , with clear ownership, definitions, and quality thresholds .

Cross Functional Collaboration

  • Act as a liaison between GP business teams, Analytics, AI, Master Data, and IT for data related topics.

  • Support alignment between procurement specific needs and enterprise data governance standards.

Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science , Information Systems, Data Analytics, or related field required .

  • Advanced degree or certification in data management, analytics, or governance is a plus.

  • Practical experience with cloud data platforms (e.g., Snowflake) is required .

Experience

  • Min 3– 4 years of experience in data quality, analytics, or reporting roles.

  • Hands‑on experience with master data management and data quality operations, preferably in Procurement or Supply Chain domains.

  • Basic knowledge of any Business Intell igence tools for Reporting such as Tableau/ Power BI is a plus

  • Experience supporting KPI frameworks, metrics definition, and program reporting.

  • Exposure to AI, advanced analytics, or data readiness initiatives is strongly preferred.

Skills & Attributes

  • Strong analytical mindset with high attention to detail and data accuracy.

  • Working knowledge of data governance concepts including stewardship, ownership, critical data elements, and quality metrics.

  • Ability to translate business questions into clear data definitions and measurable metrics.

  • Comfortable working cross ‑ functionally and influencing without direct authority.

  • Clear communicator with the ability to document standards, definitions, and processes.

  • Understanding how data quality and standardization enable automation, analytics, and AI outcomes.

What Success Looks Like

  • Trusted and reliable procurement data and KPIs used for decision ‑ making and program reviews.

  • Data quality issues are visible, prioritized, and systematically reduced over time.

  • Procurement master data is standardized and governed, reducing manual effort and reporting friction.

  • Data governance and master data improvements demonstrably increase GP productivity and accelerate AI and automation adoption.

About Micron Technology, Inc.

We are an industry leader in innovative memory and storage solutions transforming how the world uses information to enrich life for all . With a relentless focus on our customers, technology leadership, and manufacturing and operational excellence, Micron delivers a rich portfolio of high-performance DRAM, NAND, and NOR memory and storage products through our Micron® and Crucial® brands. Every day, the innovations that our people create fuel the data economy, enabling advances in artificial intelligence and 5G applications that unleash opportunities — from the data center to the intelligent edge and across the client and mobile user experience.

To learn more, please visit micron.com/careers

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

To request assistance with the application process and/or for reasonable accommodations, please contact hrsupport_india@micron.com

Micron Prohibits the use of child labor and complies with all applicable laws, rules, regulations, and other international and industry labor standards.

Micron does not charge candidates any recruitment fees or unlawfully collect any other payment from candidates as consideration for their employment with Micron.

AI alert : Candidates are encouraged to use AI tools to enhance their resume and/or application materials. However, all information provided must be accurate and reflect the candidate's true skills and experiences. Misuse of AI to fabricate or misrepresent qualifications will result in immediate disqualification.

Fraud alert: Micron advises job seekers to be cautious of unsolicited job offers and to verify the authenticity of any communication claiming to be from Micron by checking the official Micron careers website in the About Micron Technology, Inc.

About TE Connectivity & the Channel BU

TE Connectivity is a global technology leader that designs and manufactures connectivity and sensor solutions, serving industries that are transforming the future. The Channel Business Unit (CBU) manages TE's global distribution network and plays a critical role in driving growth, enhancing customer experience, and enabling commercial excellence across 300+ distributor partners worldwide. Channel BU brings together Sales Enablement, Marketing, Pricing, Customer Service, Digital, and PMO functions to accelerate revenue, deliver digitally enabled experiences, and achieve above-market growth.


Role Definition

We are seeking a skilled and motivated Senior BI Analyst to join our India-based analytics team supporting the Channel Business Unit. This individual contributor role will focus on designing, developing, and maintaining high-quality Power BI dashboards, executive reporting solutions, self-service BI assets, and business insight products that help Channel BU leaders and functional teams make faster, more informed decisions.

The ideal candidate brings strong hands-on experience in Power BI dashboard development, DAX, data visualization, business analysis, stakeholder engagement, and data storytelling. This role requires someone who can work with curated data assets, primarily from the Databricks platform, and translate business needs into intuitive, accurate, and scalable reporting solutions.

In the near term, this role may also support select Tableau reporting and dashboard needs while helping the organization continue its transition toward Power BI and Databricks-enabled analytics. While this is not a data engineering or AI role, the Senior BI Analyst should be comfortable working with curated datasets, performing basic SQL querying, validating data, and partnering with data engineering and analytics teams to ensure business reporting is trusted, consistent, and actionable.

This role also includes informal leadership responsibilities, including coaching junior analysts, sharing dashboard development best practices, supporting peer reviews, and helping raise the overall quality and consistency of BI delivery across the team.

Based in Bangalore, India, this role will report to the India-based Data Analytics & Data Science Delivery Manager and partner closely with the NA-based Data & Analytics Product Owner, Channel BU leadership, global DIA teams, and cross-functional stakeholders across AMER, EMEA, and APAC regions.

Tasks and Responsibilities

Power BI Development & Reporting

  • Design, develop, and maintain Power BI dashboards, KPI scorecards, and self-service reporting solutions supporting Sales, Marketing, Pricing, Customer Care, Digital, Strategy, and Leadership teams.
  • Build intuitive, visually compelling reports using DAX, calculated measures, filters, and best-practice data visualization principles.
  • Optimize dashboard usability, performance, and user experience while supporting recurring business and leadership reviews.

Business Insights & Data Storytelling

  • Partner with stakeholders to understand business needs and translate data into actionable insights and recommendations.
  • Develop executive-ready reporting and visualizations that clearly communicate trends, performance drivers, risks, and opportunities.
  • Support KPI definition, reporting standards, and consistent business interpretation across functions.

Tableau Support & Reporting Transition

  • Maintain and enhance existing Tableau reports while supporting migration and redesign opportunities into Power BI.
  • Ensure continuity, consistency, and quality of reporting during reporting platform transitions.

Stakeholder Management & Delivery

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather requirements, define reporting solutions, and prioritize BI initiatives.
  • Lead stakeholder discussions, validate outputs, present insights, and drive adoption of analytics solutions.
  • Manage multiple projects independently while communicating progress, risks, and dependencies.

Leadership & Team Development

  • Mentor junior analysts on Power BI, DAX, visualization, stakeholder engagement, and analytics best practices.
  • Promote reporting standards, reusable frameworks, documentation, and continuous improvement.
  • Contribute to a collaborative, insight-driven culture focused on business impact and trusted analytics.

What your background should look like

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Analytics, Information Systems, Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Finance, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field.
  • 5–8 years of progressive experience in business intelligence, data analytics, reporting, dashboard development, or related analytics roles.
  • Strong hands-on experience developing dashboards and reports in Power BI.
  • Strong working knowledge of DAX for creating measures, calculated logic, and analytical reporting views.
  • Strong data visualization skills, including the ability to design clear, intuitive, and business-friendly dashboards.
  • Experience translating business requirements into dashboard designs, reporting logic, and actionable insights.
  • Ability to work with curated datasets from enterprise data platforms such as Databricks.
  • Basic SQL querying skills for data exploration, validation, and reporting support.
  • Experience creating executive dashboards, KPI scorecards, self-service BI reports, and business performance reporting.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to explain data, insights, and dashboard functionality to business stakeholders.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities independently and deliver high-quality work with minimal supervision.

JOLLY CLAMPS PVT. LTD.

Manufacturers of Steel Clamps & Couplings

JOB DESCRIPTION

Position

Automation & Data Analyst (Manufacturing Operations)

Department

Automation & Systems

Location

Goregaon (Head Office) + Virar (Factory) — travel between both required

Experience

1–2 years

Reports To

Chief Financial Officer (CFO)

Employment

Full-time, on-site

About the Role

Jolly Clamps Pvt. Ltd. (JCPL) is building in-house capability to automate its manufacturing operations and bring its inventory, work-in-progress (WIP) and costing data under tight, reliable control. This is a hands-on role for someone in their career who wants to excel in how a real manufacturing business runs and turn its day-to-day data into dependable dashboards, reports and small applications.

You will work closely with the Chief Financial Officer (CFO), the operations and information technology (IT) teams, and the shop floor across both the Goregaon head office and the Virar factory. Full training and mentoring will be provided; what matters most is a genuine appetite to learn, attention to detail, and comfort working with data.

Core principles you will be trained to follow:

  • rely on a single, agreed source of data rather than scattered reports;
  • use clear, deterministic (rule-based) computation that anyone can audit, with no guesswork;
  • always validate a solution on one test case before scaling it across the plant.

Key Responsibilities

Under the guidance of the CFO and senior team members, you will support, build and maintain the following. You are not expected to do all of this on day one — you will be brought up to speed project by project.

Production Planning & Control (PPC) — Python-based Planning Solutions

A central part of the role is helping build and run a suite of Python-based tools that turn the monthly Sales forecast into a realistic, committed production plan. Working with the planning and operations teams, you will support:

  • Planning engine (demand to commitment): Build and maintain the monthly planning engine that converts the Sales forecast (received item-wise and family-wise from the enterprise resource planning system) into a deliverable commitment, running demand against line capacity, manpower and material limits to produce the family-wise quantity committed to Sales.
  • Forecast cleanup & common-part master: Automate cleanup and filtration of the location-wise forecast by grouping stock-keeping units (SKUs) that share a common internal part code into a single common part, replacing the manual pivot; create and maintain the master that maps customer and location SKUs to the common-part code.
  • Capacity, manpower & occupancy model: Automate the family-wise line-capacity and manpower model to compute shift-wise occupancy percentage, flag demand exceeding both shifts as over-capacity, and base commitments on current manpower, allowing for the recruitment lead time.
  • Economic batch quantity batching: Hold the economic batch quantity (EBQ) per item as a clean master and build batching logic that defaults to it, quantifying the efficiency loss when priority orders break the batch and trigger extra changeovers.
  • Make-to-stock stock-level prioritisation: Automate the colour-coded make-to-stock , stock-level sheet and auto-sequence production so the most critical parts are made first, replacing the heavy manual spreadsheet.
  • Trading-conversion & excess-production traceability: Build logic that traces production booked against a common part, the trading-conversion transfers to individual customer codes and the residual balance, so excess production is attributed to the Sales order that drove it and made visible to Sales.
  • Demand cadence by customer type: Encode the differing demand cadences by customer type (aftermarket weekly; regular original-equipment-manufacturer customers on a weekly cycle; trigger-based customers daily) into the plan, along with the buffer and overtime catch-up mechanism used to meet the required daily rate.
  • Material requirement planning: Extend the planning engine to derive raw-material and child-part requirements from the committed family and item plan and batch quantities, so procurement is driven by the confirmed plan and checked against stock and open purchase orders.

Data Reconciliation & Control Reports (rule-based, auditable)

  • Daily inventory reconciliation reports (opening stock plus purchases, less consumption, equals closing stock; and finished goods produced versus dispatched).
  • Material-balance checks that reconcile input against output, scrap and work-in-progress (WIP) movement, allowing for normal process weight and measurement tolerances.
  • Consumption-based costing reports that value material on actual usage rather than purchases, organised by cost centre.
  • Reclassification of items between make-to-stock and make-to-order based on demand trends.
  • Exception and error-tracking reports that flag wrong, reversed, delayed or duplicate transactions, along with their likely cause.
  • Threshold-based monitoring (for example, inventory or work-in-progress above an agreed reference level) with automatic alert notifications.

Workflow Automation

  • Help set up the scheduled extraction of system reports, with automatic pickup and processing into daily reconciliations.
  • Support automated report extraction through application programming interfaces (API) feeding business intelligence (BI) dashboards.
  • Assist in consolidating overlapping automation tools onto a single, governed workflow platform.

Data-Capture Applications & Dashboards

  • Support data-capture applications that record activity at source (plan versus actual, productivity, adherence), with a database behind them and a link to the enterprise resource planning (ERP) system.
  • Help deploy point-of-source data capture using fixed screens or tablets feeding a central database and live dashboards.

System Controls (with the IT team)

  • Help implement controls that prevent item, grade or master-data mismatch, with daily exception reporting.
  • Support duplicate-entry prevention using unique transaction identifiers and a holding area for failed entries.
  • Assist in evaluating a warehouse management system (WMS) and its integration with the ERP.

General

  • Validate every report and tool against real data before it is relied upon.
  • Document what you build so others can understand and maintain it.
  • Coordinate with stores, shop-floor, accounts and IT colleagues to keep data accurate and on time.

Skills & Knowledge

Essential (foundational level is acceptable for a fresher)

  • Python,N8N,Replit,Cursor,Java : Working knowledge of Python,N8N,Replit,Cursor,Java for data handling, building planning and reconciliation logic, and simple automation.
  • Data / spreadsheets: Comfort with spreadsheets, formulas and structured data; willingness to learn Power Query and business intelligence (BI) tools such as Power BI.
  • Databases: Basic understanding of databases and the ability to write simple structured query language (SQL) queries.
  • Logic & accuracy: Strong attention to detail and a logical, methodical approach to problem-solving.
  • Communication: Clear written and spoken communication, able to explain a number or a report simply.

Desirable (a plus, not required — training will be given)

  • Automation tools: Exposure to a workflow automation platform (for example, low-code or no-code tools).
  • App building: Any experience building small web pages, dashboards or applications.
  • ERP / systems: Familiarity with an enterprise resource planning (ERP) system or how factory data is recorded.
  • Programming: Basic Java or any second programming language.
  • Domain interest: Curiosity about manufacturing, production planning, inventory, costing and operations.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, engineering, data, commerce or a related field; or equivalent demonstrated ability.
  • Graduates with relevant projects, internships or self-built work (for example, dashboards, small applications or automations) are encouraged to apply.
  • Practical evidence of your work — a portfolio, project links or samples — is valued alongside formal qualifications.

What the Role Offers

  • Direct mentoring from the Chief Financial Officer (CFO) and senior operations and finance leaders.
  • Real ownership of meaningful projects on a live factory floor, not theoretical exercises.
  • Broad exposure across finance, operations, inventory, costing and information technology in one role.
  • A clear path to grow into a specialist automation, data or systems position as you develop.

Please mention your willingness to travel between the Goregaon office and the Virar factory.

Pay: ₹400,000.00 - ₹700,000.00 per year

Benefits:

  • Paid sick time
  • Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

Threshold-based monitoring (for example, inventory or work-in-progress above an agreed reference level) with automatic alert notifications.
