Discover your future at Citi

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of more than 230,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

Job Overview

The Spec Analytics Intmd Analyst is a developing professional role. Deals with most problems independently and has some latitude to solve complex problems. Integrates in-depth specialty area knowledge with a solid understanding of industry standards and practices. Good understanding of how the team and area integrate with others in accomplishing the objectives of the sub function/ job family. Applies analytical thinking and knowledge of data analysis tools and methodologies. Requires attention to detail when making judgments and recommendations based on the analysis of factual information. Typically deals with variable issues with potentially broader business impact. Applies professional judgment when interpreting data and results. Breaks down information in a systematic and communicable manner. Developed communication and diplomacy skills are required in order to exchange potentially complex/sensitive information. Moderate but direct impact through close contact with the businesses' core activities. Quality and timeliness of service provided will affect the effectiveness of own team and other closely related teams.

Citi is evolving its current commerce offerings and branching into new avenues of growth. By combining Citi’s scale, trusted customer relationships, and real purchase insights, the business delivers advertising that is relevant to customers and drives measurable, incremental impact for advertisers. This role will leverage data-driven insights to optimize targeting and personalization, enhance customer engagement, and identify new growth opportunities. The successful candidate will be working hands-on as a part of a team or function focused on in-depth analysis of 1st, 2nd and 3rd party data and underlying customer behaviors as well as advertiser preferences to develop audiences, hands-on as a part of a team or function focused on in-depth analysis of campaign performance for commerce media ads and offers and their impact on underlying customer behaviors and development of attribution models and frameworks to deliver detailed insights to advertisers. This position requires a deep understanding of the commerce media business, digital ecosystem, strong analytical capabilities.

Qualifications: Preferred - Master's degree in a quantitative field, Business Analytics, or an MBA with a strong analytical focus

Experience: 4 to 7 years (preferably 5 years+)

Relevant experience: Audience related Analytics for 3 years+

Expertise:

  • Commerce Media Domain Expertise: Deep understanding of the commerce or retail media landscape, including measurement capabilities, revenue streams, data strategy and commercialization strategy.
  • Digital Media and Marketing Expertise: Deep understanding of digital media and marketing ecosystem, including various marketing channels, media buy models, Familiarity with advertising or campaign performance data, ideally across ad servers, web analytics, or DSPs. Knowledge of key digital marketing KPIs (ROAS, Impressions, CTR, CPA etc.)
  • Advanced Analytics Skills: Proficiency in statistical analysis, predictive modeling, machine learning techniques, and experimental design (A/B testing). Familiarity with digital marketing principles such as attribution models (MMM, MTA), incrementality testing, AB testing. Proficiency in statistical analysis, predictive modeling, machine learning techniques, and experimental design (A/B testing). Experience building audience segments using 1P data, behavioral signals, and transaction data

Technical Proficiency:

  • Data Platforms:
    • Experience with large-scale data platforms and tools (e.g., Snowflake).
    • Experience working with first-party data and privacy-safe data environments (e.g., clean rooms, identity resolution)
    • Familiarity with advertising or campaign performance data, ideally across ad servers, web analytics, or DSPs.
  • AI/ML skills: Hands-on experience in attribution models and developing Gen AI solutions
  • Visualization Tools: Hands-on experience with business intelligence and data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, QlikView).

Preferred Skills:

  • Experience with programming: proficiency in SQL, Python, or R for data manipulation, statistical analysis, and model development.
  • Experience with consumer banking products and customer lifecycle analytics.

DESCRIPTION

Join Amazon's Prime Data Engineering & Analytics (PDEA) team as a Business Intelligence Engineer (BIE) to revolutionize how we understand, measure and serve our global Prime customer base. You'll architect and build enterprise-level data analytics solutions, including scalable ETL pipelines, automated AI powered reporting systems, and self-service analytics platforms that process petabytes of data daily across multiple dimensions. Working with technologies like AWS, Apache Kafka, Spark, and modern AI/ML tools, you'll create data analysis products that power critical decision-making across Amazon.

As a BIE, you'll be instrumental in defining and implementing key business metrics, building efficient dimensional data models, and leveraging advanced AI technologies like QuickSuite and ML-powered analytics. You'll design intuitive self-service platforms that enable business users to independently explore data, discover insights, and create automated reports. Beyond technical implementation, you'll lead end-to-end project execution, manage worldwide Prime core services data infrastructure, and establish key relationships across Amazon's business units. This role offers the opportunity to provide technical mentorship, drive architectural decisions, and shape the future of Amazon Prime's data ecosystem, directly impacting millions of customers globally.

Key job responsibilities
Responsibilities
1. Own design and execution of end to end projects
2. Own managing WW Prime data infrastructure
3. Establish key relationships which span Amazon business units and Business Intelligence teams
4. Implement standardized, automated operational and quality control processes to deliver accurate and timely data and reporting to meet or exceed SLAs

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

  • 1+ years of analyzing and interpreting data with Redshift, Oracle, NoSQL etc. experience
  • Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools
  • Experience with one or more industry analytics visualization tools (e.g. Excel, Tableau, QuickSight, MicroStrategy, PowerBI) and statistical methods (e.g. t-test, Chi-squared)
  • Experience with scripting language (e.g., Python, Java, or R)

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Master's degree, or Advanced technical degree
  • Knowledge of data modeling and data pipeline design
  • Experience with statistical analysis, co-relation analysis

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. As a Business Analyst, your role involves collaborating with various departments and stakeholders to gather, document, and analyze business requirements, processes, and workflows. You will then translate these requirements into functional specifications for technology teams. You will work closely with project managers, developers, and testers to ensure successful project delivery. Additionally, you will identify areas for process improvement and recommend solutions to enhance operational efficiency and effectiveness.

‍

  • Work closely with business stakeholders to understand their needs, objectives, and challenges.
  • Elicit, document, and analyze business requirements, processes, and workflows.
  • Translate business requirements into clear and concise functional specifications for technical teams.
  • Creation of Mockup Designs using Wireframes
  • Conduct Conceptual ideation & design sessions,
  • Gathering relevant data for the production of personas & scenarios, identifying potential user segments, Screen designs, clickable prototypes, and wireframe forms
  • Collaborate with technology teams to design solutions that meet business needs.
  • Propose innovative and practical solutions to address business challenges.
  • Ensure proposed solutions align with the organization's strategic goals and technological capabilities.
  • Make Data-driven Strategic Decisions
  • Identification of key data sources & liaising with Businesses for identification of KPI
  • Collaborating with Businesses for the Creation of Role Based Dashboards, drill down & slice/dice views
  • Getting World class Analytic Dashboards from UI designers. ‍

Mandatory Skills

  • Serve as a liaison between business stakeholders and technology teams.
  • Communicate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Present findings, recommendations, and project updates to various audiences
  • Create detailed documentation, including business requirements, process flows, use cases, and user stories.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date project documentation throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Collaborate with project managers to define project scope, objectives, and deliverables.
  • Assist in project planning, estimation, and resource allocation.
  • Monitor project progress and identify potential risks or deviations from the plan.
  • Participate in system testing, user acceptance testing, and validation of implemented solutions.
  • Ensure that delivered solutions meet the specified requirements and are of high quality Identify areas for process optimization and efficiency enhancement.
  • Recommend process improvements and assist in their implementation ‍

Desired skills

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities.
  • Proficiency in requirement-gathering techniques, process modeling, and documentation.
  • Familiarity with project management methodologies and software development lifecycle.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
  • Knowledge of relevant tools such as Microsoft Visio, JIRA, Confluence, etc. ‍

Agile: We thrive on change, adapting swiftly to new challenges.

Join us at Calpion and be part of a culture that's not just about work—it's about innovation, growth, and making an impact.

what you will do

  • measure feature and product impact across L0 (business outcomes), L1 (product flow), and L2 (feature-level micro-events) metrics post-launch, and feed structured inputs to the BI team for reporting
  • investigate questions about current users by slicing cohorts and user segments to answer "who is this user, what are they doing, and why" with data
  • track and analyse A/B experiments executed via ProductOps, report variant performance, and give PMs a clear, data-backed recommendation on whether to kill or scale
  • identify data gaps and outside-in signals, including share-of-wallet benchmarks from the analytics team, to surface areas of underperformance and opportunity for the PM to act on
  • ensure data is tagged and instrumented correctly ahead of every feature launch, work with engineering and ProductOps to confirm data readiness before go-live
  • own the measurement of conversion, TAT, and drop-off metrics across user journeys, and proactively flag anomalies before anyone asks
  • communicate findings clearly to PMs and cross-functional stakeholders, not just tables and charts, but a point of view on what the data means and what should happen next
  • use AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot) to accelerate your own analysis, summarising outputs, generating commentary on metric movements, classifying data at scale. spot opportunities where the AI or BI team could build something more permanent, and bring those requests forward

you should apply if you

  • are proficient in SQL you can write queries independently to extract, filter, aggregate, and join data without hand-holding
  • are comfortable in Python (pandas, numpy) for data cleaning, cohort analysis, and automating repetitive tasks in your own workflow
  • have strong excel skills pivot tables, vlookup/ index-match, and basic modelling are part of your daily workflow
  • can translate data into a clear point of view, you don’t just present numbers, you frame what they mean and what should happen next
  • communicate findings clearly to non-technical stakeholders you can walk a PM or business lead through an analysis without losing them in methodology
  • are comfortable with ambiguity: you can define the right question from a vague brief and structure your own analysis approach
  • hold a bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering, mathematics, statistics, economics, or a related quantitative field
  • have a basic understanding of A/B testing principles, what makes an experiment valid, what statistical significance means, and how to read results without over-claiming
  • are curious about using AI tools to work faster, you don’t need prior experience, but you should be someone who naturally asks “can I automate this?”
  • have exposure to fintech, lending, or BFSI products — familiarity with bureau flows, acquisition funnels, or collections will reduce your onboarding time significantly
  • understand how product events are instrumented, what data tagging means and what data readiness before a launch actually requires
  • have worked with competitive benchmarking or market-sizing exercises, share of wallet, category demand analysis, or similar outside-in research

About IntouchCX

IntouchCX is a global leader in digital customer experience management, back office processing, trust & safety solutions, and AI services. For over 25 years, we’ve scaled with soul, building trusted long-term partnerships and empowering our people to drive positive change.

About the Job
The MIS Analyst is an integral role within Global Service Desk and is responsible for the design, development, implementation and support of mission-critical enterprise Business Intelligence (BI) reports, G-Suite/Excel reports, and other tools working with cross-functional teams. This role is a part of Global Service Desk and supports in collecting and analyzing data sets using G Suite or Microsoft Excel
The ideal candidate will play an important role in helping the organization meet its strategic goals through providing direction and guidance concerning information processes and security of data.

As MIS Analyst, You Will…
  • Responsible for collecting and analyzing data sets using G-suite tools or Microsoft Excel
  • Proactively interact with multiple internal/external stakeholders on a daily, weekly and monthly basis for preparation of MIS reports
  • Understand process, delivery and operations management
  • Analyze data and reports from various sources and provide actionable insights and suggestions
  • Prepare ad hoc reports based on the requirements from the stakeholders
  • Apart from reporting tasks, the MIS Analyst will work with other functions to assist in maintaining the trackers to smoothen the reporting part
  • Identify opportunities for automating the reports, snapshots and dashboards
  • Make reports contextual and provide information based on target audience
  • Ensure on-time and accurate delivery of reports, analysis and service requests
  • Continually monitor trends, performance and assist managers in making process improvements
  • Be able to generate, maintain, consolidate and track various daily/weekly/monthly MIS reports
  • Ensure individual and process-wide performance data is captured and provide operational metrics to management as required
  • Prepare dashboard and reports on a daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly & yearly basis
As MIS Analyst, You Have…

  • Post-secondary diploma or degree (Masters is a plus)
  • Knowledge of data analytics and data modeling
  • Knowledge of VBA & SQL is required
  • Advanced G-Suite Excel skills, BI tools, creating formulas, vlook up, and dashboard reports
  • 3-5 years of MIS/Analysis/Dashboard building experience
  • Must have 3-6 years of reporting experience
  • Additional Tableau/BI certifications is a plus
  • Superior attention to detail and strong data orientation
  • Possess the ability to adapt well and learn new tools/ techniques quickly
  • Ability to work with a diverse range of requirements
  • Possess strong problem solving and reasoning abilities
  • Strong ability in automating repetitive tasks
  • Good logical reasoning with the ability to analyze and process large scale information
  • Exceptional communication skills (verbal and written) and decision-making abilities
  • Proven ability to quickly establish credibility, trust, and support within all levels of organization
  • Ability to plan, organize, and manage a variable workload and meet schedules with accurate results
  • Innovative thinker with ability to drive change and effectiveness through automation and process excellence
  • Ability to work well independently in a team environment, be self-motivated and multi task while achieving expectations
  • Availability to work night shifts to align with US or UK clients

Commercial Data Analyst
The Position
Are you driven by turning complex data into insights that shape commercial strategies and decision-making? Do you enjoy solving business challenges with data in a dynamic, collaborative environment?

We are looking for a Commercial Data Analyst to join our growing Master Data Management team in Chennai, India. In this role, you will support our commercial functions by managing, analyzing, and improving master and transactional data related to sales, customers, pricing, and market performance. Your insights will directly support improved commercial performance, customer experience, and business growth.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Commercial Data Support: Assist the Master Data Management (MDM) team in ensuring high data quality and consistency for key commercial data objects such as customers, pricing, and sales hierarchies.
  • Data Analysis & Insights: Analyze commercial data (e.g., sales performance, customer segmentation, pricing trends) to identify patterns, trends, and improvement opportunities.
  • Data Validation: Ensure completeness, accuracy, and consistency of commercial master data across systems.
  • Reporting: Develop and maintain dashboards and reports that provide actionable insights to stakeholders in sales, marketing, and business management.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with commercial teams, master data stewards, and data owners to understand data needs and ensure alignment on data structures and definitions.
  • Data Quality Management: Apply data profiling techniques to detect anomalies and support initiatives to improve and maintain data quality.
  • Documentation: Help define and maintain documentation of data definitions, processes, and standards for commercial data.
  • System Support: Support integration and consistency of commercial data across ERP, CRM, and analytics platforms.
  • Data Projects: Contribute to data migration, cleansing, and enrichment efforts in relation to commercial systems and reporting structures.

Qualifications
As a Commercial Data Analyst, you bring both analytical acumen and collaborative skills that help turn commercial data into business value.

Professional Skills:

  • 3+ years of experience working with data analysis in a commercial, sales, or marketing context.
  • Strong skills in data cleaning, analysis, and visualization of sales/customer-related data.
  • Proficiency in tools such as Excel, SQL, and BI platforms (e.g., Power BI, Tableau).
  • Experience with CRM and ERP systems (e.g. SAP ECC, SAP S4 Hana, C4C) is a strong advantage.
  • Understanding of commercial metrics and KPIs (e.g., revenue, margin, customer growth, pricing).
  • Experience working with master data domains like Customer, Pricing, and Product.
  • Good understanding of data quality principles and ability to identify and correct data issues.
  • Experience in supporting data consistency across platforms and contributing to system/data projects.

Personal Attributes:

  • Analytical and detail-oriented, with a keen eye for commercial patterns and data integrity.
  • Business-minded and able to translate data into actionable insights for commercial stakeholders.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills to partner effectively with sales and marketing teams.
  • Structured, self-driven, and able to manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proactive and curious, with a continuous improvement mindset.

We Offer

  • An exciting opportunity to shape commercial success through impactful data insights and quality management.
  • Collaboration with global commercial and data teams in a dynamic, cross-functional environment.

About NKT
NKT connects a greener world with high-quality power cable technology and takes centre stage as the world moves towards green energy. NKT designs, manufactures and installs low-, medium- and high-voltage power cable solutions enabling sustainable energy transmission. Since 1891, NKT has innovated the power cable technology building the infrastructure for the first light bulbs to the megawatts created by renewable energy today. NKT is headquartered in Denmark and employs 6,500 people. NKT is listed on Nasdaq Copenhagen and realised a revenue of EUR 3.6 billion in 2025. We connect a greener world. www.nkt.com

#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture

About this Role

We are seeking a Cyber Security Data & Reporting Analyst to enable data-driven, risk-based decision making across the cyber security landscape by defining, automating and maintaining accurate and reliable cyber KPI and KRI dashboards. This role is critical in providing consistent visibility of cyber risk posture and performance trends through high-quality data integration, automation and reporting. Working closely with multiple cyber security stakeholders, the role supports governance, prioritisation and assurance activities through timely reporting and trusted insights for senior management.

What you’ll do

We are seeking a Cyber Security Data & Reporting Analyst to enable data-driven, risk-based decision making across the cyber security landscape by defining, automating and maintaining accurate and reliable cyber KPI and KRI dashboards. This role is critical in providing consistent visibility of cyber risk posture and performance trends through high-quality data integration, automation and reporting. Working closely with multiple cyber security stakeholders, the role supports governance, prioritisation and assurance activities through timely reporting and trusted insights for senior management.

Who you are

  • You have a technical understanding of security KPIs and KRIs, with the ability to support trend analysis, forecasting and leadership decision making.
  • You have experience designing and implementing reporting metrics across complex and globally distributed organisations.
  • You are proactive, organised and able to work autonomously to strict deadlines with a high level of accountability.
  • You are able to make recommendations based on data and analysis, and communicate findings through clear, meaningful reporting.
  • You demonstrate sound judgement and decision-making skills, with a focus on continual improvement and process automation.
  • You have effective communication skills and can simplify complex information for different audiences and channels.
  • You have experience using Power BI, SAP tools, Qlik and Qlik Sense dashboards.
  • You bring strong business acumen with experience in telecommunications, technology or security environments.
  • You have experience in KPI/KRI reporting and business analyst roles.
  • You are educated to degree level.

Not a perfect fit?

Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.

What's in it for you

  • Opportunity to work on high-visibility cyber security reporting that supports risk-based decision making across the organisation.
  • Exposure to multiple cyber security platforms, data sources and stakeholder groups in a global environment.
  • A role that combines reporting, automation and analytics with meaningful impact on governance and assurance activities.
  • A collaborative environment where you can strengthen both technical reporting and stakeholder engagement capabilities.

What skills you will learn

  • Advanced cyber security KPI and KRI reporting and dashboard automation practices.
  • Stronger data integration and real-time analytics skills across multiple security platforms.
  • Enhanced capability in translating cyber risk data into clear management insights.
  • Deeper understanding of governance, assurance and performance reporting within a cyber security environment.

DESCRIPTION

Are you passionate about transforming operational processes through data-driven insights? Are you motivated to have a direct impact on customers around the world? Do you have a business analytics background and love for continuous improvement and finding creative solutions to challenging problems? Amazon's Translation Services team is responsible for providing translation tools and solutions to support the localization and translation needs of all Amazon businesses. At Translation Services Operations, we partner with other internal Amazonian teams to translate and deliver content for users of Amazon's tools and services around the world. We obsess over finding the optimal balance between quality, speed, and cost for customers we serve.
We are looking for an experienced Business Analyst to own end-to-end analytical work for our centralized metrics and reporting function — from understanding complex data dependencies to delivering actionable insights that drive business decisions. You will own problems from start to finish: partnering with business teams to understand their needs, building the reports and tools that surface meaningful patterns, and explaining the "why" behind the numbers. You will build dashboards, create new metrics, develop analytical frameworks, and leverage existing data sources to keep stakeholders informed and empowered. You will be comfortable working in an international, dynamic environment, where change is present as we constantly grow, improve, and innovate.

Key job responsibilities
  • Own and develop key operational metrics end-to-end — from understanding data sources and dependencies, to designing metric logic, building reporting solutions, and delivering insights that drive action
  • Partner hands-on with business teams (Operations, Quality, Business Development, Customer Success) to understand their data needs, translate them into structured analytical approaches, and deliver reporting that enables informed decision-making
  • Design, build, and maintain dashboards and reporting solutions that provide a single source of truth for organizational performance
  • Dive deep into data to identify patterns, trends, and root causes — then clearly communicate the "what," the "so what," and the "now what" to stakeholders and leadership
  • Proactively identify opportunities to leverage Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning (AI/ML) to optimize data insights generation, automate reporting workflows, and surface patterns at scale
  • Create new metrics, implement new measurement logics, and develop analytical tools that evolve with the business — ensuring our reporting capabilities stay ahead of organizational needs
  • Conduct root cause analyses on performance variations and develop scalable frameworks to monitor, explain, and improve business outcomes

A day in the life
In the morning, you'll review performance dashboards ahead of a business review, identifying any anomalies or trends that need attention — preparing clear narratives around the data to share with leadership. Mid-morning, you'll partner with an operations team to understand a new reporting need, mapping out data dependencies and designing the logic for a new metric they've requested — collaborating with data engineering teams to ensure the right data is available. After lunch, you'll dive into a dataset to investigate why a key performance indicator shifted month-over-month, slicing the data across multiple dimensions to isolate the driver and document your findings. Later, you'll work on building an automated reporting solution that replaces a manual process, leveraging AI capabilities to surface insights that would otherwise require hours of manual analysis. Throughout the day, you'll balance immediate stakeholder requests with longer-term projects that strengthen the organization's data foundation.

About the team
The Vendor Management & Data Insights (VMDI) team, within Translation Services Operations, consolidates vendor management operations with centralized reporting functions — including invoicing, pricing, and metrics — under one leadership. We are responsible for providing the data foundation that drives decision-making across the organization, while building and maintaining excellent relationships with external vendors to deliver results at scale for our customers. We collaborate closely with Quality and Content, Business Development, Customer Success, and Products teams to provide a seamless experience for both vendors and clients. We value a collaborative, inclusive, innovative, and data-driven culture as we work to optimize processes, improve quality, and drive cost efficiencies across Amazon's translation ecosystem.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent
  • 5+ years of Excel (including VBA, pivot tables, array functions, power pivots, etc.) and data visualization tools such as Tableau experience
  • 3+ years of business or financial analysis experience
  • Experience defining requirements and using data and metrics to draw business insights
  • Experience making business recommendations and influencing stakeholders
  • Knowledge of databases (querying and analyzing) such as SQL, MYSQL, and ETL Manager and working with large data sets
  • Speak, write, and read fluently in English, and have the ability to take direction in English

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience using Python or R for data analysis or statistical tools such as SAS
  • Experience with reporting and Data Visualization tools such as Quick Sight / Tableau / Power BI or other BI packages
  • Master's degree or above in BI, finance, engineering, statistics, computer science, mathematics or equivalent quantitative field, or 1+ years of developing automated reporting experience
  • Comfortable working in an international, dynamic environment, where change is present as we constantly grow, improve, and innovate

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

Join us as a “Data Analytics & BI Engineer - IDL Technology " at Barclays, where you'll spearhead the evolution of our digital landscape, driving innovation and excellence. You'll harness cutting-edge technology to revolutionise our digital offerings, ensuring unapparelled customer experiences.

You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as experience with, skills to meet business requirement as well as job-specific skillsets.

To be successful as a “Data Analytics & BI Engineer - IDL Technology", you should have experience with:

Basic/ Essential Qualifications:

  • Strong BI engineering capability, including semantic model design, DAX measures, report design, performance tuning, row-level security and workspace / deployment pipeline management.

  • Strong SQL and data modelling expertise to produce curated, explainable and trusted datasets.

  • Experience with Power BI, Tableau or Qlik and strong data storytelling skills. observability and auditability.

  • Minimum experience required 7 years.

  • Minimum Qualification – bachelor’s degree.

Desirable skillsets/ good to have:

  • Experience with streaming / event-driven technologies such as Kafka, Spark or structured streaming.

  • Experience working in regulated environments with secure-by-design controls, retention, access governance and evidencing requirements.

  • Experience building and operating reliable production-grade data pipelines, including near-real-time or streaming patterns, with strong controls around quality, reconciliation.

This role will be based out of Pune.

Purpose of the role

To support the bank's decision-making processes by providing timely, accurate, and insightful information through designing, developing, and maintaining management reports, compelling visualisations and dashboards that effectively communicate key performance indicators (KPIs), data insights and trends across various business units.

Accountabilities

  • Design and development of comprehensive reports and dashboards utilisng best practices in data visualisation principles and design aesthetics to ensure clarity, accuracy, and accessibility.

  • Design, development and implementation of automated report generation processes and visualisation methodologies for improved efficiency and timeliness.

  • Identification and analysis of business requirements to define report content and format.

  • Maintenance and updating of existing reports and dashboards to reflect changing business needs, including co-ordination of reporting template releases and related administrative tasks.

  • Development of robust processes & controls for collating input data, performing exploratory data analysis & data cleansing and seeking signoffs as required.

  • Engagement with stakeholders as needed to ensure up to date data is incorporated into reporting and visualisations.

Assistant Vice President Expectations

  • To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
  • Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
  • If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
  • OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
  • Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
  • Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
  • Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
  • Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.
  • Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
  • Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
  • Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
  • Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

Experience working on ERP implementations or data migrations (ideally NAV
  • SAP or similar)

  • Analytical mindset with strong attention to data quality and accuracy

description_html:
Nium, the Leader in Real-Time Global Payments
Nium, the leading global infrastructure for real-time cross-border payments, was founded on the mission to deliver the global payments infrastructure of tomorrow, today. With the onset of the global economy, its payments infrastructure is shaping how banks, fintechs, and businesses everywhere collect, convert, and disburse funds instantly across borders. Its payout network supports 100 currencies and spans 190+ countries, 100 of which in real-time. Funds can be disbursed to accounts, wallets, and cards and collected locally in 40 markets. Nium's growing card issuance business is already available in 34 countries. Nium holds regulatory licenses and authorizations in more than 40 countries, enabling seamless onboarding, rapid integration, and compliance – independent of geography. The company is co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore.

About the role:
We are looking for a Data Analyst who combines strong SQL and analytical skills with business and compliance understanding.

This is a data-first, business-impact role where you will:
  • Independently analyze transaction and risk data
  • Generate insights
  • translate those insights into risk rules, system logic, and operational decisions

Key Responsibilities:

  • Analyze large-scale transaction datasets using SQL to identify fraud, AML, and compliance risk patterns.
  • Translate analytical findings into clear business actions (rule tuning, thresholds, workflows, policy inputs).
  • Work with Compliance, Risk, and Product teams to convert regulatory requirements into data logic and system rules.
  • Evaluate effectiveness of risk controls using data (alert rates, false positives, precision/recall, conversion impact).
  • Design, build, and maintain dashboards and reporting that drive decision-making.
  • Perform deep-dive analyses and investigations to support financial crime initiatives.
  • Identify gaps and inefficiencies in current processes and recommend data-driven improvements.
  • Partner with engineering to implement scalable and auditable decisioning systems.

Requirements:

  • 3–6 years of experience in data analytics, risk, fraud, compliance, or financial services.
  • Strong proficiency in SQL (mandatory) ability to independently extract, join, and analyze large datasets.
  • Proven ability to connect data insights to business decisions and outcomes.
  • Experience building dashboards / visualizations (Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or similar).
  • Strong analytical thinking with a problem-solving, data-to-decision mindset.
  • Ability to work across technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience in fraud detection, AML, or transaction monitoring systems.
  • Exposure to rule engines, decision systems, or risk platforms.
  • Familiarity with Python (Pandas, NumPy) for data analysis.
  • Understanding of experimentation / threshold tuning / performance optimization.

What Success Looks Like:

  • You independently query and break down complex datasets without relying on others.
    • You move from data insight
  • action quickly and clearly.
  • You improve risk systems with measurable impact (e.g., reduced false positives, improved detection rates).
  • You think in terms of signals, patterns, and system behavior, not just reports.
What We’re Really Looking For
  • You don’t wait for data - you pull it yourself.
  • You don’t just present numbers -you recommend actions.
    • You can connect data risk insight rule/system change
  • measurable outcome.
  • You are comfortable operating across data, business, and system logic.
What we offer at Nium
We Value Performance: Through competitive salaries, performance bonuses, sales commissions, equity for specific roles and recognition programs, we ensure that all our employees are well rewarded and incentivized for their hard work.

We Care for Our Employees: The wellness of Nium’ers is our #1 priority. We offer medical coverage along with 24/7 employee assistance program, generous vacation programs including our year-end shut down. We also provide a flexible working hybrid working environment (3 days per week in the office).

We Upskill Ourselves: We are curious, and always want to learn more with a focus on upskilling ourselves. We provide role-specific training, internal workshops, and a learning stipend.

We Celebrate Together: We recognize that work is also about creating great relationships with each other. We celebrate together with company-wide social events, team bonding activities, happy hours, team offsites, and much more!

We Thrive with Diversity: Nium is truly a global company, with more than 33 nationalities, based in 18+ countries and more than 10 office locations. As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to providing a safe and welcoming environment for everyone.
For more detailed region specific benefits : https://www.nium.com/careers#careers-perks
For more information visit www.nium.com

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

About the Role

We are seeking a highly analytical Global Partner Data Senior Analyst to provide the data and insights that directly inform strategic business decisions through robust data analytics and reporting. This role sits within the Global Partner Program and Strategy team and operates at the intersection of data science and business strategy. The primary focus is on leveraging partner data across all systems—including PRM platforms, Salesforce, and learning management systems—to generate actionable insights that optimize the global partner ecosystem.

This role is instrumental in shaping the future of the Global Partner Strategy by transforming raw data into clear, compelling narratives and reports that cover the partner program, partner ecosystem, and overall partner business. This includes designing and maintaining essential dashboards, developing predictive analytics that drive strategic decisions related to Okta’s partner strategy, annual program planning, and measuring benefit ROI. You will also partner with technical teams to ensure data architecture supports robust analysis and drives efficiency across the partner lifecycle.


Key Responsibilities:

Strategic Analytics, Business Intelligence & Reporting

  • Conduct deep-dive strategic analysis to identify trends, performance drivers, and opportunities for program/ecosystem optimization.
  • Assist the design, development, and maintenance of all recurring Business Intelligence (BI) reports and executive dashboards (e.g., Tableau, Salesforce reports) to monitor the health and performance of the Global Partner Program and ecosystem, including:
    • Partner performance and engagement
    • Deal registration, referrals, and co-sell metrics
    • Portal usage analytics
  • Develop and maintain predictive models and advanced analytics that directly influence the development of partner strategy, annual program planning, program benefit ROI measurement, and business cases for new partner incentives.
  • Translate complex business questions and requirements into clear analytical frameworks and data visualizations.


Data Architecture & Governance

  • Lead global partner ecosystem data governance and audit initiatives, ensuring the accuracy, completeness, and integrity of partner data across CRM, PRM, LMS, reporting, and operational systems
  • Partner with Systems teams to architect and maintain data integrations to ensure reliable, high-quality data flow for reporting and analysis.
  • Identify data gaps and implement scalable solutions to improve reporting accuracy and generate insights.


Data Quality & Operational Support

  • Manage partner data quality projects and coordinate necessary bulk data updates across systems.
  • Document data definitions, reporting logic, and analytical methodologies to ensure consistency and transparency.
  • Support complex data-related inquiries from internal teams and handle escalated partner inquiries related to data and reporting.


Required Skills & Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or reporting roles within a SaaS or technology environment.
  • Deep expertise in leveraging partner data across CRM (Salesforce) and PRM (Impartner) systems to drive business insights.
  • Expert-level proficiency in SQL, advanced MS Excel (i.e., sumifs, index/match, pivot tables), and experience modeling complex problems.
  • Advanced hands-on experience designing, building, and maintaining reports and dashboards in BI tools such as Tableau or similar.
  • Strong understanding of data architecture, governance, and data flows across enterprise platforms.
  • Proven ability to translate business questions into actionable analysis and communicate complex findings to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Advanced analytical and problem-solving skills with a focus on scalable solutions.
  • This role requires flexibility to accommodate overlapping hours with the PST time zone.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with predictive analytics or statistical modeling to support business forecasting and ROI analysis.
  • Familiarity with data warehousing and ETL processes.
  • Familiarity with deal registration and marketing development fund administration.
  • Hands-on experience with Impartner PRM.
  • Understanding of the partner ecosystem at a SaaS technology company.

description_html:
Introduction
Welcome to Gallagher - a global community of people who bring bold ideas, deep expertise, and a shared commitment to doing what’s right.
We help clients navigate complexity with confidence by empowering businesses, communities, and individuals to thrive.
At Gallagher, you’ll find more than a job; you’ll find a culture built on trust, driven by collaboration, and sustained by the belief that we’re better together. Experience a workplace where you’re encouraged to be yourself, supported to succeed, and inspired to keep learning. That’s what it means to live The Gallagher Way.
Founded in 2006, the Gallagher Center of Excellence (GCoE) upholds the values of quality, innovation, and teamwork. With 10,000+ professionals across five India locations, GCoE is where knowledge-driven individuals make a significant impact and build rewarding, long-term careers.

Overview

Gallagher Center of Excellence is seeking to hire a Data Analytics professional for the GCoE Business Enablement vertical.
You will be responsible for analyzing complex data sets to provide actionable insights that drive business decisions.
You will manage the collection, processing, and analysis of data to support strategic initiatives and improve operational efficiency.
We are looking for someone who is very strong in MS Excel and Access, possesses good communication skills, and has a keen attention to detail.
Exposure to advanced analytics tools, data visualization techniques, and predictive modeling is a definite plus.
Your role will involve driving data excellence and innovation.
Additionally, you will be responsible for fostering a culture of collaboration, continuous improvement, and customer focus within the analytics team.
You will interact with team members located in various regions across the globe.
This position offers an exciting opportunity to fast track your learning and to build understanding of a wide range of sectors, at pace and with lots of variety.
Working alongside highly experienced reward consultants, the role offers much greater opportunities for rich and diverse learning and professional development than is available in most in-house roles, equipping you for the future while also honing your client engagement skills.

How you'll make an impact

Responsibilities:

Research and Analysis:
Researching data sources, market practice and other benchmarking information from published salary surveys through to internet searches.
Data analysis (primarily Excel based), including interpreting results and developing recommendations across pay benchmarking, gender pay gap reporting and equal pay auditing.
Data insight – translating data into valued findings and understandable information, which is accessible and useful to clients.
Effective presentation of findings - formatting data into clear, accessible graphs, tables and infographics.

Development and Design:
Providing input and evidence based advice in the development of pay progression systems and pay structures.
Cost modelling of different scenarios and similar impact assessments
Drafting documents in Excel, Word or PowerPoint to present options and recommendations to
clients.

Survey Management:
Gallagher runs a high quality UK benefits survey, which is published annually in October (250 participant organisations submitted data in 2019) and the job holder plays an important role in shaping design and continuous improvement of the survey, as well as encouraging participation.
Survey co-ordination – receiving, cleansing and checking inbound data and referring queries back to clients
Survey analyses - establishing findings, trend data and other insights and thereafter working with colleagues in Gallagher Communications to present those findings in a visual and impactful manner.
Survey development – helping design new surveys as well as supporting the growth of existing surveys.
Analysis of our annual Employee Communication Survey for Global Communication.
Supporting the build and analysis of employee communication survey.

Client Interaction:
Although the role will be primarily office based, there will be opportunities to attend client meetings,typically accompanied by a Senior Consultant, to:
Take the brief for a client or prospect’s consultancy requirements
Obtain the views of key stakeholders within the organisation e.g. in running focus groups
Writing or helping with the preparation of proposals for client work (either following a preliminary meeting or telephone and email contact with the client or in response to an invitation to tender)
Managing small benchmarking projects alone, albeit drawing on the close support of Consultants and Senior Consultants, as required.
Most small projects will be for new or existing clients and usually confined to telephone and/or email based contact with the client.

Reward Consulting team:
Supporting with Gender Pay Gap analysis and reporting for clients - this ranges from basic reports to deep dive analysis
Support with Pay Transparency projects which will also need some analytical support
Setting up spreadsheets for pay benchmarking and pay structures projects
Creating client facing calculation tools for variable pay projects
Analysis of the annual National Benchmarking Survey for the UK

EVP team:
Data Collection & Integration - Aggregate and clean data from multiple sources (HRIS, engagement surveys, compensation databases, external benchmarks).
Analytics & Modelling – Build/Review statistical models (e.g., regression, attrition prediction) to identify drivers of promotions, exits, and engagement ; Develop/review dashboards in tools like Power BI for real-time insights on attraction, retention, and workforce segmentation.
Reporting & Visualisation - Create clear, compelling reports and visualisations, including persona-based insights and EVP impact metrics.

Competencies:

Analytical Thinking: Ability to systematically and logically break down complex data sets to extract
actionable insights and inform business decisions.

Attention to Detail: Strong focus on accuracy and thoroughness in reviewing data submissions,
identifying discrepancies, and maintaining organized records

Communication Skills: Proficient in conveying information clearly and effectively to clients and team
members, ensuring mutual understanding and timely data

Technical Proficiency: Expertise in using MS Excel and Access for data entry, analysis, and database
management, with a willingness to learn additional analytics tools

Problem-Solving: Capability to identify issues within data sets and implement effective solutions
to resolve discrepancies and improve data processes.

Collaboration: Ability to work effectively with team members and departments to achieve
common goals and ensure seamless data management

Process Improvement: Aptitude for identifying opportunities to enhance data accuracy and efficiency
and implementing innovative solutions.

Adaptability: Flexibility to adjust to changing priorities and new challenges in a dynamic
work environment.

Organizational Skills: Strong ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities, maintaining organized
and up-to-date records and documentation.


About you

Qualifications:

Minimum Required Degree: Bachelor's degree in a relevant field such as Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline.

Preferred Degree: Master’s degree in data science, Statistics, Business Analytics, Computer Science, or a related field. Advanced degrees can provide deeper expertise and a competitive edge in the field.

Certificate(s)/Special Training:

Certified Analytics Professional (CAP): A widely recognized certification that demonstrates expertise in the analytics process.

Microsoft Certified: Data Analyst Associate: Validates skills in using MS Access, Power BI to maximize the value of data assets.

Google Data Analytics Professional Certificate: Provides foundational skills in data cleaning, analysis, and visualization.

Experience ( Career Level Guide)
  • 6-9 years of experience in data analytics or a related field.
  • Proficiency in data analysis, statistical methods, and data visualization tools such as Tableau or Power BI.
  • Experience in managing databases and conducting complex data analyses.
  • Advanced expertise in data modeling, predictive analytics, and machine learning techniques.
  • Proven track record of leading data-driven projects and providing strategic insights to support business decisions.
  • Experience in managing teams, developing analytics strategies, and driving innovation in data processes.
  • Strong ability to communicate insights to executive stakeholders and influence decision-making.
  • Statistical methods and advanced analysis e.g. regression and key driver analysis would be beneficial.
  • Working with Databases and analysis specific packages such as R, SPSS, Python is added advantage.
Required Skills And Knowledge:
  • Proven experience of working as a Reward Analyst, as experience matters as much as the quality of your excel
    and wider analytical skills
  • Highly developed MS Office IT skills, but especially advanced level Excel sufficient to manipulate data to
    obtain impactful insights and trend analyses
  • Numerate, with high attention to detail and an aptitude for systems and data management
  • Administratively well organized, being a completer finisher with a considerable ability to prioritize tasks
  • Resilient attitude, i.e. not easily blown off course by unpredictable work flows or tight timescales/deadlines
  • A proactive “can do” attitude and a willingness to go the extra mile when required
  • An inquisitive nature - interested in learning about different sectors, with the tenacity to research and mine
    data
  • A responsive, client focused approach and the empathy to see the world from the client’s perspective
  • The interpersonal skills and ability to develop effective working relationships with clients and persuade
    prospective clients to participate in our surveys
  • Mature judgement, i.e. having sufficiently reliable insight into people and the workings of large organizations
    to know the right things to do and say
  • Good written and oral presentation skills, sufficient to turn data into meaningful, easily accessible information


Additional Information


Compensation and benefits

On top of a competitive salary, great teams and exciting career opportunities, we also offer a wide range of benefits.

Below are the minimum core benefits you’ll get, depending on your job level, these benefits may improve:

  • Medical Insurance and Parental Medical Insurance
  • Accidental Insurance and Life Insurance
  • Retirals - Employee Gratuity, Future Service Gratuity benefit - Group Term Life, Employee Provident Fund, National Pension Scheme
  • Flexi Benefits Plan – Tax Savings Plans
  • Educational expense reimbursement
  • Annual Leave/ Maternity & Paternity Leave/ Additional paid ML, Mental Health Day

Other benefits include:

  • Employee Wellness Programs
  • Training programs
  • And more..

We value inclusion and diversity

Inclusion and diversity (I&D) is a core part of our business, and it’s embedded into the fabric of our organization. For more than 95 years, Gallagher has led with a commitment to sustainability and to support the communities where we live and work.

Gallagher embraces our employees’ diverse identities, experiences and talents, allowing us to better serve our clients and communities. We see inclusion as a conscious commitment and diversity as a vital strength. By embracing diversity in all its forms, we live out The Gallagher Way to its fullest.

Equal employment opportunity will be extended in all aspects of the employer-employee relationship, including, but not limited to, recruitment, hiring, training, promotion, transfer, demotion, compensation, benefits, layoff, and termination.

At LPL’s Global Capability Center, you'll find a collaborative culture where your voice matters, integrity guides every decision, and technology fuels progress. Your skills, talents, and ideas will redefine what's possible. LPL's success reflects its exceptional employees, who together pursue one noble purpose: empowering financial advisors to deliver personalized advice for all who need it. We’re proud to be expanding and reaching new heights in Hyderabad.

Join us as we create something extraordinary together.

Job Overview:

Step into a key role where you’ll illuminate cloud spending, control, and performance. You’ll shape data into cost saving insights, empowering teams with show-back clarity and greater understanding of their technical debt. Join us to drive smarter budgets and make real impact!

Responsibilities:

  • Analyze cloud cost and usage data to identify trends, anomalies, and optimization opportunities.
  • Build and maintain dashboards and reports for engineering, finance, and leadership.
  • Support show-back/chargeback models by mapping costs to applications, teams, and business units.
  • Use observability tools to understand business value of optimized infrastructure.
  • Perform budget vs actual variance analysis and explain cost drivers.
  • Develop and track FinOps, Controls, and Performance KCI/ KPIs (utilization, cost per unit, waste, efficiency).
  • Partner with engineering to highlight:
    • Overprovisioned resources.
    • Idle / unused infrastructure.
    • Optimization opportunities.
  • Assist in forecasting cloud spend and improving forecast accuracy.
  • Automate reporting and data extraction processes where possible.
  • Ability to track cost avoidance and realized saves.
  • Utilize and develop monitoring frameworks: data models, data quality checks, and documentation so metrics are trusted, repeatable, and utilized.

What are we looking for?

We’re looking for strong collaborators who deliver exceptional client experiences and thrive in fast-paced, team-oriented environments. Our ideal candidates pursue greatness, act with integrity, and are driven to help our clients succeed. We value those who embrace creativity, continuous improvement, and contribute to a culture where we win together and create and share joy in our work.

Requirements:

  • 8+ years in data analytics, business intelligence, or FinOps-related roles
  • Experience working with large datasets (billing, usage, financial data)
  • Experience supporting financial analysis (budgeting, forecasting, variance)
  • Exposure to cloud cost management or technology environments
  • Experience collaborating with engineering and finance teams
  • AWS Practitioner Certified, FinOps Practitioner Certifed, Azure Fundamentals
  • Strong proficiency in SQL and Data manipulation
  • Experience with data visualization tools (ie: Power BI, Tableau, etc.)
  • Advanced Excel Skills (Pivot tables, modeling and data validation)
  • Working knowledge of Cloud Platforms (AWS, Azure, OnPrem and Infrastructure)
  • Understanding of cost drivers across compute, storage and network
  • Familiarization with FinOps Principles and Concepts showback, chargeback, budgeting, forecasting and unit economics
  • Experience with cloud tools Cloud ability, cloudhealth and native cloud billing tools)
  • Ability to build and maintain dashboards scorecards and executive reports
  • Strong attention to detail in data accuracy, reconciliation and validation
  • Ability to translate data into clear actionable insights; strong story telling skills.
  • Ability to communicate insights to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Experience working with Finance, SRE/Engineering and product teams.

Preferences:

  • FinOps Certified, Azure Fundamentals certified AWS Solutions Architect certified.
  • CRISC Certification/ Understanding of Risk and Controls frameworks (NIST, CIS, CSA).

Core Competencies:

  • Clear, accurate visibility into cloud spend and cost drivers.
  • High-quality dashboards that drive decision-making and action
  • Early identification of cost anomalies and inefficiencies
  • Improved forecast accuracy and reduced budget variance
  • Strong partnership with engineering and finance teams
  • Insights that consistently lead to measurable cost savings
  • Ensure that stakeholders understand data and action

description_html:
DESCRIPTION

Amazon is shaping the future of digital video entertainment in India. We seek a BA II for our team who can help us scale Amazon MX Player, Amazon India's free ad-supported (AVOD) streaming service. Over the next few months, we plan to launch a large number of exclusive shows and new content.

Over the past decade Amazon has developed a number of market-leading, innovative and fast-growing digital and mobile businesses, including: Amazon Prime Video, Amazon Prime Music, Echo, Alexa and Kindle. This is an exciting opportunity for an entrepreneurial minded candidate who wants to work in a start-up like environment and is passionate about digital media and new customer experiences.

We are looking for an analytical leader who can build and scale the data streams for a digital video business in India He/She will work in a highly collaborative environment, and be responsible for working both with the local teams in India as well as the Global teams in Seattle & other locales.

This role will be responsible for building and maintaining end-to-end analytics solutions that drive business decisions. The ideal candidate will have a track record of navigating successfully through ambiguity, gathering business requirements and creating BI and analytics solutions that have measurable customer impact, and demonstrating exemplary written and verbal communication skills. The candidate will have to set the right vision, strategy and roadmap and work alongside with stakeholders in the organization to make it happen. The candidate knows and loves working with business intelligence tools, can model multidimensional datasets, and can partner effectively with business leaders to answer key business questions. S/he will need to be a self-starter, comfortable with ambiguity in a fast-paced and ever-changing environment, and be able to lead a team to innovate and think big, while diving deep to meet our bar for quality and accuracy.

Key job responsibilities
Duties & responsibilities for this role will include:
Design, implement, and support key datasets that provide structured and timely access to actionable business information
Set up the data lake for a new video streaming business
Owning the design, development, and maintenance of ongoing metrics, reports, analyses, dashboards, etc. to drive key business decisions.
Developing expertise across various business teams, to drive adoption and increase visibility into key measures of business performance.
Proposing and prioritizing changes to key metric reporting, creating additional metrics and processes based on program changes and customer requirements, and owning the data presented.
Interfacing with business customers to gather data and metrics requirements, then driving analytic projects which will help solve complex challenges.
Perform deep-dives to find the root causes behind variances of key parameters.
Analyzing data and driving insights related to operation and compliance.
Investigate and implement new big data technologies to provide automatic resolutions to address stakeholder needs.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent
  • 5+ years of business analyst, data analyst or similar role experience
  • Experience in data warehouse technical architectures, data modeling, infrastructure components, ETL/ ELT and reporting/analytic tools and environments, data structures and hands-on SQL coding
  • Business Intelligence systems and data presentation (Tableau, MicroStrategy, PowerBI, QuickSight)

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Working knowledge of Python/Java or similar coding languages.
  • Familiarity with AWS solutions such as Redshift, S3.
  • Have ability to independently influence and drive outputs, meet deadlines, and set clear expectations and roadmaps.
  • MBA or Master’s in Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, Finance or related field.
  • Experience in projects involving complex data sets and high variability.
  • A history of teamwork and willingness to roll up one’s sleeves to get the job done.
  • Excellent communication (verbal and written) and interpersonal skills and an ability to effectively communicate with both business and technical teams.
  • Experience handling confidential and sensitive data.
  • Design and develop data infrastructure to support business growth

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

description_html:
Role Description:

About us: At Booking.com, data drives our decisions. Technology is at our core. And innovation is everywhere. But our company is more than datasets, lines of code or A/B tests. We’re the thrill of the first night in a new place. The excitement of the next morning. The friends you encounter. The journeys you take. The sights you see. And the memories you make. Through our products, partners and people, we make it easier for everyone to experience the world

About the team: The Data & AI Governance department enables extending the governance theme of policies, standards, processes and technology for governing data and AI to driving excellence in our approach to leveraging secure, trusted, accessible data for data driven decision making through:

  • An overarching Data & AI Policy to include associated standards

  • Data & AI Governance including meta and master data management

  • Data & AI Delivery Governance

  • Data & AI Quality including both technical and business quality measures

This enables the maturity of Data and AI capabilities across Booking.com, unlocking data and algorithms as assets for delivering innovative growth opportunities and cost saving operational efficiencies.

Role Description: The Data & AI Governance Analyst role contributes to balancing regulatory safety with high-velocity innovation. Sitting within the Data & AI Governance Department, you will be part of the team that translates complex regulations (DMA, EU AI Act, etc.) into everyday agile practices. You will assist with moving beyond simple ‘checkbox compliance’, helping product and tech teams navigate the complexities of data governance and ethical AI without slowing down development. You will be challenged to learn & adapt to new tools & technologies as a part of being a champion of change. You will assist with the full lifecycle of governance, from maintaining the Data Catalogue and AI Registry, to conducting quality control reviews thus ensuring our ‘agile’ environment remains a ‘compliant’ environment. You will work cross-functionally with business and tech stakeholders to ensure the regulatory and internal policies are not just written but translated into practical guardrails.

Key Job Responsibilities and Duties:

  • Data & AI Governance Compliance Operations

  • Oversee the daily health of the various compliance dashboards. Ensure critical parameters and thresholds are monitored and actioned upon

  • Assist in operationalizing governance frameworks (AI standard, master data management, etc.) that support the ‘High Velocity’ of change, ensuring guardrails keeps pace with changes.

  • Regulatory Compliance & Monitoring

  • Assist with risk & control implications of digital regulations (DMA, EU AI Act, GDPR, etc.) and help translate legal requirements into clear, actionable items for engineering and product teams.

  • Help build the compliance monitoring plan. Actively monitor controls, review key activities, and validate that business units are adhering to defined requirements and policies.

  • Help identify compliance risks or control deficiencies in early stages projects or implementation. Escalate material risks to the Compliance Manager with recommended remediation strategies.

  • Adoption, Culture & Change Management

  • Assist with the adoption of new governance tools and technologies. Create practical processes and raise awareness that make it easier for teams to be compliant than to cut corners.

  • Simplify compliance concepts for non-technical stakeholders across the organization.

  • Ideate and embed automated compliance checkpoints into the agile processes for continual compliance

  • Policy Maintenance & Reporting

  • Assist leadership in maintaining the compliance resource library. Ensure policies are not static documents but are regularly updated to reflect new regulatory standards and industry best practices.

  • Assist with the remediation process ensuring that identified deficiencies are logged, tracked, and monitored until they are fully remediated and closed.

  • Work with other BU and second line risk teams to ensure risks are monitored, remediated and/or reported appropriately to the right stakeholders.

  • Help prepare data artifacts and evidence for internal and external audits, ensuring the ‘burden of proof’ is easily met.

Role Qualifications and Requirements:

  • 1+ years of experience around Data Governance and Compliance, or, alternatively, 1+ years of experience in working with Data, coming from Data Analysis, Business Analysis, Analytical background

  • Good verbal, written and interpersonal communication skills, with the ability to apply common sense to carry out instructions and instruct others, write reports, correspondence and procedures, and speak clearly with stakeholders.

  • Understanding of risk management procedures;

  • Ability to think through risk management problems involving multiple facets and variables in non-standardized situations, requiring non-standard solutions.

  • Ability to work independently with a wide variety of stakeholders.

This enables the maturity of Data and AI capabilities across Booking.com, unlocking data and algorithms as assets for delivering innovative growth opportunities and cost saving operational efficiencies.
Role Description: The Data & AI Governance Analyst role contributes to balancing regulatory safety with high-velocity innovation. Sitting within the Data & AI Governance Department, you will be part of the team that translates complex regulations (DMA, EU AI Act, etc.) into everyday agile practices. You will assist with moving beyond simple ‘checkbox compliance’, helping product and tech teams navigate the complexities of data governance and ethical AI without slowing down development. You will be challenged to learn & adapt to new tools & technologies as a part of being a champion of change. You will assist with the full lifecycle of governance, from maintaining the Data Catalogue and AI Registry, to conducting quality control reviews thus ensuring our ‘agile’ environment remains a ‘compliant’ environment. You will work cross-functionally with business and tech stakeholders to ensure the regulatory and internal policies are not just written but translated into practical guardrails.

Key Job Responsibilities and Duties:
Data & AI Governance Compliance Operations
Oversee the daily health of the various compliance dashboards. Ensure critical parameters and thresholds are monitored and actioned upon
Assist in operationalizing governance frameworks (AI standard, master data management, etc.) that support the ‘High Velocity’ of change, ensuring guardrails keeps pace with changes.
Regulatory Compliance & Monitoring
Assist with risk & control implications of digital regulations (DMA, EU AI Act, GDPR, etc.) and help translate legal requirements into clear, actionable items for engineering and product teams.
Help build the compliance monitoring plan. Actively monitor controls, review key activities, and validate that business units are adhering to defined requirements and policies.
Help identify compliance risks or control deficiencies in early stages projects or implementation. Escalate material risks to the Compliance Manager with recommended remediation strategies.
Adoption, Culture & Change Management
Assist with the adoption of new governance tools and technologies. Create practical processes and raise awareness that make it easier for teams to be compliant than to cut corners.
Simplify compliance concepts for non-technical stakeholders across the organization.
Ideate and embed automated compliance checkpoints into the agile processes for continual compliance
Policy Maintenance & Reporting
Assist leadership in maintaining the compliance resource library. Ensure policies are not static documents but are regularly updated to reflect new regulatory standards and industry best practices.
Assist with the remediation process ensuring that identified deficiencies are logged, tracked, and monitored until they are fully remediated and closed.
Work with other BU and second line risk teams to ensure risks are monitored, remediated and/or reported appropriately to the right stakeholders.
Help prepare data artifacts and evidence for internal and external audits, ensuring the ‘burden of proof’ is easily met.
Role Qualifications and Requirements:
1+ years of experience around Data Governance and Compliance, or, alternatively, 1+ years of experience in working with Data, coming from Data Analysis, Business Analysis, Analytical background
Good verbal, written and interpersonal communication skills, with the ability to apply common sense to carry out instructions and instruct others, write reports, correspondence and procedures, and speak clearly with stakeholders.
Understanding of risk management procedures;
Ability to think through risk management problems involving multiple facets and variables in non-standardized situations, requiring non-standard solutions.
Ability to work independently with a wide variety of stakeholders.
