Discover your future at Citi

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of more than 230,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

Job Overview

About us:

Analytics Information management (AIM) is a global community that is driving data driven transformation across Citi in multiple functions with the objective to create actionable intelligence for our business leaders. We are a fast-growing organization working with Citi businesses and functions across the world.

What do we offer:

USCC EDO team manages the implementation of best-in-class data quality measurement programs across globe in retail consumer bank. The critical areas we support:

  • Data Governance: Standardization of data definitions and ensuring consistency in usage as per definitions across systems/products/regions.
  • Meta Data Management: Leveraging data lineage, data discovery initiatives and creation of enterprise level meta data for all retail consumer products
  • Data Ownership: Identifying trusted data sources, data owners and consumers across process and products
  • Issue Management: Identifying defects and investigating root causes for different issues. Following up with stakeholders and creation of plan for resolution as per SLA
  • Audit Support: Identifying cases on control gaps, policy breaches and providing data evidence for audit completion
  • Data Certification: Developing procedures on data certification and certifying as per fit for purpose criteria

Expertise Required:

Data/Information Mgt Int Analyst is responsible for ensuring the organization’s data is accurate, complete, consistent, and reliable to support strategic planning and operational efficiency. This role involves profiling data to identify flaws, authoring data quality rules to prevent issues, monitoring data pipelines, managing metadata and remediate data concerns. This person will also be responsible to design, develop, and deploy scalable AI-powered solutions that enhance enterprise workflows and decision-making. The ideal candidate will combine strong software engineering skills with hands-on experience in machine learning and generative AI systems, including LLM-based applications and AI agents.

Metadata Management and Data Governance

  • Maintain Data Catalog/Dictionary: Document and maintain business, technical, and operational metadata, including data lineage, definitions, and data standards.
  • Data Lineage Mapping: Utilize metadata to map data lineage, understanding how data flows from source systems to downstream reporting to identify potential impact areas.
  • Policy Compliance: Ensure all data assets adhere to defined data governance policies and data privacy regulations.

Data Profiling and Analysis

  • Profiling Execution: Perform deep profiling of large datasets to understand data structure, patterns, and content, identifying hidden anomalies or missing information.
  • Root Cause Analysis (RCA): Investigate data quality issues to determine the root cause, distinguishing between upstream processing errors and data entry errors.
  • Data Assessment: Evaluate critical data elements (CDEs) for accuracy and completeness.

Data Quality Rule Creation and Authoring

  • Rule Definition: Collaborate with business stakeholders to define and validate business rules for data validation (e.g., completeness, accuracy, consistency, validity).
  • Rule Authoring/Implementation: Develop and implement data quality rules, checks, and preventative/detective controls using SQL, Python, or specialized DQ tools.
  • Validation Logic: Document validation logic and exception-handling procedures for critical datasets.

Data Monitoring and Reporting

  • Continuous Monitoring: Actively monitor data pipelines, ETL processes, and dashboards to proactively identify DQ issues and operational anomalies.
  • DQ Dashboards/Scorecards: Develop and maintain data quality metrics and scorecards to report on data accuracy trends to leadership.
  • Alerting: Set up automated alerts for breach of data quality thresholds.

Data Concern Remediations

  • Issue Resolution: Identify, document, and triage data quality issues through a tracking system.
  • Remediation Action Plans: Develop and execute remediation plans, including data cleansing efforts and automated corrections.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with data stewards, IT, and developers to resolve data issues and implement long-term solutions.
    (Preferred) –

Design and Develop AI powered solution across data Quality lifecycle utilizing Agentic AI frameworks

Technical Skills

  • Proficient in Python, SAS, SQL, Teradata, Collibra
  • Experience with prompt engineering
  • Experience building LLM-based applications, AI agents, or autonomous workflows
  • Exposure to LangChain / LangGraph frameworks
  • Exposure to creating multi-agent orchestration
  • Exposure to BI tools and technologies – example: Tableau
  • Automation and process re-engineering / optimization skills

Domain Skills

Good understanding of

  • Banking domain (Cards, Deposit, Loans, Wealth management, & Insurance etc.)
  • Audit Framework
  • Data quality framework
  • Risk & control Metrics

(Preferred) - Knowledge of Finance Regulations, Understanding of Audit Process

Soft Skills

  • Ability to identify, clearly articulate and solve complex business problems and present them to the senior management or partners in a structured and simpler form
  • Should have excellent communication and inter-personal skills
  • Good process/project management skills
  • Ability to work well across multiple functional areas
  • Ability to thrive in a dynamic and fast-paced environment
  • Contribute to organizational initiatives in wide ranging areas including competency development, training, organizational building activities etc.
  • Proactive approach in solving problems and eye for details
  • A strong team player

Educational and Experience:

  • MBA / Masters Degree in Economics / Statistics / Mathematics / Information Technology / Computer Applications / Engineering from a premier institute. BTech / B.E in Information Technology / Information Systems / Computer Applications
  • (Preferred) Post Graduate in – Computer Science, Mathematics, Operations Research, Econometrics, Management Science and related fields
  • 2 to 5 years of hands-on experience in delivering data quality, MIS, data management with at least 1 year experience in Banking Industry

Position Title: Specialist – Parts recovery Data & Planning Analyst

Role Overview

The Data & Planning Analyst for Parts Recovery is responsible for analyzing operational data, forecasting repair demand, monitoring KPIs, and supporting decision‑making for repair operations, supply chain flows, and inventory availability. The role develops dashboards, identifies performance gaps, coordinates cross‑functional reporting, and provides visibility on repaired‑parts availability, repair lead times, cost avoidance, backlog, and consumption trends. This position ensures reliable data and structured planning to improve Parts Recovery performance, reduce bottlenecks, and support Service Operations and regional teams.

Key Responsibilities

Support to Low Value Claims:
Provide operational support to the Low Value Claims team.
Request the accounting postings for amounts
corresponding to satisfactory replacements validated by the Quality team.
Request the issuance of the invoice once Accounting has completed the posting
ensuring that financial compensation for satisfactory claims is executed correctly.

D‑Parts Master Data Maintenance:
Maintain and update master data in SAP
HANA and Osapiens for defective parts, repairable components, and material status codes.
Ensure correct system configuration of the D‑Parts lifecycle, including: return creation, postings, storage locations..

Ensure correct creation and assignment of D‑codes (defective) and R‑codes (repaired)

Verify that all materials are linked to the appropriate Profit Center and Cost Center of the area.
Analyze system data to identify inconsistencies, missing fields, incorrect statuses, or blocked materials.
Monitor D‑Parts system performance KPIs, such as master data errors...
Resolve SAP/Osapiens tickets related to D‑Parts together with IT, providing business input and validating defects.
Provide training and guidance to regional teams on correct SAP postings and Osapiens usage for defective components

SAP/Osapiens System and Repair Process Support Support reverse logistics and repair processes by ensuring SAP accurately reflects transport movements, stock positions, and repair routing.

Support SAP HANA enhancement initiatives, UAT, and system testing for workflows impacting defective components.
Develop, maintain, and improve dashboards to monitor: master data gaps, process bottlenecks...
Contribute to SAP HANA migration activities (data validation, process mapping, testing).
Support Osapiens workflows for D‑Parts and repaired material traceability.
Assist in business cases for new repair capabilities (ROI, payback, demand analysis).
Support circularity and sustainability KPIs within Parts Recovery.
Develop standardized templates for dashboards, KPIs, and reporting governance.

Candidate Requirements

Education & Experience:
Bachelor’s degree / master’s degree
Minimum of 6-8 yrs experience in Material Management
Proven experience in import & Export handling
Strong analytical and data manipulation skills in Excel
Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to prioritize tasks effectively

ID: 2875 | 7-8 yrs | Bengaluru

Job Description –Techno-Functional Business Analyst


Position

Techno-Functional Business Analyst


Experience

8–10 Years


Location

Bangalore


Employment Type

Full-TimePosition Overview


We are seeking a highly experienced Techno-Functional Business Analyst with 8–10 years of experience in business analysis, data analysis, and software delivery to support applications used in the design, customization, production, and fulfillment of custom sports apparel and event merchandise.

The ideal candidate will possess a strong blend of business process expertise, technical understanding, and data analysis capabilities. This role requires working closely with business users, decorators, artwork teams, product managers, architects, developers, QA teams, and operations stakeholders to define requirements, analyze business processes and data, and ensure solutions meet business objectives.

The candidate will act as a critical bridge between business and technology teams, translating complex business needs into scalable technology solutions while leveraging data-driven insights to improve operational efficiency and customer experience.


Key Responsibilities

Business Analysis & Requirements Management

    Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather, analyze, and document business requirements.
    Facilitate workshops, interviews, discovery sessions, and process reviews.
    Translate business requirements into:
    User Stories
    Functional Specifications
    Business Process Flows
    Use Cases
    Acceptance Criteria
    Data Requirements
    Create and maintain Requirement Traceability Matrices (RTM).
    Identify process improvement opportunities and recommend technology solutions.
    Ensure business requirements are complete, testable, and aligned with organizational objectives.


Decorator & Artwork Domain Analysis

Develop deep understanding of business processes supporting:

    Artwork creation and management
    Design proofing and approvals
    Logo placement and customization
    Sports event merchandise production
    Inventory and fulfillment processes

Work closely with business teams to define business rules, workflows, exception handling, and operational controls.


Techno-Functional Analysis

    Collaborate with solution architects and engineering teams to define scalable technical solutions.
    Analyze system integrations and data flows across applications.
    Define API requirements and integration specifications.
    Participate in solution design discussions and technical reviews.
    Interpret business requirements into technical implementation requirements.
    Evaluate application functionality gaps and recommend enhancements.
    Support data mapping and transformation requirements across systems.
    Work with development teams to clarify requirements and resolve functional issues during implementation.


Data Analysis & Business Insights

The candidate should possess strong analytical capabilities and be comfortable working with large datasets.

Responsibilities

    Analyze business and operational data to identify trends, anomalies, and opportunities.
    Perform root cause analysis for production and operational issues.
    Develop data-driven recommendations for process optimization.
    Create reports, dashboards, and business performance metrics.
    Define data validation and reconciliation requirements.
    Support business decision-making using quantitative analysis.

Data Analysis Skills

    Advanced SQL querying skills.
    Data profiling and data quality analysis.
    Data mapping and transformation analysis.
    KPI definition and reporting.
    Trend analysis and forecasting.
    Business performance analysis.

Preferred Tools

    SQL
    PostgreSQL
    Snowflake
    Power BI


Agile Product Delivery

    Participate in Agile ceremonies:
    Sprint Planning
    Backlog Grooming
    Sprint Reviews
    Retrospectives
    Work closely with Product Owners on backlog prioritization.
    Create detailed user stories and acceptance criteria.
    Ensure requirements are ready for development and testing.
    Support release planning and deployment readiness activities.


Testing & Quality Assurance

    Collaborate with QA teams to define test scenarios and acceptance criteria.
    Participate in User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
    Validate implemented functionality against business requirements.
    Support defect triage and resolution activities.

Quality Engineering Knowledge

Strong understanding of:

    Functional Testing
    Integration Testing
    Regression Testing
    UAT
    Test Coverage Analysis
    Requirement Traceability

Working knowledge of:

    Unit Testing concepts
    Static Code Analysis practices
    SonarQube quality metrics
    Code quality governance
    CI/CD quality gates

The candidate is not expected to write code but should be capable of collaborating effectively with engineering teams on quality and release readiness.


Required Skills & Experience

Business Analysis

    8–10 years of experience as a Business Analyst or Techno-Functional Analyst.
    Strong expertise in requirements gathering and stakeholder management.
    Experience documenting business and functional requirements.
    Experience creating process flows, wireframes, and user stories.
    Strong facilitation and workshop management skills.


Technical Skills

Strong Understanding Of

    Web and Enterprise Applications
    REST APIs
    Microservices Architecture
    System Integrations
    Data Flows and Interfaces
    Cloud-based Applications
    Application Security Concepts
    Identity and Access Management Concepts

Data Skills

    Advanced SQL
    Data Analysis and Reporting
    Data Mapping
    Data Reconciliation
    Data Validation
    KPI Reporting

Tools

    Jira
    Confluence
    Miro
    Power BI / Tableau
    SQL Clients


Preferred Qualifications

    Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration, or related field.


Key Competencies


Functional Competencies

    Requirements Engineering
    Business Process Modeling
    Product Customization Workflows
    Artwork Lifecycle Management
    Data Analysis & Reporting
    UAT Management

Technical Competencies

    API Analysis
    Integration Analysis
    SQL & Data Analysis
    Cloud Application Understanding
    System Design Collaboration
    Quality Governance

Leadership Competencies

    Stakeholder Management
    Executive Communication
    Problem Solving
    Decision Making
    Cross-functional Collaboration

As the Orchestration Analyst, you will play a crucial role in driving data-driven decision-making processes and optimizing business performance in the Global Business Services (GBS) space. Your responsibilities will include developing and maintaining global reports, performing data quality checks, and supporting ad-hoc analyses. You should have a strong technical background in data visualization, SQL, and tools such as Alteryx. You will be responsible for gathering, analyzing, and visualizing data from various sources to provide valuable insights and support strategic initiatives across the organization. Additionally, you will focus on improving and automating analytic processes to enhance efficiency and accuracy.

Location:

  • Pune

What’s in it for you:

  • The opportunity to take on some of the world’s most meaningful challenges, helping customers achieve clean water, safe food, and healthy environments

  • The ability to make an impact and shape your career with a company that is passionate about growth

  • The support of an organization that believes it is vital to include and engage diverse people, perspectives, and ideas to achieve our best

  • Be part of an outstanding team with relentless focus on improvement and exceeding our customers’ expectations

What You Will Do:

Data Management and Analysis:

  • Utilize Power BI and ThoughtSpot to develop interactive and visually compelling reports and dashboards that enable stakeholders to make informed decisions

  • Perform data mining and modeling tasks using SQL and Python, uncovering hidden opportunities and providing insights into business performance

  • Conduct data quality checks and support day-to-day analytic needs

  • Continuously seek opportunities to enhance data analysis processes, tools, and methodologies

Communication and Collaboration:

  • Communicate complex data findings to non-technical audiences through intuitive visualizations

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive data-driven decision-making

Process Improvement and Automation:

  • Implement and manage analytic process improvements and automation using tools such as Alteryx

  • Stay updated with the latest trends and advancements in data analytics, business intelligence, and data visualization tools

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Finance, or a related field

  • Proven experience as a Data Analyst or in a similar analytical role

  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with a keen attention to detail

  • Strong communication skills to effectively convey insights to both technical and non-technical stakeholders across multiple functions

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Proficiency in data analysis and visualization tools such as Power BI and ThoughtSpot

  • Proficiency in SQL, with the ability to write queries, transform, blend, and manipulate data from databases

  • Experience with Alteryx, or similar tools, for analytic process improvement and automation is preferred

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively in a team-oriented environment

Tools:

  • Power BI/ThoughtSpot, basic SQL, Alteryx

CREATIVITY IS OUR SUPERPOWER. It’s our heritage and it’s also our future. Because we don’t just make toys. We create innovative products and experiences that inspire fans, entertain audiences and develop children through play. Mattel is at its best when every member of our team feels respected, included, and heard—when everyone can show up as themselves and do their best work every day. We value and share an infinite range of ideas and voices that evolve and broaden our perspectives with a reach that extends into all our brands, partners, and suppliers.

The Team:


BUSINESS INTELLIGENCE DEVELOPER

ENTERPRISE DATA & ANALYTICS


CREATIVITY IS OUR SUPERPOWER. It’s our heritage and it’s also our future. Because we don’t just make toys. We create innovative products and experiences that inspire, entertain and develop children through play. Mattel is at its best when every member of our team feels respected, included, and heard—when everyone can show up as themselves and do their best work every day. We value and share an infinite range of ideas and voices that evolve and broaden our perspectives with a reach that extends into all our brands, partners, and suppliers.


The Opportunity

Mattel is seeking a BI Developer, based out of our Technology & Innovation Center in Hyderabad, India, reporting to the IT Director for Enterprise Data and Analytics. The person filling this role will be responsible for developing and maintaining business intelligence solutions using tools such as Tableau, ThoughtSpot, and IBM Cognos Analytics to enable actionable insights, reporting and visualization for cross-functional analytics teams. This role includes collaborating with business analysts on requirements; creating robust data models, reports, dashboards and other solutions; and helping to ensure data accuracy and performance across our BI platforms. The BI Developer may also support and optimize existing dashboards and analytics solutions, while helping to shape the future of the company’s reporting strategies.


What Your Impact Will Be:

  • Design and develop robust data models and other business intelligence solutions using Tableau, ThoughtSpot, and IBM Cognos Analytics to support enterprise reporting and analytics needs.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to understand business requirements, translate them into actionable development plans, and ensure deliverables align with expectations.
  • Design and build reports, interactive dashboards, and visualizations to help business users gain actionable insights.
  • Partner with IT and business teams to deliver analytics projects and enhancements on time and within scope, following industry best practices.
  • Work closely with data engineers and architects to ensure data pipelines and integrations support BI and reporting needs effectively.
  • Create and execute test plans, validate data accuracy, and coordinate the roll-out of BI solutions to end users.
  • Provide training, guidance, and support to end users on BI tools and best practices, acting as a subject matter expert for analytics solutions.
  • Optimize reporting performance by improving the efficiency of queries, dashboards, and system configurations. Ensure scalability and efficiency of Mattel's BI solutions for larger data sets.
  • Conduct quality assurance (QA) checks and test BI tools, dashboards, and reports to ensure accuracy. Validate data against source systems to ensure consistency.
  • Document all reports, processes, data models, and system configurations for reference and knowledge-sharing.
  • Design BI solutions with appropriate access controls, ensuring data privacy and security.


What We’re Looking For:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, Business Analytics or another related field. MBA is a plus.
  • 2+ years of experience in a developer role or similar position, working with reporting and visualization tools. Knowledge of ThoughtSpot, Tableau and/or IBM Cognos Analytics would be an advantage. Certification in any of these tools would be a significant advantage.
  • Demonstrated experience working with data and databases required, including working understanding of SQL – Google Cloud Platform/BigQuery would be highly desirable.
  • Knowledge of data preparation, ETL/ELT tools and processes would be a significant advantage – in particular, Ascend and/or Alteryx.
  • Knowledge of data governance practices and data management tools, particularly Collibra, would be a significant advantage.
  • Familiarity with SAFe (Scaled Agile Framework) principles and practices, including an understanding of Agile methodologies, ceremonies, and tools. Certification would be a significant advantage.
  • Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications.
  • Energy, integrity, tenacity, and passion in your daily work life.
  • Good interpersonal, oral, and written communication skills.
  • Self-motivated and able to work with minimal supervision.
  • Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to multitask and prioritize appropriately.
  • Ability to work in a global environment.
  • Ability to effectively interact and communicate with stakeholders.
  • Willingness to roll up your sleeves and do what it takes to get the job done.
  • Fluent business English required, both written and verbal.


Don’t meet every single requirement? At Mattel, we are dedicated to an inclusive workplace and a culture of belonging. If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

How We Work:
We are a purpose driven company aiming to empower generations to explore the wonder of childhood and reach their full potential. We live up to our purpose employing the following behaviors:

  • We collaborate: Being a part of Mattel means being part of one team with shared values and common goals. Every person counts and working closely together always brings better results. Partnership is our process and our collective capabilities is our superpower.
  • We innovate: At Mattel we always aim to find new and better ways to create innovative products and experiences. No matter where you work in the organization, you can always make a difference and have real impact. We welcome new ideas and value new initiatives that challenge conventional thinking.
  • We execute: We are a performance-driven company. We strive for excellence and are focused on pursuing best-in-class outcomes. We believe in accountability and ownership and know that our people are at their best when they are empowered to create and deliver results.

Our Approach to Flexible Work:
We embrace a flexible work model designed to empower a culture of growth, optimism, and wellbeing, where every employee can reach their full potential. Combining purposeful in-person collaboration with flexibility, our focus is to optimize performance and drive connection for moments that matter.

Who We Are:
Mattel is a leading global toy and family entertainment company and owner of one of the most iconic brand portfolios in the world. We engage consumers and fans through our franchise brands, including Barbie, Hot Wheels, Fisher-Price, American Girl, Thomas & Friends, UNO, Masters of the Universe, Matchbox, Monster High, MEGA and Polly Pocket, as well as other popular properties that we own or license in partnership with global entertainment companies. Our offerings include toys, content, consumer products, digital and live experiences. Our products are sold in collaboration with the world’s leading retail and ecommerce companies. Since its founding in 1945, Mattel is proud to be a trusted partner in empowering generations to explore the wonder of childhood and reach their full potential.

Mattel’s award-winning workplace culture has been recognized by Forbes, Fast Company, Newsweek, Great Place to Work, TIME, and more.

Visit us at https://jobs.mattel.com/ and www.instagram.com/MattelCareers.

Mattel is an Equal Opportunity Employer where we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day. We welcome all job seekers, and all applicants will receive consideration for employment.

The Culture at Mattel
Corporate Philanthropy

Conduct quality assurance (QA) checks and test BI tools, dashboards, and reports to ensure accuracy. Validate data against source systems to ensure consistency.
Document all reports, processes, data models, and system configurations for reference and knowledge-sharing.
Design BI solutions with appropriate access controls, ensuring data privacy and security.

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, Business Analytics or another related field. MBA is a plus.
2+ years of experience in a developer role or similar position, working with reporting and visualization tools. Knowledge of ThoughtSpot, Tableau and/or IBM Cognos Analytics would be an advantage. Certification in any of these tools would be a significant advantage.
Demonstrated experience working with data and databases required, including working understanding of SQL – Google Cloud Platform/BigQuery would be highly desirable.
Knowledge of data preparation, ETL/ELT tools and processes would be a significant advantage – in particular, Ascend and/or Alteryx.
Knowledge of data governance practices and data management tools, particularly Collibra, would be a significant advantage.
Familiarity with SAFe (Scaled Agile Framework) principles and practices, including an understanding of Agile methodologies, ceremonies, and tools. Certification would be a significant advantage.
Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications.
Energy, integrity, tenacity, and passion in your daily work life.
Good interpersonal, oral, and written communication skills.
Self-motivated and able to work with minimal supervision.
Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills.
Ability to multitask and prioritize appropriately.
Ability to work in a global environment.
Ability to effectively interact and communicate with stakeholders.
Willingness to roll up your sleeves and do what it takes to get the job done.
Fluent business English required, both written and verbal.

description_html:
Who We Are

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.


The Role

The ideal candidate will have experience in Marketing Analytics, Event Analytics, Campaign Performance, Revenue Analytics, or a related marketing domain, with the ability to work on complex datasets and derive actionable insights. This role involves full-cycle analytics delivery, including data analysis, dashboard development, and presenting insights to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Strong skills in SQL, Power BI, and exposure to tools like Tableau, data warehousing, and Python or R are essential. The candidate should excel in data storytelling, stakeholder management (especially across Marketing, RevOps, and Sales), and maintaining high standards of data quality, governance, and accuracy. Experience in building automated reporting solutions and working with global, multi-region datasets is important. An MBA degree is mandatory, and certifications in SQL or Power BI are an added advantage.

Your Future at Kyndryl
Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career. We have opportunities that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.


Who You Are

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in Marketing Analytics, Event Analytics, Campaign Performance, Revenue Analytics, or a related marketing background

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and structured thinking skills, with the ability to handle complex and ambiguous datasets

  • Excellent communication and data storytelling skills, with the ability to translate insights into executive-ready narratives for both technical and non-technical audiences

  • Proven ability to manage multiple projects or workstreams simultaneously, ensuring quality, accuracy, and timely delivery

  • Advanced expertise in SQL and Power BI (data querying, data modeling, and dashboard development)

  • Experience in end-to-end analytics delivery, from problem definition to insight generation and stakeholder presentation

  • Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, particularly across Marketing, RevOps, and Sales teams

  • High attention to detail with a strong focus on data quality, validation, and governance practices

  • Ability to work in global environments and manage multi-region datasets and use cases

  • Hands-on experience with analytics and data platforms such as Power BI and Tableau

  • Strong SQL skills with experience in data warehouses; exposure to Python or R is a plus

  • Experience building automated reporting solutions, scalable dashboards, and workflow efficiencies

  • Strong understanding of data models, schemas, and enterprise data platforms

  • MBA degree is mandatory

Preferred Skills & Experience

  • Any relevant certification related to Power BI or SQL


Being You

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.


What You Can Expect

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.

From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.

We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.

We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

Get Referred!

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: Data Analysis

description_html:
Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Math, Quantitative Science, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 3 years of experience working in data analytics, consulting, data science, engineering, or a technical operations role.
  • 3 years of experience in statistical problem solving and analyzing data sets using SQL or comparable coding language (e.g., Python, R, Java, C++).

Preferred qualifications:

  • 4 years of experience in business intelligence, data analytics, or related, focusing on designing, developing, and maintaining self-service reporting tools tailored for procurement stakeholders.
  • Experience using advanced SQL, Python (Pandas/Matplotlib) and data visualization and prototyping tools.
  • Experience in developing high-fidelity wireframes or mock-ups to prototype and iterate on data visualizations and stakeholder narratives and experience defining requirements for conversational data interfaces using Natural Language Processing tools.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills to support ongoing manual reporting activities, and the ability to perform data validation, quality checks, and verification processes.
  • Familiarity with cloud data warehouse environments.

About the job

Google's leadership team hand-picks thorny business challenges, and members of BizOps work in small teams to find solutions. As part of this team you fully immerse yourself in data collection, draw insight from analysis, and then zoom out to develop compelling, synthesized recommendations. Taking strategy one step further, you also persuasively communicate your recommendations to senior-level executives, roll-up your sleeves to help drive implementation and check back-in to see the impact of your recommendations.

In the Google Procurement Organization (GPO), our aim is to unlock the value for Google to reinvest in what matters most. We do this by bringing velocity, efficiency, and security to buying at Google, while partnering across Google to deliver solutions fit for purpose. As a centralized organization operating in a high complexity environment, we bring "one voice" to stakeholders and suppliers to ensure the best outcomes. Our organization fosters a culture of collaboration and innovation while providing opportunities for ongoing career growth and development.

Within the Google Procurement Organization, the Digital Experience team is responsible for enabling and ensuring a consistent approach across the entire GPO through data insights and agile simple processes and technology, and focuses on developing GPO's processes, technology landscape and data architecture to create efficient, user-friendly, and integrated processes and systems that enhance GPO's capabilities, streamline operations, improve user experiences, and drive value for the organization.

In this role, you will be responsible for supporting components of GPO's AI-first data ecosystem and its data reporting capabilities expanding beyond traditional analytics to empower stakeholders with high-quality insights, agentic intelligence and automated forensics that facilitate data-driven decision-making.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the functional design and development of prototypes for the next generation of intelligence hubs and 'Agentic' analytics platforms tailored for procurement stakeholders.
  • Collect, aggregate, and analyze procurement-related data from various sources to create insights and visualizations.
  • Conduct the analysis to identify key performance indicators (KPIs) and metrics relevant to procurement operations.
  • Create specifications and develop proof-of-concept self-service tools that utilize NLP, enabling stakeholders to 'talk to their data' and retrieve real-time intelligence. Conduct rigorous quality assurance and testing of the 'Agentic' platform tailored for procurement stakeholders
  • Support ongoing manual reporting activities by generating ad-hoc reports, and analyses as needed for specific operational requirements and ensure accuracy, completeness, and timely delivery of manually prepared reports.
Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

description_html:
Why Valtech? We’re advisors, visionaries, creative and techies. We embrace all things digital. We talk to each other. We have fun. We love our clients. We’re looking ahead • We are global


At Valtech, we’ve got opportunities to offer you — for growth, for leadership, for big, world-changing impact and for, dare we say it, fun. We are a global workforce that is committed to building a world that works better for everyone. And that starts with our Kin. That’s why we’re proud of:

The role


Ideal candidates will have strong quantitative backgrounds and analytical discipline. While they will have some demonstrated ability to write code, they will not have learned programming languages for the sake of building their resume, but rather as a means to express their intellectual curiosity and analytical voice. Valtech will provide a platform and training to help them reach their full potential.

Valtech is looking to hire a Business Intelligence Analyst / Data Engineer to join our growing capabilities team. If you are innovative, passionate about data and AI technologies, and look to continually learn and enjoy sharing expertise, read on!

Role responsibilities

  • Analyze a collection of raw data sets to create meaningful impact to large enterprise clients while maintaining a high degree of scientific rigor and discipline.
  • Engineer data pipelines and products to help stakeholders make and execute data driven decisions.
  • Communicate analytical findings in an intuitive and visually compelling way.
  • Creating highly visual and interactive dashboards via Tableau, PowerBI, or custom web applications
  • Conducting deep dive analysis and designing KPIs to help guide business decisions and measure success
  • Engineering data infrastructure, software libraries, and APIs supporting BI and ML data pipelines
  • Architecting cloud data platform components enabling the above
  • Building and tracking project timelines, dependences, and risks
  • Gathering stakeholder requirements and conducting technical due diligence toward designing pragmatic data-driven business solutions

Minimum qualifications

We want all new hires to succeed in their roles at Valtech. That's why we've outlined the job requirements below. To be considered for this role, it's important that you meet all Minimum Qualifications. If you do not meet all of the Preferred Qualifications, we still encourage you to apply.

  • Proven industry experience executing data engineering, analytics, and/or data science projects or Bachelors/Masters degree in quantitative studies including Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science or computation-intensive Sciences and Humanities.
  • Proficiency (can execute data ingestion to insight) in programmatic languages such as SQL, Python, and R.

Preferred qualifications

  • Proficiency in visualization/reporting tools such as Tableau and PowerBI or programmatic visualization library such as R ggplot2, Python matplotlib/seaborn/bokeh, Javascript D3.
  • Proficiency in big data environments and tools such as Spark, Hive, Impala, Pig, etc.
  • Proficiency with cloud architecture components (AWS, Azure, Google)
  • Proficiency with data pipeline software such as Airflow, Luigi, or Prefect
  • Ability to turn raw data and ambiguous business questions into distilled findings and recommendations for action
  • Experience with statistical and machine learning libraries along with the ability to apply them appropriately to business problems
  • Experience leading and managing technical data/analytics/machine learning projects

What We Offer


You’ll join an international network of data professionals within our organisation. We support continuous development through our dedicated Academy. If you're looking to push the boundaries of innovation and creativity in a culture that values freedom and responsibility, we encourage you to apply.

At Valtech, we’re here to engineer experiences that work and reach every single person. To do this, we are proactive about creating workplaces that work for every person at Valtech. Our goal is to create an equitable workplace which gives people from all backgrounds the support they need to thrive, grow and meet their goals (whatever they may be). You can find out more about what we’re doing to create a Valtech for everyone here.

Please do not worry if you do not meet all of the criteria or if you have some gaps in your CV. We’d love to hear from you and see if you’re our next member of the Valtech team!

3M has a long-standing reputation as a company committed to innovation. We provide the freedom to explore and encourage curiosity and creativity. We gain new insight from diverse thinking, and take risks on new ideas. Here, you can apply your talent in bold ways that matter.

Job Description:

Collaborate with Innovative 3Mers Around the World

Choosing where to start and grow your career has a major impact on your professional and personal life, so it’s equally important you know that the company that you choose to work at, and its leaders, will support and guide you. With a wide variety of people, global locations, technologies and products, 3M is a place where you can collaborate with other curious, creative 3Mers.

The Impact You’ll Make in this Role

The ideal candidate will independently analyze complex supply chain datasets, create impactful dashboards, and deliver insights that support data driven decision-making across the enterprise supply chain organization.

As a Data Analyst, you will have the opportunity to tap into your curiosity and collaborate with some of the most innovative people around the world. Here, you will make an impact by:

  • Implement solutions by extracting cleaning and validating data from multiple sources utilizing SQL and AI-assisted workflows.
  • Conduct advanced analysis- Collecting, processing, and modelling data to obtain valuable insights and inform strategic decision making.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define and translate business requirements into data solutions.
  • Utilize AI tools to accelerate data processing, Python script generation, and the analysis of complex supply chain datasets.
  • Present insights and recommendations to functional stakeholders.
  • Build and maintain scalable data models and Support improvements in data quality, governance, and process automation.

Your Skills and Expertise

To set you up for success in this role from day one, 3M requires (at a minimum) the following qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher (completed and verified prior to start).
  • Overall, 7 years of experience, including a minimum of 3 years in data extraction and analysis and statistical analysis and analytical techniques.
  • 3 years’ experience in SQL and data visualization tools like Power BI, Tableau etc
  • Working knowledge of Python, coupled with a strong, demonstrated ability to leverage AI development tools (e.g., LLMs, coding copilots) to write code, debug, and execute data analysis efficiently.
  • Strong understanding of data modelling and relational databases and strong communication and presentation skills

Additional qualifications that could help you succeed even further in this role include:

  • Connected and optimized Snowflake data sources with BI platforms.
  • Wrote highly complex, performant SQL queries (window functions, CTEs) in Snowflake to uncover business trends.
  • Designed and implemented efficient data storage strategies within Snowflake using clustering keys, materialized views, and search optimization services.

Work Location: Hebbal, Bangalore (Karnataka), Hybrid Mode

Supporting Your Well-being

3M offers many programs to help you live your best life – both physically and financially. To ensure competitive pay and benefits, 3M regularly benchmarks with other companies that are comparable in size and scope.

Learn more about 3M’s creative solutions to the world’s problems at www.3M.com or on Instagram, Facebook, and LinkedIn @3M.

Safety is a core value at 3M. All employees are expected to contribute to a strong Environmental Health and Safety (EHS) culture by following safety policies, identifying hazards, and engaging in continuous improvement.

Please note: your application may not be considered if you do not provide your education and work history, either by: 1) uploading a resume, or 2) entering the information into the application fields directly.

Responsible for three key functions within the Division; Service Level Management – managing inventory & surplus: ensure proper stocking of inventory in all branches for the Division. Review reports daily and use the information to formulate and implement plans of action to mitigate service level risks. Division Support Services: provide support services to the entire Division with a primary focus of supporting the Product Management teams. Financial Analysis: monitor Division financials to ensure gross margin growth targets are met.

Operations Analyst

About Medline India:

Medline India was setup in 2010 in Pune, primarily as an offshore Development Centre and to augment resources for Medline Industries LP headquartered in Chicago, USA. We are a 1500+ strong and growing team of technology, finance and business support professionals who support our businesses worldwide towards a mission to make healthcare run better. We are proud to be certified as a ‘Great Place to Work’ by the Great Place to Work Institute® (India) for the duration June 2025 – June 2026. We are an organization with a conducive work environment, ample opportunities to learn, contribute and grow with a highly empowered & engaged team. We encourage our people to share their best ideas and create new opportunities for our customers and ourselves to work together to solve today’s toughest healthcare challenges.

About Medline Industries, LP:

Established in 1966, Medline Industries LP is a renowned global healthcare organization boasting 56 years of consecutive sales growth, exceeding $21 billion in annual sales. With a workforce of over 36,000 professionals spread across the globe, we operate in more than 125 countries and territories. As the largest privately held manufacturer and distributor of medical supplies in the United States, Medline is uniquely positioned to offer comprehensive products, education, and support across the continuum of care. At present, Medline Industries, LP holds the esteemed position as the #1 market leader, delivering an extensive portfolio of over 550,000 medical products and clinical solutions. Our clientele includes hospitals, extended care facilities, surgery centers, physician offices, home care agencies, providers, and retailers. We're proud to be recognized by Forbes as one of America’s Best Large Employers and Best Employers for Women. Additionally, the Chicago Tribune has consistently named us a Top Workplace for the past 12 years.

Job Description:

The Operations Analyst – Renewal is responsible for coordinating, analyzing, and executing Opportunity Analysis projects for Medline’s Renewal Division. This role ensures accurate and accessible insights on potential spending, savings, and cross‑reference data, delivering high‑quality Opportunity Analysis to support Sales teams and customers.

Some of the responsibilities are:

  • Coordinate opportunity analysis requests from Sales by performing preliminary spend and usage analysis on cross‑reference items and delivering finalized insights to Sales representatives.
  • Research, collect, and format Competitor information for use in Opportunity Analysis.
  • Perform detailed Opportunity Analysis, including:

Assessing and preparing files for import into the scrub (Cross Reference) tool. Conducting cross-reference and quantity/pricing analysis. Identifying items of interest within datasets and mapping them to the ReNewal device list. Researching and applying appropriate conversion factors and determining sourcing (OEM, ReNewal, Competitor). Building item lists, determining appropriate pricing, and finalizing Opportunity Analysis deliverables. Archiving datasets in the scrub tool for tracking and reference.

Must Have:

  • Strong sense of urgency and time management.
  • Excellent follow-up, communication, and problem-solving skills.
  • Intermediate to advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel (e.g., formulas, pivot tables, data analysis).
  • Ability to extract, analyze, and report on data accurately.
  • Detail-oriented with strong analytical thinking.
  • Highly driven and self-motivated, with the ability to work independently and meet deadlines.
  • Any Graduate- Pharma/ MBA with 3 - 8 Years

Good to have:

  • Experience with SAP or other ERP systems.
  • Prior experience working with U.S.-based teams or in a global operations environment.
  • Experience with online research and competitive analysis.

Working Hours:

  • 10.30 am to 7.30 pm – daylight saving
  • 11.30 am to 8.30 pm – non daylight saving

description_html:
Job Description:

Job Purpose

We are on a mission as a team. We are problem solvers and partners, always starting with our customers to solve their challenges and create opportunities. Our start-up roots keep us nimble, flexible and fast moving. We take ownership and make decisions. We all work for one company and work together to drive growth across the business. We engage in robust debates to find the best path, and then we move forward as one team. We take pride in what we do, acting with integrity and passion, so that our customers can perform better. We are experts and enthusiasts - combining ever-expanding knowledge with leading technology to consistently deliver results, solutions and opportunities for our customers and stakeholders. Every day we work toward transforming global markets.


We are looking for a self-motivated, passionate Senior Business Intelligence Developer to join our Clearing Data Analytics team. In this role you will develop a deep understanding of our Clearing Houses business processes. You will focus on understanding the data models and fields, integrating data, and helping users access data in an understandable and performant way. The right candidate has a unique mix of technical skills and business-process savvy, will work with our end-users to define priorities, communicate them to the data warehouse development team and will proactively develop and maintain tools, automation, and data analytic solutions to help our users achieve their goals.


Responsibilities

  • Design and develop end-to-end scalable analytical solutions using Tableau to support critical business processes
  • Help identify high-impact analytics use cases and communicate it to the data warehouse development team
  • Develop data models based in our data warehouse for the use of our self-service BI users
  • Interact with technology and business stakeholders to provide solutions for business data analytic requirements
  • Perform hands-on design, development, configuration and testing of BI reports and dashboards for new and existing business metrics
  • Become proficient in our data model and data structures to quickly respond to business queries and requests
  • Maintain a consistent, clear, and useful data dictionary
  • Use SQL and other database access tools and methods to address business or technical requirements
  • Create and maintain up to date documentation of the data model, data flow and field level mappings
  • Provide technical guidance for the design and implementation of data analytics systems and tools
  • Work with the team to develop a data governance framework, with a focus on data quality and protection of sensitive data, through establishing policies and standards, principles, processes, related tools, and data architecture
  • Resolve production problems and data issues and conduct root cause analysis
  • Participate in the design, development, and analysis of data architecture and data mart approaches


Knowledge and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field
  • 5+ years of experience in development using SQL for various transactional and/or analytical database systems
  • Skilled with architecture, design, development, and support of ETL, DWH, and Reporting solutions
  • Experience implementing data analytics tools in an enterprise setting, including installation, rollout, training, troubleshooting, and QA
  • Experience in the development process with hands on experience of basic design, structured programming, work reviews, testing cycles from unit to acceptance testing, release build, implementation, and post release bug/issue fixes
  • Proficient with Oracle SQL (e.g., complex views/joins, analytical functions, regular expressions, materialized views)
  • Experience working with large volumes of data and relational / dimensional data models
  • Experience with business intelligence reporting tools available on the Tableau platform (Tableau Desktop, Tableau Server, Tableau Prep) required
  • Experience with cloud technologies in the business intelligence area such as Snowflake, Sigma, Tableau cloud strongly preferred
  • Experience with other business intelligence reporting tools such as Business Objects, PowerBi preferred. Experience with Python is preferred.
  • Must be resourceful, self-motivated, and comfortable working under pressure in an unstructured environment with little supervision
  • Proven ability and initiative to learn and research new concepts, ideas, and technologies quickly
  • Strong systems/process orientation with demonstrated analytical thinking, organization skills, and problem-solving skills

We are looking for a self-motivated, passionate Senior Business Intelligence Developer to join our Clearing Data Analytics team. In this role you will develop a deep understanding of our Clearing Houses business processes. You will focus on understanding the data models and fields, integrating data, and helping users access data in an understandable and performant way. The right candidate has a unique mix of technical skills and business-process savvy, will work with our end-users to define priorities, communicate them to the data warehouse development team and will proactively develop and maintain tools, automation, and data analytic solutions to help our users achieve their goals.

Design and develop end-to-end scalable analytical solutions using Tableau to support critical business processes
Help identify high-impact analytics use cases and communicate it to the data warehouse development team
Develop data models based in our data warehouse for the use of our self-service BI users
Interact with technology and business stakeholders to provide solutions for business data analytic requirements
Perform hands-on design, development, configuration and testing of BI reports and dashboards for new and existing business metrics
Become proficient in our data model and data structures to quickly respond to business queries and requests
Maintain a consistent, clear, and useful data dictionary
Use SQL and other database access tools and methods to address business or technical requirements
Create and maintain up to date documentation of the data model, data flow and field level mappings
Provide technical guidance for the design and implementation of data analytics systems and tools
Work with the team to develop a data governance framework, with a focus on data quality and protection of sensitive data, through establishing policies and standards, principles, processes, related tools, and data architecture
Resolve production problems and data issues and conduct root cause analysis
Participate in the design, development, and analysis of data architecture and data mart approaches

Knowledge and Experience
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field
5+ years of experience in development using SQL for various transactional and/or analytical database systems
Skilled with architecture, design, development, and support of ETL, DWH, and Reporting solutions
Experience implementing data analytics tools in an enterprise setting, including installation, rollout, training, troubleshooting, and QA
Experience in the development process with hands on experience of basic design, structured programming, work reviews, testing cycles from unit to acceptance testing, release build, implementation, and post release bug/issue fixes

Experience with business intelligence reporting tools available on the Tableau platform (Tableau Desktop, Tableau Server, Tableau Prep) required

Job Purpose and Impact

  • BAND DESCRIPTION

    Established professional individual contributor. Works independently with general supervision. Problems faced are difficult (i.e. requires significant effort) but typically not complex (i.e. does not involve multiple layers and components to solve).     JOB SUMMARY

    The Professional in Data Analytics & Reporting – Data Visualization is responsible for collecting, processing, analyzing complex datasets and building detailed reports and dashboards using specific data tools to generate actionable insights. This job is critical for the effective provisioning of data, analytics, models, solutions, findings and presentation of insights to business stakeholders to meet business objectives across the Food enterprise in Asia Pacific.

Key Accountabilities

  • DATA ANALYSIS: Collects, transforms, and analyzes data from multiple sources to identify trends, patterns, anomalies, and actionable insights that support reporting, performance tracking, and decision making.
  • REPORTING & VISUALIZATION: Implements detailed reports and dashboards using various tools, designs and completes data visualizations to communicate moderately complex data clearly.
  • DATA MODELING & AUTOMATION: Supports data models, reporting logic, and workflow automation, while identifying and implementing opportunities to improve data collection and reporting processes using standard data management and reporting practices.
  • ADVANCED ANALYTICS AWARENESS: Familiarity with predictive analytics, AI/ML, and data science concepts to support evolving analytics solutions.
  • DATA QUALITY & REQUIREMENT SUPPORT: Validates data, supports reporting requirements, and helps ensure the accuracy and consistency of analytics solutions.

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field such as Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Business Analytics, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. Minimum of 3-4 years of relevant work experience in data analytics, reporting, or business intelligence roles.

Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: Hyderabad, Telangana, India; Bengaluru, Karnataka, India.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Math, Quantitative Science, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 6 years of experience in conducting industry trend analysis and translating data into business insights in a data-driven corporate environment.
  • Experience in writing SQL, analyzing data sets, building data pipelines, and design reporting dashboards.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Data Science, etc.).
  • 5 years of experience with designing experiments, developing statistical models, measurement, and identifying business opportunities.
  • Experience in data analysis, with the ability to solve problems in complex, fast-moving, and ambiguous business environments reliable data intuition and business acumen.
  • Experience influencing senior leadership on analytical decision making.
  • Knowledge of Google tools (e.g., Plex).
  • Ability to effectively communicate analysis and recommendations across a wide range of non-technical audiences.

About the job

Google's leadership team hand-picks thorny business challenges, and members of BizOps work in small teams to find solutions. As part of this team you fully immerse yourself in data collection, draw insight from analysis, and then zoom out to develop compelling, synthesized recommendations. Taking strategy one step further, you also persuasively communicate your recommendations to senior-level executives, roll-up your sleeves to help drive implementation and check back-in to see the impact of your recommendations.

As a Business Analysis Generalist, you are responsible to critically evaluate and synthesize analytical findings, then contextualize them against the relevant business objective or project question, drawing meaningful, justified conclusions and acknowledging data limitations to drive evidence-based decision-making. You will be required to work hours aligned with the North American time zone.

Responsibilities

  • Drive outcomes for one or more complex business analyses or overarching strategic pieces as an individual contributor. Lead efforts to translate data into insights, identify key market drivers, and design experimental frameworks using analytical tools to test hypotheses and draw conclusions.
  • Design, architect, and deploy data strategies for reporting, data pipelines, and interactive dashboards. Partner with stakeholders to define success metrics and ensure repeatable analyses that optimize global vendor operations.
  • Understand business requirements and processes and apply them to a solution design that meets user, quality, and sustainability requirements.
  • Articulate and address conflicts between the goals and objectives of stakeholders by understanding the nature of the problem and its underlying assumptions.
  • Communicate business results, related findings, and strategic roadblocks clearly to senior leadership and the broader organization by delivering high-impact presentations.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. OUR MISSION

At Redwood, we empower our customers with lights-out automation for their mission-critical business processes.

ABOUT US

Redwood Software is the leading orchestration platform for the autonomous enterprise, driving business transformation at the lowest total cost of ownership. Redwood empowers organizations to intelligently automate and orchestrate mission-critical business and IT processes across complex ERP, hybrid cloud, data and emerging agentic AI systems. Through its SaaS-first automation fabric—with AI embedded across the automation lifecycle—Redwood accelerates the path to autonomous operations. Backed by 30 years of experience and trusted by more than 50% of the Fortune 50, Redwood helps organizations unlock human potential to focus on innovation, growth and what’s next.

CORE VALUES

One Team. One Redwood

Make Your Own Weather

Obsess over Customer Success

Work the Problem

Be Curious

Own the Outcome

Respect Each Other

YOUR IMPACT

We are seeking a Financial Data Analyst to support financial planning, reporting, and revenue analytics across the business. This role will partner closely with Finance, RevOps, and Business Leadership to deliver accurate, timely, and actionable insights that drive strategic decision-making.

You will be responsible for owning and analyzing key financial metrics such as ARR, Net Retention, Gross Retention, and cash flow indicators (e.g., AR, DSO), while building scalable data models and dashboards to support forecasting, budgeting, and performance tracking.

This role goes beyond reporting, you will help connect financial outcomes to operational drivers, identify risks and opportunities, and improve data reliability across financial systems.

  • Build and maintain financial reporting models and dashboards using BigQuery, SQL, and Qlik
  • Support monthly close, forecasting, and budgeting processes through data analysis and reconciliation
  • Perform variance analysis (actuals vs plan/forecast) and explain key drivers
  • Analyze revenue trends, customer cohorts, and retention metrics to support growth strategy
  • Partner with Finance, Accounting, and RevOps to ensure data consistency across systems (e.g., Salesforce, Workday, Adaptive)
  • Translate complex financial data into clear insights for executive and board-level reporting
  • Identify opportunities to improve financial performance, efficiency, and data processes

YOUR EXPERIENCE

  • 5+ years of experience in financial data analysis, FP&A, or revenue analytics
  • Advanced SQL skills (required) with experience working on large-scale datasets (e.g., BigQuery)
  • Experience building financial models, forecasts, and variance analysis
  • Strong understanding of SaaS financial metrics, including ARR, MRR, Net/Gross Retention, CAC, LTV
  • Experience supporting monthly close, budgeting, and planning processes
  • Familiarity with financial systems and data sources (e.g., ERP, Salesforce, billing systems)
  • Experience with BI tools such as Qlik or Tableau for financial dashboards and reporting
  • Strong business acumen with the ability to link data insights to financial outcomes
  • Excellent communication skills, with experience presenting to finance and executive stakeholders
  • High attention to detail, especially in financial data accuracy and reconciliation
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Passion for data and its ability to drive business results.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Data Science, or related field.


If you like growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!

About Rippling

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.


Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365 - all within 90 seconds.


Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.85B+ from the world’s top investors - including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, Bedrock, GIC, Elad Gil and Goldman Sachs—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.


We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.


About the role

Join our growing Payments Data & Analytics team as an experienced Data Scientist. This is an opportunity to be embedded in the engine room of our customer funds analytics —playing a critical role in reconciling customer data, improving data quality, and making our payments reconciliation platform bulletproof and more scalable. You’ll work closely with Engineering, Product, and Finance teams to ensure customers have clean, actionable data at their fingertips.

Your role will involve analyzing complex data sets, managing analytical projects, and collaborating with various teams to deliver complete and accurate analytics to ensure compliance with regulators and external parties.

You should have strong critical thinking skills, and the ability to frame and break down complex problems. You thrive under ambiguity and can operate cross functionally in a fast paced environment. You are able to operate across the data stack, and support all elements from data engineering to delivering strategic recommendations

Note: Looking for a founding team member who isn't afraid to roll up their sleeves and do the heavy lifting on analytics as we build from the ground up.

What you will do

  • Build internal tooling and processes to reconcile financial and transactional data from multiple sources to enable accurate, repeatable customer funds reporting
  • Collaborate with key stakeholders (Accounting, Compliance, Engineering, etc.) to understand business requirements and develop solutions to automate reporting and reconciliation, including internal tool development and/or implementation of third party tools.
  • Maintain strong internal controls to protect against payment errors or compliance breaches.
  • Support audits, month-end reconciliation, system implementations and special projects.
  • Leverage data analysis and AI-powered tools to identify process gaps, detect anomalies, and drive automation opportunities.
  • Improve the fidelity and performance of our DBT pipelines and help evolve our broader data architecture

What you will need

  • A minimum of 4 years of experience in Business Intelligence/Data Analytics within a Finance, Accounting, or Compliance function
  • Excellent verbal communication and presentation ability. You are able to frame problems, and communicate to all levels of an organization
  • Proven track record of working cross functionally and communicating findings to executive leadership
  • Experience partnering with Finance/Accounting organizations in performing detailed and data intensive reconciliations with disparate datasets.
  • Experience reconciling financial or transactional data (ideally in an e-commerce or payments environment)
  • Experience with data warehousing and reporting technologies like DBT, Snowflake, Tableau, etc.
  • Expert in SQL
  • Familiarity with business intelligence best practices and tooling
  • Familiarity with data transformation best practices and tooling (e.g. dbt projects, incremental tables, etc.)
  • Experience with data visualization tools and delivering self service reporting

Additional Information

Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accommodations@rippling.com


Rippling highly values having employees working in-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.

Job Description:

Job Purpose

The Quantitative Analyst will join the Quant Group which designs, implements, and supports enterprise quantitative models and systems. The primary role for this position will be to provide model research, development, and strategic recommendations to solve practical problems in the financial industry. The candidate for this job must have the ability to work in a fast-paced environment, formulate and articulate solutions and defend assumptions. This role requires frequent interaction with Quant Research, Data Analytics, Risk Management, Technology Development and Senior Management.


Responsibilities

  • Design and develop quantitative model analytics frameworks to assess model usage and performance.
  • Create relevant test data sets, and portfolio strategies to be submitted to the model validators and regulators.
  • Investigate model behavior, carry out root cause analysis, and give model improvement suggestions.
  • Provide documentation of methods, techniques, results, and analysis.
  • Analyze large data sets, including positions, prices, and other market/liquidity data.
  • Research and design innovative quantitative solutions for stakeholders.
  • Develop and support in-house quantitative R&D platform and analytics tools to automate model testing, analysis, and visualization.


Knowledge and Experience

  • Master’s Degree or above in math, quantitative finance, physics, statistics, computer science or similar quantitative fields.
  • Proficiency in Python, SQL, and object-oriented programming.
  • Advanced knowledge in math (stochastic process, probability theory, numerical methods).
  • Ability to work in a high-performance, high-velocity environment.
  • Strong analytical and organizational skills with acute attention to detail.
  • Strong communication skills in both verbal and written English.


Preferred Knowledge and Experience

  • Strong knowledge of Python, SQL, and C++.
  • Strong knowledge in object-oriented programming.
  • Work experience in Options Pricing Theory.
  • Work experience in Data Analytics.

  • High proficiency in Microsoft Office products (Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint, Word, Teams, etc.)
